  color: #ffd700;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-left: 8px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.price-ticker-pill {
  background: rgba(4, 9, 26, 0.85) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3) !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12) !important;
  transition: all 0.25s ease !important;
}
.price-ticker-pill:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.6) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
}
.api-radar-pill {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4) !important;
  color: #34d399 !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15) !important;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s ease !important;
}
.api-radar-pill:hover {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.22) !important;
  border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.7) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.mode-toggle-pill {
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35) !important;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1) !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s ease !important;
}
.mode-toggle-pill:hover {
  border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.65) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.price-ticker-pill {
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}
.price-ticker-pill.ticker-updating {
  opacity: 0.25;
  transform: scale(0.98);
}

.price-ticker-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.28);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08);
}
.live-beacon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  color: var(--accent-green);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.live-beacon-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  background: var(--accent-green);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-green);
  animation: pulse 1.6s infinite;
}
.ticker-sep {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}
.ticker-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.topbar-actions {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.status-beacon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3);
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-green);
}
.beacon-dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  background: var(--accent-green);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-green);
  animation: pulse 1.8s infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.85); } }

.badge-tag {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  border: 1px solid;
}
.tag-mha { color: var(--accent-purple); border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4); background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.08); }
.tag-lea { color: var(--accent-danger); border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4); background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.08); }

/* ── LAYOUT ── */
main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 69px);
}

/* ── SIDEBAR HUD (CASE INTAKE) ── */
.sidebar {
  background: rgba(6, 8, 24, 0.7);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding: 24px 18px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 69px);
  position: sticky;
  top: 69px;
}
.section-header {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-green);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.bracket { color: var(--accent-purple); font-weight: 900; }

.hud-panel {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}
.hud-panel::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-purple), transparent);
}

/* ── Inputs & Selects ── */
.input-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.input-label span.req { color: var(--accent-danger); }

.cyber-input {
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.25);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  outline: none;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.cyber-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.9);
}

.cyber-select {
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.25);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text-main);
  padding: 9px 12px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  outline: none;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.cyber-select:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);
}

/* ── Glowing Action Buttons ── */
.btn-cyber {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.btn-cyber:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

.btn-primary-glow {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #4f6ef7);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.5);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}
.btn-primary-glow:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9333ea, #6366f1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.75);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-green-glow {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #059669, #10b981);
  color: #030712;
  font-weight: 800;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
}
.btn-green-glow:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #34d399);
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.6);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-ghost {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  padding: 8px 14px;
}
.btn-ghost:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  color: #fff;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ELEVATED SIDEBAR & PRE-LOADED CASE DOSSIER DECK
   ========================================================================== */
.case-dossier-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 14, 38, 0.85) 0%, rgba(4, 7, 22, 0.95) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}
.case-dossier-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.55);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(12, 22, 54, 0.95) 0%, rgba(6, 12, 34, 0.98) 100%);
  transform: translateX(4px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2), 0 0 12px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
}
.case-dossier-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.case-dossier-id {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #00e5ff;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.case-dossier-risk {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.case-dossier-risk.critical {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
  color: #f87171;
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
}
.case-dossier-risk.high {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
  color: #fbbf24;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
}
.case-dossier-risk.minimal {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
  color: #34d399;
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
}
.case-dossier-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.case-dossier-desc {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.case-dossier-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.case-dossier-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: #cbd5e1;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.case-dossier-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  padding-top: 8px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.btn-case-action {
  flex: 1;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: #cbd5e1;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 5px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.btn-case-action:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4);
  color: #00e5ff;
}
.btn-case-action.pdf:hover {
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
  border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
  color: #c084fc;
}

/* Glowing Pulse Animation for Run Trace Button */
.btn-primary-trace {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7 0%, #0369a1 50%, #075985 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid #38bdf8 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}
.btn-primary-trace:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff 0%, #0284c7 50%, #0369a1 100%) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.6), 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* ── Pre-loaded Case Files ── */
.case-card {
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.case-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-green);
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  transform: translateX(4px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
}
.case-id {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.case-title {
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  margin: 4px 0 2px;
}
.case-desc {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.4;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.case-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.case-chip {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.12);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}

/* ── MAIN WORKSPACE ── */
.workspace {
  padding: 30px 36px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 69px);
}

/* ── HERO COMMAND STATE (KRAKEN & CYBERTHEME HERO) ── */
#heroView {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 160px);
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}
.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
}
.hero-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 2.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.hero-title .gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #38bdf8 50%, #34d399 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
}
.hero-desc {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 680px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 34px;
}

.hero-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  max-width: 1080px;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.hero-feature {
  background: var(--bg-glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 22px 18px;
  text-align: left;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}
.hero-feature:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
}
.hf-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  display: inline-block;
}
.hf-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.hf-desc {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── LOADING ANIMATION ── */
#loadingView {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 400px;
  gap: 20px;
}
.cyber-radar {
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-top-color: var(--accent-purple);
  border-right-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  animation: radar 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) infinite;
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
}
@keyframes radar { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.loading-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
}
.loading-step-box {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--accent-green);
  background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3);
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

/* ── INVESTIGATION RESULT SECTION ── */
#resultsView { display: none; }

/* ── Investigative Nav Tabs ── */
.cyber-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.cyber-tab {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.cyber-tab:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.08);
}
.cyber-tab.active {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.25), rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.2));
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
}
.tab-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.pane { display: none; animation: fadeIn 0.25s ease-in-out; }
.pane.active { display: block; }
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

/* ── VASP ATTRIBUTION HUD CARD ── */
.attribution-hud {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-card) 0%, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.08) 100%);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-glow);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 26px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}
/* legacy corner-accent removed */

.hud-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
}
.vasp-profile {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}
.vasp-avatar {
  width: 58px;
  height: 58px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4f6ef7, #a855f7);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.5);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
}
.vasp-info h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fff;
}
.vasp-jurisdiction {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.confidence-gauge {
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.8);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-green);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  text-align: right;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
}
.cg-score {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--accent-green);
}
.cg-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
}

.hud-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}
.hud-cell {
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 14px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.hud-cell:hover {
  border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.9);
}
.hc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.hc-value {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  word-break: break-all;
}
.hc-value.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--accent-cyan); }
.hc-value.green { color: var(--accent-green); font-size: 1.15rem; }
.hc-value.warn { color: var(--accent-warn); }

/* ── ACTION DOCK ── */
.action-dock {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.action-dock .btn-cyber { width: auto; flex: 1; min-width: 180px; }


/* ==========================================================================
   UNIFIED VISUAL GRAPH DESIGN SYSTEM ACROSS ALL TABS (USER MANDATE)
   ========================================================================== */

/* 1. Universal Command Shell - Exact backdrop & border as Visual Graph */
.hud-panel,
.attribution-hud,
.graph-hud,
.notice-generator-card {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #070b1a 0%, #020308 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
  position: relative !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}
.hud-panel:hover,
.attribution-hud:hover,
.graph-hud:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 30px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15) !important;
}

/* 2. Visual-Graph-Style Header Bar Across All Panes */
.pane-cyber-header {
  padding: 14px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(3, 7, 24, 0.95) 0%, rgba(6, 12, 34, 0.9) 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: -20px -20px 20px -20px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 5;
}

/* 3. Universal Target Pill - Exact match to graph-target-pill */
.universal-target-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
  color: #e0f2fe;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
  animation: targetPillGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes targetPillGlow {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4); border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.6); }
}

/* 4. Frosted Glass Floating Toolbar Buttons (Exact Visual Graph Button Style) */
.cyber-action-tool-btn {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(6, 10, 26, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  color: #cbd5e1;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.cyber-action-tool-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
  color: #00e5ff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.cyber-action-tool-btn.green:hover {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18);
  border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6);
  color: #34d399;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
}

/* 5. High-Tech Precision Curved Bezel Corner Accents (Seamless Radial Curvature) */
.corner-accent {
  position: absolute;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 10;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background: transparent;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.corner-tl {
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  border-top: 2px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-left: 2px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-right: none !important;
  border-bottom: none !important;
  border-top-left-radius: 14px !important;
  border-top-right-radius: 0 !important;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 0 !important;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 0 !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.8));
}

.corner-tr {
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  border-top: 2px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-right: 2px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-left: none !important;
  border-bottom: none !important;
  border-top-right-radius: 14px !important;
  border-top-left-radius: 0 !important;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 0 !important;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 0 !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.8));
}

.corner-bl {
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-left: 2px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-top: none !important;
  border-right: none !important;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 14px !important;
  border-top-left-radius: 0 !important;
  border-top-right-radius: 0 !important;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 0 !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.8));
}

.corner-br {
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-right: 2px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-top: none !important;
  border-left: none !important;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 14px !important;
  border-top-left-radius: 0 !important;
  border-top-right-radius: 0 !important;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 0 !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.8));
}

/* Specific radius overrides for containers with 12px or 10px radius */
.recon-card .corner-tl, .notice-config-box .corner-tl, .notice-terminal-box .corner-tl { border-top-left-radius: 12px !important; }
.recon-card .corner-tr, .notice-config-box .corner-tr, .notice-terminal-box .corner-tr { border-top-right-radius: 12px !important; }
.recon-card .corner-bl, .notice-config-box .corner-bl, .notice-terminal-box .corner-bl { border-bottom-left-radius: 12px !important; }
.recon-card .corner-br, .notice-config-box .corner-br, .notice-terminal-box .corner-br { border-bottom-right-radius: 12px !important; }

/* 6. Tabs High-Tech Glow */
.cyber-tab {
  background: rgba(5, 8, 24, 0.75) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  transition: all 0.25s ease !important;
}
.cyber-tab:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4) !important;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}
.cyber-tab.active {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(6, 12, 34, 0.95) 100%) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3), inset 0 0 12px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}


/* ── GRAPH VIEW ── */
.graph-hud {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.graph-header {
  padding: 14px 20px;
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.6);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}
.graph-legends {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}
.leg-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 4px;
}
#graphCanvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 520px;
  background: #02020a;
  display: block;
}

/* ── TIMELINE HOP CHAIN (REDLINE STYLE) ── */
.hop-timeline {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 20px;
}
.hop-timeline::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 15px;
  bottom: 15px;
  left: 29px;
  width: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-danger), var(--accent-purple), var(--accent-green));
}
.timeline-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 16px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.timeline-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  transform: translateX(4px);
}
.tl-badge {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px currentColor;
}
.tl-content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.tl-tag {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.tl-addr {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #fff;
  word-break: break-all;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.tl-sub {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* ── RISK & AML MATRIX ── */
.risk-matrix {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 24px;
}
.risk-meter {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
}
.meter-circle {
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 5px solid;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.meter-num {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 2.4rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
}
.meter-risk-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.typology-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.typology-card {
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-danger);
}
.tc-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.tc-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; color: #fff; }
.tc-ioc { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--accent-cyan); background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; }
.tc-evidence { font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.4; }

/* ── LEGAL NOTICE GENERATOR ── */
.notice-generator-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 24px;
}
.form-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.notice-terminal {
  background: #02020a;
  border: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.2);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: #94a3b8;
  max-height: 380px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}

@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sidebar { display: none; }
  .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .hud-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .risk-matrix { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
}

/* ── Mode Switch & Banners ── */
.mode-toggle-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.85);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  user-select: none;
}
.mode-toggle-pill:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.3);
}
.mode-toggle-pill.live-mode {
  border-color: var(--accent-green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.25);
}
.mode-toggle-pill.live-mode:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.4);
}
.mode-banner-demo {
  background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.3);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: #fef08a;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.mode-banner-live {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: #6ee7b7;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.val-error-box {
  display: none;
  background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.5);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  margin: 10px 0;
  font-size: 0.73rem;
  color: #fecdd3;
  line-height: 1.4;
  animation: shake 0.3s ease;
}
@keyframes shake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  25% { transform: translateX(-4px); }
  75% { transform: translateX(4px); }
}

/* ── Top-3 Candidates Table ── */
.cand-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin-top: 14px;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}
.cand-table th {
  text-align: left;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.cand-table td {
  padding: 10px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.cand-table tr:hover td {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  color: #fff;
}
.cand-rank {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}
.cand-score {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── Interactive Logo Click Modal ── */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 99998;
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
}
.modal-card {
  background: #080c24;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent-purple);
  border-radius: 18px;
  max-width: 860px;
  width: 100%;
  max-height: 92vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45), inset 0 0 35px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15);
  padding: 28px 32px;
  position: relative;
  animation: modalPop 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
@keyframes modalPop { from { transform: scale(0.92); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }
.modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: #fff;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.modal-close:hover { background: var(--accent-danger); border-color: var(--accent-danger); transform: rotate(90deg); }
.diag-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 18px 0;
}
.diag-item {
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}
.diag-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.diag-val {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.diag-val.green { color: var(--accent-green); }
.diag-val.cyan { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
.spin-ring { transform-origin: center; animation: spinRing 12s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spinRing { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
#brandBtn:hover #brandLogo { transform: scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(56,189,248,0.7); border-color: var(--accent-green); }

/* ── Postman-style API Testing Console ── */
.postman-box {
  background: #02030d;
  border: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.3);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 18px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}
.postman-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  padding-bottom: 10px;
}
.postman-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: inline-block;
}
.method-get { background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15); color: #34d399; border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.35); }
.method-post { background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15); color: #fbbf24; border: 1px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.35); }
.api-test-card {
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.api-test-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.95);
}
.api-test-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.api-test-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 260px;
}
.api-test-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.api-endpoint-text {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: #64748b;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  word-break: break-all;
}
.btn-ping {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #4f6ef7);
  color: #fff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.btn-ping:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.6);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.btn-ping:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.btn-toggle-payload {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-toggle-payload:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  color: #fff;
}
.postman-response-box {
  background: #010207;
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #6ee7b7;
  margin-top: 8px;
  max-height: 160px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  display: none;
}
.api-radar-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.35);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--accent-green);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.api-radar-pill:hover {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.16);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* ── Topbar Brief Pill ── */
.btn-brief-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: #c084fc;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.btn-brief-pill:hover {
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.32);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45);
  color: #fff;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* ── High-Tech AI Thinking & Loading Animation ── */
.ai-thinking-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.95), rgba(20, 10, 45, 0.9));
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  animation: aiCardPulse 2.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}
@keyframes aiCardPulse {
  0%, 100% { border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1); }
  50% { border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25); }
}
.ai-thinking-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.ai-radar-box {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.ai-radar-spinner {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  border-top-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  border-right-color: var(--accent-purple);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spinRadar 0.8s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes spinRadar {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
.ai-thinking-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.ai-dots span {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent-cyan);
  animation: dotPulse 1.4s infinite ease-in-out both;
}
.ai-dots span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: -0.32s; }
.ai-dots span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: -0.16s; }
@keyframes dotPulse {
  0%, 80%, 100% { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0.3; }
  40% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}
.ai-step-dynamic {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.6);
  border-radius: 6px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-green);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.ai-thinking-progress {
  width: 100%;
  height: 4px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.ai-thinking-bar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7, #34d399);
  width: 40%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  animation: barSlide 1.5s infinite ease-in-out;
}
@keyframes barSlide {
  0% { left: -40%; width: 40%; }
  50% { width: 60%; }
  100% { left: 100%; width: 40%; }
}

/* ── Rich Markdown Formatting for AI Answers ── */
.ai-md-content {
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  line-height: 1.68;
  color: var(--text-main);
  word-break: break-word;
}
.ai-md-content h3, .ai-md-content h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  margin: 14px 0 6px 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}
.ai-md-content h3:first-child, .ai-md-content h4:first-child {
  margin-top: 0;
}
.ai-md-content p {
  margin: 6px 0 8px 0;
}
.ai-md-content strong {
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.ai-md-content em {
  color: #c084fc;
  font-style: italic;
}
.ai-md-content code {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #38bdf8;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.ai-md-content pre {
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px;
  margin: 10px 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.ai-md-content pre code {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  color: #e2e8f0;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}
.ai-md-content ul, .ai-md-content ol {
  margin: 6px 0 10px 20px;
  padding: 0;
}
.ai-md-content li {
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}
.ai-md-content blockquote {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-purple);
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1);
  margin: 10px 0;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}
.ai-md-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin: 12px 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}
.ai-md-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}
.ai-md-table th {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  text-align: left;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}
.ai-md-table td {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}
.ai-md-table tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}
.ai-action-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding-top: 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}
.ai-copy-btn {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
.ai-copy-btn:hover {
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TRACE-X SYSTEM REDESIGN & LEA COMMAND STANDARDS (PS-26182)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Typography Standardization */
h1, h2, h3, .section-heading-std {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 24px !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
body, p, input, select, textarea, td, th, .body-std {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.badge-tag, .tab-badge, .meta-std, .status-badge, .case-chip {
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Primary Dominant CTA Button */
.btn-primary-trace {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  background: #4f46e5;
  color: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #6366f1;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.4);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  margin-top: 14px;
}
.btn-primary-trace:hover {
  background: #4338ca;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.6);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.btn-primary-trace:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* Status Indicators (Colored dots with glow, zero emoji) */
.status-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.status-dot-green {
  background: #10b981;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #10b981;
}
.status-dot-amber {
  background: #f59e0b;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #f59e0b;
}
.status-dot-red {
  background: #ef4444;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #ef4444;
}
.status-dot-pulse {
  animation: dotGlow 1.8s infinite ease-in-out;
}
@keyframes dotGlow {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.85); }
}

/* High Contrast Amber for WCAG AA compliance on dark theme */
.contrast-amber {
  color: #fbbf24 !important;
}

/* Skeleton Loading Pulse */
.skeleton-card {
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.8);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.skeleton-pulse {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 25%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 75%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: skeletonShimmer 1.5s infinite;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
@keyframes skeletonShimmer {
  0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

/* Dynamic Format Hints */
.input-hint-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.input-hint-row .hint-badge {
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.input-hint-row .hint-badge:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Confidence Score Bar */
.confidence-bar-container {
  margin-top: 14px;
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
}
.confidence-bar-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.confidence-progress-track {
  width: 100%;
  height: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.confidence-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: width 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* Laundering Typology Card */
.typology-fatf-card {
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.8);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-amber);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.typology-fatf-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.typology-fatf-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.typology-fatf-ref {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  color: #fbbf24;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* Hop Classification Badges */
.hop-badge-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border: 1px solid;
}
.hop-badge-unhosted { background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12); color: #cbd5e1; border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3); }
.hop-badge-hot { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); color: #38bdf8; border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3); }
.hop-badge-deposit { background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.12); color: #34d399; border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3); }
.hop-badge-mixer { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); color: #f87171; border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4); }
.hop-badge-bridge { background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15); color: #c084fc; border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4); }

/* Cross-border MLAT Alert Card */
.mlat-alert-card {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.mlat-alert-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: #fbbf24;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ELEVATED SAHYOG DISPATCH GATEWAY MODAL (PS-26182)
   ========================================================================== */
.sahyog-modal-card {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #05081c 0%, #020410 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4) !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25), 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) !important;
  position: relative !important;
}
.sahyog-status-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
}
.sahyog-sec-badge {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
  color: #34d399;
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

/* SAHYOG Portal Modal */
.sahyog-modal-overlay {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(3, 0, 20, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  z-index: 1000;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
}
.sahyog-modal-card {
  background: #080c24;
  border: 1px solid #38bdf8;
  border-radius: 12px;
  max-width: 680px;
  width: 100%;
  max-height: 90vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
  position: relative;
}

/* Canvas Graph Controls & Cyber Inspector */
.graph-container-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #070b1a 0%, #020308 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}
#graphCanvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 420px;
  background: transparent;
  display: block;
  cursor: crosshair;
}
.graph-target-pill {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.18);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45);
  color: #e9d5ff;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  animation: fadeInPill 0.2s ease-out;
}
@keyframes fadeInPill {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}
.graph-toolbar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  right: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  max-width: calc(100% - 28px);
  gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(6, 10, 26, 0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  z-index: 20;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 15px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
}
.graph-tool-btn {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: var(--text-main);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.graph-tool-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
  color: #38bdf8;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}
.graph-tool-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}
.graph-hover-tooltip {
  position: absolute;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 30;
  background: rgba(6, 10, 26, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), 0 0 18px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  transform: translate(14px, 14px);
  transition: opacity 0.12s ease;
  min-width: 240px;
  max-width: 320px;
}
.graph-hover-tooltip .tt-header {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.graph-hover-tooltip .tt-addr {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  word-break: break-all;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.graph-hover-tooltip .tt-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-top: 5px;
}
.node-inspector-drawer {
  display: none;
  background: rgba(8, 12, 32, 0.98);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border-top: 2px solid var(--accent-purple);
  padding: 16px 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 -6px 25px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35);
  animation: slideDownFade 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}
.node-inspector-drawer.pulse-glow {
  animation: drawerPulseNotice 0.6s ease-out;
}
@keyframes slideDownFade {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes drawerPulseNotice {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9), inset 0 0 15px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 -6px 25px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35); }
}

/* LEA Analytics Tab Styles */
.analytics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.analytics-stat-card {
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.75);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

.analytics-stat-num {

}
.analytics-stat-lbl {
  font-size: 13px;

}
.analytics-charts-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
}


/* Filter pill buttons for investigation log */
.filter-pill-btn {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
.filter-pill-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
}
.filter-pill-btn.active {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  font-weight: 600;
}


/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ULTRA-CLEAN CYBER COMMAND DESIGN SYSTEM // TOPBAR, BUTTONS & VASP HERO
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── TOPBAR STANDARDIZATION ── */
.topbar {
  background: rgba(4, 6, 18, 0.94) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.25) !important;
  padding: 0 28px !important;
  min-height: 66px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
  position: sticky !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
}

.topbar-telemetry,
.topbar-actions {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
}

/* Uniform Pill Sizing & Alignment Across Entire Topbar */
.price-ticker-pill,
.api-radar-pill,
.mode-toggle-pill,
.btn-brief-pill,
.badge-tag {
  height: 36px !important;
  line-height: 36px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  vertical-align: middle !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.74rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px !important;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  user-select: none !important;
}

.price-ticker-pill {
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.9) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.35) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 0 16px !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1) !important;
}
.price-ticker-pill.ticker-updating {
  opacity: 0.3 !important;
  transform: scale(0.97) !important;
}

.api-radar-pill {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1) !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 0 14px !important;
  color: #34d399 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  gap: 7px !important;
}
.api-radar-pill:hover {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.22) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  border-color: #34d399 !important;
}

.mode-toggle-pill {
  background: rgba(11, 15, 38, 0.9) !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.45) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 0 16px !important;
  color: #fbbf24 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
}
.mode-toggle-pill:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.45) !important;
  border-color: #fbbf24 !important;
}
.mode-toggle-pill.live-mode {
  border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.55) !important;
  color: #34d399 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.25) !important;
}
.mode-toggle-pill.live-mode:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.5) !important;
  border-color: #34d399 !important;
}

.btn-brief-pill {
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.18) !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 0 16px !important;
  color: #c084fc !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
}
.btn-brief-pill:hover {
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.35) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.55) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  border-color: #d8b4fe !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

.badge-tag {
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 0 14px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px !important;
}
.tag-lea {
  color: #f87171 !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5) !important;
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12) !important;
}

/* ── ADVANCED BUTTON INTERACTION EFFECTS ACROSS ENTIRE APP ── */
.btn-cyber,
.btn-primary-trace,
.btn-sahyog-primary {
  position: relative !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
}

/* Diagonal Shine Shimmer on Hover */
.btn-cyber::before,
.btn-primary-trace::before,
.btn-sahyog-primary::before {
  content: '' !important;
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  left: -120% !important;
  width: 80% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22), transparent) !important;
  transform: skewX(-25deg) !important;
  transition: left 0.65s ease !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

.btn-cyber:hover::before,
.btn-primary-trace:hover::before,
.btn-sahyog-primary:hover::before {
  left: 150% !important;
}

.btn-cyber:hover,
.btn-primary-trace:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

.btn-cyber:active,
.btn-primary-trace:active,
.btn-sahyog-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985) !important;
}

.btn-primary-trace {
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
}
.btn-primary-trace:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) !important;
}

.btn-ghost {
  border: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.3) !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}
.btn-ghost:hover {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12) !important;
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35) !important;
}

.btn-copy-inline {
  padding: 3px 9px !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
}

/* ── REDESIGNED VASP ATTRIBUTION HUD CARD ── */
.provenance-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}
/* ==========================================================================
   STEP 7: LEA ANALYTICS & NATIONAL CYBER FORENSICS TELEMETRY COMMAND DECK (FIXED & POLISHED)
   ========================================================================== */
.analytics-header-strip {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 16px;
}
.analytics-avatar-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 62px;
  height: 62px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.analytics-aura {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2) 50%, transparent 75%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  animation: analyticsAuraPulse 3.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes analyticsAuraPulse {
  0% { transform: scale(0.92); opacity: 0.55; }
  100% { transform: scale(1.18); opacity: 0.95; }
}
.analytics-orbit-ring-1 {
  transform-origin: 36px 36px;
  animation: analyticsSpinCW 20s linear infinite;
}
.analytics-orbit-ring-2 {
  transform-origin: 36px 36px;
  animation: analyticsSpinCCW 28s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes analyticsSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
@keyframes analyticsSpinCCW {
  from { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(0deg); }
}

.analytics-badge-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 5px;
}
.analytics-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.analytics-badge.live {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
  color: #34d399;
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
}
.analytics-badge.ncrp {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
  color: #00e5ff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}
.analytics-badge.bsa {
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
  color: #c084fc;
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
}

/* Action Buttons Strip - Fixed Horizontal Inline */
.analytics-actions-strip {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
}
.analytics-btn {
  width: auto !important;
  flex: 0 0 auto !important;
  padding: 8px 14px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display) !important;
  font-size: 0.76rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}
.analytics-btn.primary {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.28) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid #00e5ff !important;
  color: #00e5ff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
}
.analytics-btn.primary:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.38) 0%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.45) 100%) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}
.analytics-btn.secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
  color: #cbd5e1 !important;
}
.analytics-btn.secondary:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}
.analytics-btn.cyan {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) !important;
  color: #00e5ff !important;
}
.analytics-btn.cyan:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

/* Jurisdiction Filter Command Bar */
.analytics-filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  background: rgba(6, 12, 30, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}
.analytics-filter-pills {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.filter-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: #94a3b8;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.filter-pill:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4);
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}
.filter-pill.active {
  border-color: #00e5ff;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
  color: #00e5ff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3);
}

/* 6-HUD Telemetry Stat Grid - 3 columns x 2 rows on normal screens, 6 on ultra-wide */
.analytics-hud-grid-6 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
@media (min-width: 1550px) {
  .analytics-hud-grid-6 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .analytics-hud-grid-6 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .analytics-hud-grid-6 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.analytics-hud-cell {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 16, 42, 0.75) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 22, 0.9) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}
.analytics-hud-cell:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 26px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.analytics-hud-icon-wrap {
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.analytics-hud-meta {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.analytics-hud-top-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.analytics-hud-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.trend-tag {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.trend-tag.green { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #34d399; }
.trend-tag.cyan { background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2); color: #00e5ff; }
.trend-tag.gold { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: #fbbf24; }
.trend-tag.purple { background: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.2); color: #c084fc; }

.analytics-hud-num {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.analytics-hud-subtext {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* 24-Hour Forensic Influx Wave Chart Deck */
.analytics-wave-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 14, 38, 0.75) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 22, 0.92) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.22);

  padding: 18px 22px;

  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.analytics-wave-header {

/* Analytical Charts Row */
.analytics-charts-deck {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.analytics-chart-panel {

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);

/* VASP Compliance & Real-time Case Tables Deck */
.analytics-tables-deck {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.analytics-table-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 14, 38, 0.7) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 20, 0.88) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.16);

/* Executive Incident Heatmap & Velocity Strip */
.analytics-velocity-deck {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 16, 40, 0.7) 0%, rgba(4, 9, 26, 0.88) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.16);

  gap: 16px;

  display: flex;
