  gap: 4px;
}
.velocity-item-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
}
.velocity-item-val {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
}
.velocity-item-desc {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: #64748b;
}

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .analytics-hub-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .analytics-tables-deck { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .analytics-charts-deck { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .analytics-velocity-deck { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .analytics-hub-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .analytics-velocity-deck { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   STEP 6: FREEZING NOTICE [SEC 91] STATUTORY DIRECTIVE COMMAND DECK
   ========================================================================== */
.notice-header-strip {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 16px;
}
.notice-justice-avatar-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 68px;
  height: 68px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.notice-justice-aura {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35) 0%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15) 50%, transparent 75%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  animation: noticeJusticeAuraPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes noticeJusticeAuraPulse {
  0% { transform: scale(0.92); opacity: 0.5; }
  100% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 0.95; }
}
.notice-justice-svg {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.55));
}
.notice-orbit-ring-1 {
  transform-origin: 36px 36px;
  animation: noticeSpinCW 16s linear infinite;
}
.notice-orbit-ring-2 {
  transform-origin: 36px 36px;
  animation: noticeSpinCCW 24s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes noticeSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
@keyframes noticeSpinCCW {
  from { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(0deg); }
}

.notice-badge-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.notice-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.notice-badge.mandate {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
  color: #34d399;
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
}
.notice-badge.sla {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  color: #fbbf24;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
}
.notice-badge.sahyog {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
  color: #00e5ff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}

/* 4-HUD Statutory Telemetry Grid */
.notice-hud-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.notice-hud-cell {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 16, 40, 0.7) 0%, rgba(4, 8, 24, 0.85) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}
.notice-hud-cell:hover {
  border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.notice-hud-icon-box {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.notice-hud-meta {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.notice-hud-title {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.notice-hud-val {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.notice-hud-sub {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* Investigative Presets & Form Area */
.notice-config-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 14, 38, 0.6) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 20, 0.8) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  position: relative;
}
.notice-presets-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}
.notice-preset-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}
.notice-preset-pill:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4);
  color: #00e5ff;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.notice-preset-pill.active {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18);
  border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5);
  color: #34d399;
}

/* Investigative Requisition Directives Checkboxes */
.notice-mandates-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}
.notice-mandate-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: #cbd5e1;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.notice-mandate-label:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3);
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.05);
}
.notice-mandate-checkbox {
  accent-color: #10b981;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Elevated Cyber Requisition Terminal */
.notice-terminal-box {
  background: #010410;
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);
  position: relative;
}
.notice-terminal-topbar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(8, 20, 38, 0.95) 0%, rgba(4, 12, 28, 0.98) 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
}
.notice-terminal-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #34d399;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.notice-terminal-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #10b981;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #10b981;
  animation: noticeDotBlink 2s infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes noticeDotBlink {
  0% { opacity: 0.4; }
  100% { opacity: 1; }
}
.notice-terminal-body {
  padding: 20px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: #94a3b8;
  max-height: 440px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
  background: #010410;
  position: relative;
}
.notice-terminal-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}
.notice-terminal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .notice-hud-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .notice-mandates-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .notice-hud-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* ── STEP 5: RISK & AML FORENSIC MATRIX (FATF RED-FLAGS & REACTOR GAUGE) ── */
.risk-header-strip {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.risk-shield-avatar-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.risk-shield-aura {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: -8px;
  right: -8px;
  bottom: -8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35) 0%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15) 50%, transparent 75%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: riskAuraPulse 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes riskAuraPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(0.95); }
  50% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(1.1); filter: blur(10px); }
}

/* 4-Pillar AML Telemetry Matrix */
.fatf-telemetry-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .fatf-telemetry-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .fatf-telemetry-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

.fatf-telemetry-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14, 22, 54, 0.75) 0%, rgba(6, 10, 28, 0.9) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}
.fatf-telemetry-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.55);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
}
.fatf-telemetry-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.8), transparent);
}
.fatf-telemetry-card.amber-glow::before {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.8), transparent);
}
.fatf-telemetry-card.purple-glow::before {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.8), transparent);
}
.fatf-telemetry-card.green-glow::before {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.8), transparent);
}

/* Cyber Risk Gauge Deck */
.risk-deck-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: stretch;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .risk-deck-container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

.risk-reactor-gauge-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(12, 20, 48, 0.9) 0%, rgba(5, 9, 26, 0.98) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 24px 20px;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), inset 0 0 25px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.05);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.risk-reactor-gauge-box:hover {
  border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.65);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 38px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 22px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
}

/* Risk Decomposition Factor Bars */
.risk-factor-metrics {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.risk-factor-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  text-align: left;
}
.rfr-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}
.rfr-label {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.rfr-val {
  font-weight: 800;
}
.rfr-track {
  height: 5px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.rfr-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: width 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.typology-deck-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.typology-cyber-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(12, 18, 48, 0.85) 0%, rgba(6, 9, 28, 0.95) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-left: 4px solid #f59e0b;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}
.typology-cyber-card:hover {
  transform: translateX(4px);
  border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
}
.typology-cyber-card.crit {
  border-left-color: #ef4444;
}
.typology-cyber-card.crit:hover {
  border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.55);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
}
.typology-cyber-card.high {
  border-left-color: #f59e0b;
}
.typology-cyber-card.med {
  border-left-color: #38bdf8;
}

/* FATF Statutory Compliance Matrix Grid (4 Pillars) */
.fatf-compliance-deck {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 14, 38, 0.75) 0%, rgba(4, 7, 22, 0.9) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.fcd-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 12px;
}
.fcd-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .fcd-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .fcd-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

.fcd-pillar-card {
  background: rgba(4, 10, 28, 0.6);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.fcd-pillar-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
  background: rgba(8, 16, 42, 0.75);
}
.fcd-pill-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.fcd-pill-desc {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.fcd-pill-status {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  width: fit-content;
}

/* ── STEP 4: TRANSACTION PATH & FORENSIC HOP EVIDENCE CONDUIT ── */
.path-nav-deck-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.path-chain-avatar-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.path-chain-aura {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: -8px;
  right: -8px;
  bottom: -8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35) 0%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15) 50%, transparent 75%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: chainAuraPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes chainAuraPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(0.95); }
  50% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(1.1); filter: blur(10px); }
}

@keyframes laserChainFlow {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.8); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.4); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #00e5ff); }
}
.chain-laser-pulse {
  transform-origin: center;
  animation: laserChainFlow 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* Path Summary Strip (4 HUD Cells) */
.path-summary-strip {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {

}
@media (max-width: 600px) {

.path-stat-card {

  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);

  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;

.path-stat-card:hover {

  box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2);

.path-stat-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;

  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.8), transparent);
}
.path-stat-icon-wrap {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.path-stat-meta {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.psc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #94a3b8;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.psc-val {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fff;
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.psc-sub {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: #64748b;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* Hop Filter Pills Bar */
.path-filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(6, 12, 30, 0.65);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.path-filter-pills {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.path-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: #94a3b8;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.path-pill:hover {
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
}
.path-pill.active {
  border-color: #38bdf8;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  color: #38bdf8;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}

/* Electric Animated Data Conduit Timeline */
.electric-timeline-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  padding-left: 0;
}
.electric-timeline-wrap::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 30px;
  bottom: 30px;
  left: 36px;
  width: 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ef4444 0%, #f59e0b 35%, #a855f7 65%, #10b981 100%);
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Hop Evidence Card Styling */
.hop-evidence-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(12, 22, 52, 0.9) 0%, rgba(5, 9, 28, 0.98) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), inset 0 0 25px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.05);
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  z-index: 2;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.hop-evidence-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.65);
  transform: translateX(4px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
}

.thc-badge {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  position: relative;
  background: rgba(10, 20, 50, 0.85);
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px currentColor;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.thc-content {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.thc-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.thc-addr-box {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #00e5ff;
  word-break: break-all;
  background: rgba(3, 7, 24, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}
.thc-telemetry-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  background: rgba(3, 8, 26, 0.65);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .thc-telemetry-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .thc-telemetry-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
.thc-tel-cell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
}
.thc-tel-lbl {
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  color: #64748b;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.thc-tel-val {
  color: #e2e8f0;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

/* Between-Hop Electric Transfer Conduit Strip */
.hop-conduit-strip {
  position: relative;
  margin: 12px 0 12px 66px;
  padding: 11px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(8, 18, 48, 0.9) 0%, rgba(14, 30, 76, 0.95) 50%, rgba(8, 18, 48, 0.9) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4);
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.73rem;
  z-index: 2;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18), inset 0 0 15px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}
.hop-conduit-strip:hover {
  border-color: #00e5ff;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(12, 28, 68, 0.96) 0%, rgba(18, 42, 98, 0.98) 50%, rgba(12, 28, 68, 0.96) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.38), inset 0 0 22px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
  transform: translateX(3px);
}
.conduit-flow-arrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: #00e5ff;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
.conduit-amt-badge {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5);
  color: #34d399;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
}
.conduit-meta-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}
.conduit-copy-btn {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: #38bdf8;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  line-height: 1;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.conduit-copy-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3);
  border-color: #00e5ff;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #00e5ff;
}

/* Card Action Toolbar */
.thc-actions-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}
.thc-act-btn {
  background: rgba(14, 28, 64, 0.75);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: #38bdf8;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}
.thc-act-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22);
  border-color: #00e5ff;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.thc-act-btn.primary {
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.16);
  border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.55);
  color: #00e5ff;
}
.thc-act-btn.primary:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3);
  border-color: #00e5ff;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.55);
}
.thc-act-btn.green {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.16);
  border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.55);
  color: #34d399;
}
.thc-act-btn.green:hover {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
  border-color: #10b981;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.55);
}

.hop-badge-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.hop-badge-hot {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.45);
  color: #f87171;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
}
.hop-badge-unhosted {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.45);
  color: #fbbf24;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
}
.hop-badge-deposit {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.45);
  color: #34d399;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
}
.hop-badge-bridge {
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45);
  color: #c084fc;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);
}
.hop-badge-mixer {
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.18);
  border: 1px solid rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.45);
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

/* ── STEP 3: ON-CHAIN QUERY TERMINAL ── */
.live-terminal-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.radar-orbit-avatar-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.radar-scan-aura {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: -8px;
  right: -8px;
  bottom: -8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35) 0%, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1) 60%, transparent 80%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: radarAuraPulse 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes radarAuraPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(0.95); }
  50% { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(1.08); filter: blur(10px); }
}

@keyframes radarSweepSpin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
.radar-sweep-group {
  transform-origin: 35px 35px;
  animation: radarSweepSpin 5s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes radarBlipTwinkle {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; transform: scale(0.7); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.4); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #00e5ff); }
}
.radar-blip { transform-origin: center; }
.radar-blip.b-1 { animation: radarBlipTwinkle 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.radar-blip.b-2 { animation: radarBlipTwinkle 2.7s ease-in-out infinite 0.7s; }
.radar-blip.b-3 { animation: radarBlipTwinkle 3.2s ease-in-out infinite 1.4s; }

/* Connected Feeds Status Strip */
.feed-status-strip {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.feed-status-card {
  background: rgba(10, 16, 40, 0.65);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}
.feed-name {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.feed-state {
  color: #34d399;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Standby Showcase Deck */
.live-standby-deck {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 44px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(10, 16, 42, 0.5) 0%, rgba(4, 7, 20, 0.8) 100%);
  border: 1px dashed rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
  border-radius: 14px;
}

/* Dual Threat Matrix Cards */
.threat-matrix-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
@media (max-width: 840px) {
  .threat-matrix-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
.threat-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14, 22, 54, 0.75) 0%, rgba(6, 10, 28, 0.9) 100%);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}
.threat-card-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 10px;
}
.threat-card-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* Asset Vault Grid */
.asset-vault-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(12, 18, 48, 0.7) 0%, rgba(6, 9, 26, 0.9) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  position: relative;
}
.vault-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}
.vault-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

/* Stream Tables */
.stream-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(10, 14, 38, 0.75) 0%, rgba(4, 7, 20, 0.95) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

/* ── STEP 2: QUANTUM NEURAL COPILOT & FORENSIC CONSOLE SYSTEM ── */
.ai-quantum-avatar-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ai-quantum-aura {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: -8px;
  right: -8px;
  bottom: -8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35) 0%, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15) 50%, transparent 70%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: aiAuraGlow 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes aiAuraGlow {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.95); }
  50% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(1.1); filter: blur(10px); }
}

@keyframes aiOrbitGyro1 {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
@keyframes aiOrbitGyro2 {
  from { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(0deg); }
}
.ai-orbit-gyro-1 {
  transform-origin: 35px 35px;
  animation: aiOrbitGyro1 20s linear infinite;
}
.ai-orbit-gyro-2 {
  transform-origin: 35px 35px;
  animation: aiOrbitGyro2 14s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes aiSynapseTwinkle {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.85); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.35); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #fff) drop-shadow(0 0 10px #c084fc); }
}
.ai-synapse-node { transform-origin: center; }
.ai-synapse-node.s-1 { animation: aiSynapseTwinkle 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.ai-synapse-node.s-2 { animation: aiSynapseTwinkle 3.2s ease-in-out infinite 0.5s; }
.ai-synapse-node.s-3 { animation: aiSynapseTwinkle 2.9s ease-in-out infinite 1.1s; }
.ai-synapse-node.s-4 { animation: aiSynapseTwinkle 3.5s ease-in-out infinite 1.7s; }

/* Dual-Engine Telemetry Matrix */
.ai-telemetry-strip {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.ai-telemetry-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(17, 24, 52, 0.7) 0%, rgba(8, 12, 30, 0.85) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.ai-telemetry-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.8), transparent);
}
.ai-telemetry-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
}
.ai-tc-icon {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ai-tc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #94a3b8;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.ai-tc-val {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.ai-tc-status {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* Glassmorphism Briefing Deck */
.copilot-glass-deck {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 23, 58, 0.65) 0%, rgba(6, 10, 28, 0.9) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 22px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}
.copilot-deck-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.copilot-deck-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}
.copilot-deck-status {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.copilot-action-ribbon {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}
.btn-copilot-action {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
  color: #38bdf8;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.btn-copilot-action:hover {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  border-color: #38bdf8;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
  color: #fff;
}
.btn-copilot-action.btn-purple {
  border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
  color: #c084fc;
}
.btn-copilot-action.btn-purple:hover {
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);
  border-color: #c084fc;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
  color: #fff;
}
.btn-copilot-action.btn-green {
  border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.4);
  background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.1);
  color: #34d399;
}
.btn-copilot-action.btn-green:hover {
  background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.25);
  border-color: #34d399;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.4);
  color: #fff;
}

/* 5-Card Investigative Prompt Grid */
.copilot-prompt-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.copilot-prompt-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14, 20, 48, 0.75) 0%, rgba(6, 9, 24, 0.9) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: left;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.copilot-prompt-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 3px;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--accent-cyan);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}
.copilot-prompt-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(20, 32, 75, 0.85) 0%, rgba(10, 16, 40, 0.95) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25);
}
.copilot-prompt-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}
.cpc-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.cpc-icon-box {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.cpc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.cpc-desc {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.cpc-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: #38bdf8;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  padding-top: 6px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

/* Chat Console Styling */
.copilot-chat-deck {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(10, 14, 36, 0.9) 0%, rgba(4, 7, 20, 0.95) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.copilot-chat-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}
.copilot-chat-log {
  max-height: 380px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: rgba(3, 5, 18, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}
.copilot-chat-log::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}
.copilot-chat-log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

/* IO User Bubble */
.chat-bubble-io {
  align-self: flex-end;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.45) 0%, rgba(67, 56, 202, 0.35) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.55);
  border-radius: 14px 14px 2px 14px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  max-width: 82%;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  position: relative;
}
.chat-io-meta {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #c084fc;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

/* Copilot AI Bubble */
.chat-bubble-ai {
  align-self: flex-start;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 23, 58, 0.8) 0%, rgba(6, 12, 32, 0.95) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
  border-left: 3px solid #38bdf8;
  border-radius: 2px 14px 14px 14px;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  max-width: 90%;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  position: relative;
}
.chat-ai-meta {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #38bdf8;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  padding-bottom: 6px;
}

/* Input Strip */
.copilot-input-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(4, 7, 22, 0.85);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 4px 6px 4px 14px;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.copilot-input-strip:focus-within {
  border-color: #38bdf8;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
}
.copilot-prefix-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #c084fc;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.copilot-input-box {
  flex: 1;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 10px 8px;
  outline: none;
}
.copilot-input-box::placeholder {
  color: #64748b;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ── 3D HOLOGRAPHIC CONSTELLATION COIN & ISOMETRIC NEON SYSTEM ── */
.vasp-avatar-box {
  width: 82px;
  height: 82px;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 30%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25) 0%, rgba(10, 18, 44, 0.95) 60%, rgba(2, 6, 20, 1) 100%);
  border: 2px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.75);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 
    0 0 25px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.45),
    inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5),
    inset 0 -3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
    0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: visible;
}
.vasp-avatar-glyph {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* Constellation Nodes Twinkle Animation */
@keyframes constellationTwinkle {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.85); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.3); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #fff) drop-shadow(0 0 10px #38bdf8); }
}
.star-node {
  transform-origin: center;
}
.node-p1 { animation: constellationTwinkle 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
.node-p2 { animation: constellationTwinkle 3.1s ease-in-out infinite 0.6s; }
.node-p3 { animation: constellationTwinkle 2.8s ease-in-out infinite 1.2s; }
.node-p4 { animation: constellationTwinkle 3.4s ease-in-out infinite 1.8s; }

/* Rotating Constellation Orbit Ticks */
@keyframes orbitTicksSpin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
.holo-orbit-ticks {
  transform-origin: 40px 40px;
  animation: orbitTicksSpin 25s linear infinite;
}

/* 3D Isometric Neon Icon Styles */
.iso-neon-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: middle;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4));
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease;
}
.hud-cell:hover .iso-neon-icon {
  transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.08);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.8));
}

/* Standby Grand Holographic Coin Showcase */
.standby-holo-coin-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 110px;
  height: 110px;
  margin: 0 auto 18px auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.standby-pcb-glow {
  position: absolute;
  top: -15px;
  left: -15px;
  right: -15px;
  bottom: -15px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25) 0%, transparent 70%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: standbyAuraPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes standbyAuraPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.95); }
  50% { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(1.08); }
}

/* ── CYBER ELEVATION: VASP ATTRIBUTION HUD (TAB 1) ── */
.attribution-hud {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 12, 32, 0.95) 0%, rgba(13, 19, 48, 0.85) 50%, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.08) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.vasp-dossier-topbar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.vasp-dossier-tag {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.provenance-strip {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.prov-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: rgba(4, 8, 24, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.prov-badge:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1);
}
.pb-label {
  color: var(--accent-green);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.pb-val {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.vasp-hero-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(11, 16, 42, 0.85), rgba(7, 10, 28, 0.95));
  border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  position: relative;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.vasp-hero-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 280px;
}

/* ── 3D DIGITAL HOLOGRAPHIC CRYPTO COIN MEDALLION ── */
.vasp-avatar-box {
  width: 74px;
  height: 74px;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35) 0%, rgba(13, 20, 48, 0.95) 55%, rgba(4, 7, 20, 1) 100%);
  border: 2.5px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.85);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 
    0 0 25px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.45),
    inset 0 2.5px 5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65),
    inset 0 -3.5px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85),
    0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.vasp-avatar-box::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  left: 3px;
  right: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.vasp-avatar-glyph {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 2;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6));
  transform: translateZ(0);
}
.vasp-avatar-scan {
  position: absolute;
  top: -120%;
  left: -120%;
  right: -120%;
  bottom: -120%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    transparent 35%,
    rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35) 48%,
    rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35) 52%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  animation: coinHoloShimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes coinHoloShimmer {
  0% { transform: translate(-30%, -30%) rotate(25deg); opacity: 0.35; }
  50% { transform: translate(30%, 30%) rotate(25deg); opacity: 0.75; }
  100% { transform: translate(-30%, -30%) rotate(25deg); opacity: 0.35; }
}

.vasp-title-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.vasp-main-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #ffffff;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.vasp-tag-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.vasp-tag-fiu {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.14);
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.5);
  color: #34d399;
}
.vasp-tag-intl {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.14);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5);
  color: #fbbf24;
}

.vasp-sub-meta {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.meta-label {
  color: #64748b;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.vasp-hero-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

.node-inspect-btn {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  padding: 4px 12px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  width: auto !important;
  height: auto !important;
  min-height: 28px !important;
  max-height: 32px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}
.node-inspect-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2) !important;
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35) !important;
}
.node-inspect-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.96) !important;
}

/* VASP Hero Ultra-Cyber Elevations */
.vasp-avatar-ring {
  position: absolute;
  top: -5px;
  left: -5px;
  right: -5px;
  bottom: -5px;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  border: 1.5px dashed rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.7);
  animation: coinOrbitSpin 14s linear infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes coinOrbitSpin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ── CYBER ENERGY ARC GAUGE (NO CLOCK NEEDLE) ── */
.hud-sonar-ring {
  transform-origin: 60px 60px;
  animation: hudSonarPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes hudSonarPulse {
  0%, 100% {
    opacity: 0.2;
    transform: scale(0.96);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.65;
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }
}

.hud-spark-node {
  animation: sparkPulseGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes sparkPulseGlow {
  0%, 100% {
    opacity: 0.85;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px currentColor);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px currentColor) drop-shadow(0 0 4px #fff);
  }
}

.vasp-seizable-pill {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.5);
  color: #34d399;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.vasp-inline-target {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);
  border-radius: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.vit-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.vit-addr {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #fff;
  word-break: break-all;
}
.btn-mini-copy {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  color: #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.btn-mini-copy:hover {
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25);
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  color: #fff;
}

.vasp-urgency-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15) 0%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
}
.vub-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #fca5a5;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 260px;
}
.vub-title {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #f87171;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.vub-desc {
  color: #fecaca;
}
.btn-urgent-freeze {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dc2626, #b91c1c);
  border: 1px solid #f87171;
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.btn-urgent-freeze:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6);
}

/* Radar Radial Gauge */
.vasp-radar-gauge-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.vasp-radar-gauge {
  position: relative;
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
}
.radar-outer-ring {
  animation: radarSpin 20s linear infinite;
  transform-origin: 60px 60px;
}
@keyframes radarSpin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.vasp-gauge-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

/* Sahyog Primary Dispatch Button */
.sahyog-dispatch-container {
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.btn-sahyog-primary {
  width: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #064e3b 0%, #047857 50%, #059669 100%);
  border: 1.5px solid #34d399;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px 24px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  text-align: left;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}
.btn-sahyog-primary:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #047857 0%, #059669 50%, #10b981 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: #a7f3d0;
}
.bsp-glow-sweep {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -100%;
  width: 60%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), transparent);
  transform: skewX(-25deg);
  animation: bspSheen 6s infinite;
}
@keyframes bspSheen {
  0%, 70% { left: -100%; }
  100% { left: 200%; }
}
.bsp-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  flex: 1;
}
.bsp-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: #fff;
}
.bsp-headline-row {
  display: flex;

  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.bsp-headline {

  font-size: 1.08rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;

}
.bsp-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);

  padding: 2px 8px;

  border: 1px solid rgba(167, 243, 208, 0.4);
}
.bsp-subline {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: #d1fae5;

}
.bsp-arrow {

  color: #a7f3d0;
}
.btn-sahyog-primary:hover .bsp-arrow {

}

/* Confidence Matrix Container */
.confidence-matrix-container {
  background: rgba(7, 11, 30, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.confidence-matrix-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.confidence-progress-wrap {
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.confidence-progress-track {
  width: 100%;
  height: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.confidence-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: width 1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.confidence-scale-ticks {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #64748b;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.heuristic-factors-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}
.heuristic-factor-card {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

}
.heuristic-factor-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
  background: rgba(20, 28, 56, 0.8);
}
.hfc-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.hfc-title {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #e2e8f0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;

}
.hfc-score {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;

}
.hfc-bar-track {
  width: 100%;
  height: 4px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.hfc-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

/* Enhanced HUD Grid Cells */
.hc-header {

}
.hc-badge {

}

.hc-badge-green { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35); }
.hc-badge-purple { background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15); color: var(--accent-purple); border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35); }
.hc-badge-amber { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: #f59e0b; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35); }
.hc-badge-red { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); color: #ef4444; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35); }

.hc-sub {

}

/* Candidate Podium Grid */
.cand-section {

}
.cand-header {

}

}
.cand-podium-card {

.cand-podium-card:hover {

}
.cand-card-rank1 {

}
.cand-card-alt {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}
.cpc-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}
.cpc-rank-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.cpc-conf {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}
.cpc-name {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
}
.cpc-bar-track {
  width: 100%;
  height: 6px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.cpc-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.cpc-meta {

  font-size: 11px;

}
.cpc-lbl {
  color: #64748b;
  margin-right: 4px;
}
.cpc-contact {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  padding-top: 8px;

  align-items: center;

}
.cpc-email {

}

/* Responsive Styles (< 768px) */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .input-grid, .results-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }
  main {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    padding: 12px;
  }
  .sidebar {
    display: block !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    padding-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .topbar {
    padding: 10px 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .topbar-telemetry {
    order: 3;
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-top: 8px;
  }
  .topbar-actions {
    margin-left: auto;
  }
  .cyber-tabs {
    display: grid !important;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 6px !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
    white-space: normal !important;
  }
  .form-row, .hud-grid, .analytics-grid, .analytics-charts-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }
  .action-dock {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .action-dock .btn-cyber {
    width: 100%;
  }
}


/* ── Copy Animation & Floating Bubble ── */
@keyframes copyBubbleFloat {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, 4px) scale(0.7);
  }
  25% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, -16px) scale(1);
  }
  75% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, -22px) scale(1);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, -30px) scale(0.9);
  }
}

.copy-float-bubble {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, 0);
  background: #10b981;
  color: #030014;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  pointer-events: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5);
  animation: copyBubbleFloat 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
  z-index: 99999;
}

.btn-copied-anim {
  border-color: #10b981 !important;
  color: #10b981 !important;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6) !important;
  transform: scale(0.98);
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

/* ── Prominent Below-Content Copy Action Button ── */
.btn-copy-card {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  padding: 8px 14px !important;
  font-size: 0.78rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.32) !important;
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) !important;
}
.btn-copy-card:hover {
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.22) !important;
  border-color: #38bdf8 !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}
.btn-copy-card:active,
.btn-copy-card.btn-copied-anim {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25) !important;
  border-color: #10b981 !important;
  color: #10b981 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6) !important;
}

/* ── Animation Utilities ── */
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes fadeOut { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes slideIn { from { transform: translateY(20px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes slideOut { from { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } to { transform: translateY(-20px); opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes ripple {
  from { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0.6; }
  to { transform: scale(2.5); opacity: 0; }
}
@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; }
  50% { opacity: 1; }
}
.anim-fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease forwards; }
.anim-fade-out { animation: fadeOut 0.2s ease forwards; }
.anim-slide-in { animation: slideIn 0.3s ease forwards; }
.anim-slide-out { animation: slideOut 0.3s ease forwards; }
/* Ripple effect for buttons */
.btn-cyber { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.btn-cyber::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 100px; height: 100px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  transform: scale(0);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.btn-cyber.ripple-active::after { animation: ripple 0.6s ease-out; }
/* Copy button animation */
.ai-copy-btn { position: relative; }
.ai-copy-btn.copied::after {
  content: "✔";
  position: absolute;
  right: 8px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--accent-green);
  animation: pulse 1s ease;
}
/* Respect prefers-reduced-motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * { animation-duration: 0s !important; transition-duration: 0s !important; }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PREMIUM GLASSMORPHISM, 3D WIREFRAME CANVAS & CYBER DOCK STYLES
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── 3D Wireframe Canvas Layer ── */

/* ── Seamless Glassmorphic Paneling ── */
.sidebar {

.notice-generator-card {

}

/* ── Dynamic Ripple Effect on Click ── */
.cyber-ripple-circle {
  position: absolute !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) !important;
  transform: scale(0) !important;

  pointer-events: none !important;

    transform: scale(3.2) !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;

}


/* ─── ELEVATED CYBER RECON SIDEBAR & ACTIVE CASE STATE ───────────────────── */
.recon-status-badge {

  font-weight: 700;

}
.wallet-input-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}
.wallet-clear-btn {
  position: absolute;
  right: 10px;
  top: 50%;

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

  color: #94a3b8;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;

}
.wallet-clear-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
  border-color: #ef4444;
  color: #fff;
}
.case-dossier-card.active {

  transform: translateX(6px) !important;
}
.case-dossier-card.active::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 4px;
  height: 100%;

}
.case-dossier-card .active-tag {

  font-weight: 800;

  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;

}

}
.case-dossier-asset-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #34d399;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}


/* ==========================================================================
   PREMIUM CYBER SIDEBAR REDESIGN (ZERO CLUTTER, HIGH-TECH HUD)
   ========================================================================== */
main {
  grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr !important;
}

.sidebar {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6, 10, 26, 0.95) 0%, rgba(2, 5, 16, 0.98) 100%) !important;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.16) !important;

}

.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar {

}

}

/* Investigative Section Header */
.sidebar-section-header {

}
.ssh-title {

.ssh-badge {

}

  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
  border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
}
.ssh-badge.cyan {
  color: #38bdf8;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}

/* Recon Panel Container */
.recon-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 14, 38, 0.85) 0%, rgba(4, 7, 22, 0.95) 100%);

}

/* Recon Engine Status Bar */
.recon-engine-bar {

/* Clean Field Label Row */
.field-label-row {

/* Cyber Input Wrapper with Integrated Left Icon & Right Clear */
.cyber-input-wrapper {

/* High-Impact Trace Wallet Button */
.btn-recon-trace {

  justify-content: center;

  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);

  overflow: hidden;
}

  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38bdf8 0%, #00e5ff 60%, #0284c7 100%);

}

/* Neo4j Aura Results Table */
.neo4j-results-table {

}

  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
  color: #fff;
}


/* ==========================================================================
   WIDESCREEN ULTRA-PREMIUM CYBER COMMAND MODALS (SIH INTRO & FORENSIC CONSOLE)
   ========================================================================== */
.modal-overlay {
  background: rgba(2, 5, 18, 0.88) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) !important;
}

.modal-card {
  max-width: 1180px !important;
  width: 94% !important;
  max-height: 90vh !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 16, 42, 0.96) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 24, 0.98) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.28) !important;
  border-top: 3px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), 0 0 50px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.14), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
  padding: 30px 36px !important;
}

/* Widescreen 4-Column Feature Grid for System Dossier */
.sih-feature-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
  margin-bottom: 22px !important;
}
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .sih-feature-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .sih-feature-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }
}

.sih-feature-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 14, 38, 0.75) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 22, 0.92) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18) !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 16px 18px !important;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
}
.sih-feature-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5) !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15) !important;
}

.sfc-header {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display) !important;
  font-size: 0.82rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px !important;
}

.sfc-bullets {
  font-family: var(--font-sans) !important;
  font-size: 0.76rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
}
.sfc-bullets code {
  color: #00e5ff !important;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
  padding: 1px 4px !important;
  border-radius: 3px !important;
}

/* Widescreen 3-Column Diagnostics Grid */
.diag-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  margin: 20px 0 !important;
}
@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .diag-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .diag-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }
}

.diag-item {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 14, 38, 0.8) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 22, 0.95) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.16) !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}
.diag-item:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}
.diag-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.66rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: #64748b !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-bottom: 4px !important;
}
.diag-val {
  font-family: var(--font-display) !important;
  font-size: 0.84rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #f1f5f9 !important;
}

/* Elevated Postman Console Box */
.postman-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(4, 9, 26, 0.88) 0%, rgba(2, 5, 18, 0.96) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.22) !important;

.postman-header {

  margin-bottom: 16px !important;

}

.btn-ping {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  color: #00e5ff !important;

  padding: 6px 16px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display) !important;

  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3) !important;

}

.api-test-card {
  background: rgba(6, 12, 34, 0.75) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;

/* ==========================================================================
   AI INVESTIGATOR, TOPBAR SPACE MANAGEMENT & SAHYOG MODAL UPGRADES
   ========================================================================== */

/* Topbar Space Optimization & Masterclass Responsive Fit */
.topbar {
  background: rgba(3, 7, 24, 0.96) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.28) !important;
  padding: 0 18px !important;
  height: 56px !important;
  min-height: 56px !important;
  max-height: 56px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  position: sticky !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

.brand {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}
.brand-emblem {
  width: 36px !important;
  height: 36px !important;
  min-width: 36px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a, #1e1b4b) !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5) !important;
  border-radius: 9px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3) !important;
  position: relative !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
.brand-text {
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  line-height: 1.2 !important;
}
.brand-text h1 {
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif) !important;
  font-size: 1.05rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}
.brand-text h1 span.tx-tag {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7) !important;
  -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
  font-size: 1.12rem !important;
}
.brand-text h1 span.sub-tag {
  color: #34d399 !important;
  font-size: 0.78rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px !important;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.4) !important;
}
.brand-sub {
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace) !important;
  font-size: 0.58rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-top: 1px !important;
}

/* Telemetry Hub */
.topbar-telemetry {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  flex: 1 1 auto !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
}

/* Uniform Pill System Across Telemetry */
.price-ticker-pill,
.api-radar-pill,
.mode-toggle-pill {
  height: 32px !important;
  line-height: 32px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  vertical-align: middle !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace) !important;
  font-size: 0.70rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  user-select: none !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}

/* 1. Rates Ticker Pill */
.price-ticker-pill {
  background: rgba(8, 14, 36, 0.9) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) !important;
  padding: 0 12px !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12) !important;
}
.price-ticker-pill:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.6) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
}
.price-ticker-pill.ticker-updating {
  opacity: 0.4 !important;

/* 4. Actions & Tools Hub Button */

.btn-topbar-tools { height: 32px !important;

  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif) !important;
  font-size: 0.74rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.16) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  color: #38bdf8 !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), 0 0 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
  transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  user-select: none !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.32) 100%) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), 0 0 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools.is-active {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.42) 100%) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.6) !important;
}

.tools-gear-icon {
  width: 17px !important;
  height: 17px !important;
  min-width: 17px !important;
  min-height: 17px !important;
  max-width: 17px !important;
  max-height: 17px !important;
  stroke: #00e5ff !important;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease !important;
  display: block !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools:hover .tools-gear-icon {
  transform: rotate(60deg) !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #00e5ff) !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools.is-active .tools-gear-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg) !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #00e5ff) !important;
}

.tools-btn-label {

}

}

/* ==========================================================================

}

.tools-btn-label {

.btn-topbar-tools { height: 32px !important;

  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;

  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), 0 0 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
  transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;

}

  border-color: #00e5ff !important;

  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools.is-active {

}

  transform: rotate(60deg) !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #00e5ff) !important;
}

  transform: rotate(180deg) !important;

/* Individual Tool Card (No !important on display to allow easy filtering) */

   SIH26182 GROUNDED & CREDIBLE RESEARCH PROTOTYPE STYLES
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Global Disclaimer Banner */
.sih-global-disclaimer-banner {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
  padding: 8px 24px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 105;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.sgdb-inner {
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sgdb-badge {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.22);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.65);
  color: #fbbf24;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 4px;

  white-space: nowrap;
}
.sgdb-msg {
  font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui);

}
