  color: #fbbf24;
}
.sgdb-msg em {
  color: #38bdf8;
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Investigator Pipeline Flow Ribbon */
.investigator-pipeline-card {
  background: rgba(8, 14, 38, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  margin: 20px 0 24px 0;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}
.ipc-header {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.ipc-title-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.ipc-icon {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}
.ipc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.ipc-badge {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
  color: #38bdf8;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.ipc-sub {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.ipc-steps-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: stretch;
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .ipc-steps-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    row-gap: 14px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .ipc-steps-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
.ipc-step-item {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 52, 0.6);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.ipc-step-item:hover {
  background: rgba(20, 32, 70, 0.8);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.ipc-step-item.active {
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
}
.ipc-step-item.approval-step {
  border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5);

}
.ipc-step-num {

  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #38bdf8;

}

}

  font-weight: 700;
  color: #f8fafc;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.ipc-step-desc {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.ipc-arrow {
  position: absolute;
  right: -8px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  z-index: 2;
  display: none;
}

}

  }

  }
}
.lis-card {
  background: rgba(12, 20, 48, 0.6);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);

.lis-card-title {

}
.lis-card-text em {
  color: #38bdf8;

}


/* Calm, sober disclaimer for every pane / view */

  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);

        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px">
          <select id="customMethod" class="cyber-select" style="width:110px;margin-bottom:0;font-weight:700">
            <option value="GET">GET</option>
            <option value="POST">POST</option>
            <option value="PUT">PUT</option>
          </select>
          <input type="text" id="customUrl" class="cyber-input" style="flex:1;margin-bottom:0" placeholder="https://api.example.com/v1/endpoint..." />
          <button class="btn-cyber btn-primary-glow" id="btnSendCustom" onclick="sendCustomApiRequest()" style="width:auto;padding:8px 18px">
            Send request
          </button>
        </div>

        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px">
          <div>
            <div class="input-label" style="margin-bottom:4px">Headers (JSON format)</div>
            <textarea id="customHeaders" class="cyber-input" style="height:70px;resize:vertical;font-size:0.75rem;font-family:var(--font-mono)" placeholder='{"Authorization": "Bearer ...", "X-API-KEY": "..."}'></textarea>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div class="input-label" style="margin-bottom:4px">Request Body (JSON format for POST)</div>
            <textarea id="customBody" class="cyber-input" style="height:70px;resize:vertical;font-size:0.75rem;font-family:var(--font-mono)" placeholder='{"address": "0x...", "query": "..."}'></textarea>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Custom Response View -->
        <div id="customResponseSection" style="display:none;background:#010207;border:1px solid rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.3);border-radius:8px;padding:12px">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">
            <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:700">
              RESPONSE: <span id="customRespStatus" style="color:var(--accent-green)">200 OK</span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--accent-cyan)">
              ⏱️ <span id="customRespLatency">0ms</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <pre class="postman-response-box" id="customRespPayload" style="display:block;max-height:220px"></pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:20px;flex-wrap:wrap">
      <button class="btn-cyber btn-primary-glow" onclick="togglePitchView()" style="width:auto;flex:1">📋 View Team Pitch Guide</button>
      <button class="btn-cyber btn-ghost" onclick="resetDashboardConsole()" style="width:auto;flex:1">🏠 Reset Console</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Collapsible Team Pitch View -->
    <div id="inlinePitchView" style="display:none;margin-top:20px;background:#030412;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);border-radius:10px;padding:16px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-secondary);max-height:240px;overflow-y:auto">
      <div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--accent-green);margin-bottom:8px">💡 30-Second Elevator Pitch:</div>
      <p style="line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:10px">
        "TraceX is an automated blockchain forensic intelligence system that traces illicit fund flows from unhosted suspect wallets across multi-hop peel chains directly to destination centralized exchanges (e.g., Binance, CoinDCX, WazirX). It integrates real-time on-chain balance queries, cryptographic OFAC sanctions verification, public scam intelligence feeds, and automated FATF money laundering typology classification. Upon attributing the terminal VASP, it instantly synthesizes a statutory Section 91 BNSS / CrPC asset-freezing requisition directive. All APIs configured with evaluation keys and IO review required."
      </p>
      <div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--accent-cyan);margin-bottom:4px">🔑 Configured Evaluation APIs:</div>
      <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.72rem;line-height:1.6">
        • Etherscan V2 API (Ethereum / EVM) — Evaluation Key Prototype<br/>
        • TronGrid API (TRON / TRC-20 USDT) — Evaluation Key Prototype<br/>

        • US Treasury OFAC SLS (Cryptographic Sanctions) — Official SDN<br/>
        • Chainabuse (Public Scam Reports) — Public Registry
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<main>
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SIDEBAR HUD // TARGET INPUT & PRE-LOADED DOSSIERS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<aside class="sidebar">

  <!-- ── 01. TARGET RECON HUD ── -->
  <div class="sidebar-section-header">
    <div class="ssh-left">
      <span class="ssh-number">01</span>
      <span class="ssh-title">Target Recon</span>
    </div>
    <span class="ssh-badge">MULTI-CHAIN</span>
  </div>

  <div class="recon-card">
    <div class="corner-accent corner-tl"></div>
    <div class="corner-accent corner-tr"></div>
    <div class="corner-accent corner-bl"></div>
    <div class="corner-accent corner-br"></div>

    <div class="recon-engine-bar">
      <!-- Case Input Mode Indicator -->
      <div class="reb-status">
        <span class="pulse-indicator" style="background:#10b981;box-shadow:0 0 8px #10b981"></span>
        <span>Case Input Ready</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Suspect Wallet Field -->
    <div class="field-label-row">
      <label for="walletAddr">Suspect Crypto Wallet</label>
      <span class="field-req-tag">REQUIRED</span>
    </div>

    <div class="cyber-input-wrapper">
      <div class="ciw-icon">
        <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 12V7H5a2 2 0 0 1 0-4h14v4"/><path d="M3 5v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16v-5"/><path d="M18 12a2 2 0 0 0 0 4h4v-4Z"/></svg>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="walletAddr" class="cyber-recon-input" placeholder="Paste address (0x..., T..., bc1..., SOL...)" oninput="handleWalletInputLive(this.value)" onpaste="setTimeout(()=>handleWalletInputLive(this.value), 30)" onchange="handleWalletInputLive(this.value)" onkeyup="handleWalletInputLive(this.value)"/>
      <button type="button" class="ciw-clear-btn" id="walletClearBtn" onclick="clearWalletInput()" title="Clear address">✕</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Quick Samples & Network Detect (Clean Stacked Layout) -->
    <div class="samples-detected-container">
      <div class="samples-top-row">
        <span class="samples-label">QUICK SAMPLES:</span>
        <div class="samples-pills-row">
          <button type="button" class="sample-chip eth" onclick="pasteSampleAddr('ETH')">ETH</button>
          <button type="button" class="sample-chip tron" onclick="pasteSampleAddr('TRON')">TRON</button>
          <button type="button" class="sample-chip btc" onclick="pasteSampleAddr('BTC')">BTC</button>
          <button type="button" class="sample-chip sol" onclick="pasteSampleAddr('SOL')">SOL</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="network-detect-status">
        <span class="nds-dot"></span>
        <span id="detectedChainHint">Auto-Detecting Network...</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Dynamic Validation Error Alert -->
    <div id="valErrorBox" class="val-error-box"></div>

    <!-- Target Network Dropdown -->
    <div class="field-label-row" style="margin-top:12px">
      <label for="chainSelect">Target Network</label>
      <span class="field-info-tag">AUTO-DETECT</span>
    </div>
    <select id="chainSelect" class="cyber-recon-select">
      <option value="">🔄 Auto-Detect Chain</option>
      <option value="BTC">₿ Bitcoin (BTC)</option>
      <option value="ETH">Ξ Ethereum (ETH)</option>
      <option value="TRON">🔴 TRON / USDT (TRC-20)</option>
      <option value="BNB">🟡 BNB Smart Chain</option>
      <option value="POLYGON">🟣 Polygon / MATIC</option>
      <option value="SOL">🌙 Solana (SOL)</option>
    </select>

    <!-- Crime Category Dropdown -->
    <div class="field-label-row" style="margin-top:12px">
      <label for="crimeCategory">Crime Category</label>
      <span class="field-info-tag">TYPOLOGY</span>
    </div>
    <select id="crimeCategory" class="cyber-recon-select">
      <option>Cyber Fraud / Task Scam</option>
      <option>Ransomware Extortion</option>
      <option>Investment Fraud / Ponzi</option>
      <option>Phishing / Drainer</option>
      <option>Darknet Market Proceeds</option>
      <option>Terrorism Financing</option>
      <option>Synthetic Benchmark</option>
    </select>

    <!-- Investigating Officer Input -->
    <div class="field-label-row" style="margin-top:12px">
      <label for="ioName">Investigating Officer / Unit</label>
    </div>
    <div class="cyber-input-wrapper">
      <div class="ciw-icon">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M19 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H9a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="ioName" class="cyber-recon-input" placeholder="e.g. Analyst LEA-701" value="Analyst LEA-701"/>
    </div>

    <!-- Prominent Trace Button -->
    <button class="btn-recon-trace" id="btnRunTrace" onclick="runTrace()">
      <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
      <span>TRACE WALLET</span>
      <span class="brt-arrow">➔</span>
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- ── 02. PRE-LOADED DOSSIER VAULT ── -->
  <div class="sidebar-section-header" onclick="toggleSidebarSection('demoCasesList', 'dossierArrow')" style="cursor:pointer">
    <div class="ssh-left">
      <span class="ssh-number" style="color:#c084fc;background:rgba(168,85,247,0.12);border-color:rgba(168,85,247,0.3)">02</span>
      <span class="ssh-title">Dossier Vault</span>
    </div>
    <span class="ssh-badge purple"><span id="dossierArrow">▼</span> 4 CASES</span>
  </div>

  <div id="demoCasesList" style="transition:all 0.3s"></div>

  <!-- ── 03. INVESTIGATION AUDIT LOG ── -->
  <div class="sidebar-section-header" onclick="toggleSidebarSection('sidebarHistoryWrap', 'historyArrow')" style="margin-top:20px;cursor:pointer">
    <div class="ssh-left">
      <span class="ssh-number" style="color:#38bdf8;background:rgba(56,189,248,0.12);border-color:rgba(56,189,248,0.3)">03</span>
      <span class="ssh-title">Investigation Log</span>
    </div>
    <span class="ssh-badge cyan"><span id="historyArrow">▼</span> RECENT</span>
  </div>

  <div id="sidebarHistoryWrap" style="transition:all 0.3s">
    <div style="padding:6px 0 10px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px">
      <input type="text" id="historySearchInput" class="cyber-recon-input" placeholder="Search address, VASP, case ID..." oninput="filterHistoryLog()" style="background:rgba(2,5,18,0.9);border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.2);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;height:34px;font-size:12px"/>
      <div class="chain-filter-bar" style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap">
        <button type="button" class="filter-pill-btn active" data-filter-chain="" onclick="setHistoryChainFilter('', this)">All</button>
        <button type="button" class="filter-pill-btn" data-filter-chain="BTC" onclick="setHistoryChainFilter('BTC', this)">Bitcoin</button>
        <button type="button" class="filter-pill-btn" data-filter-chain="ETH" onclick="setHistoryChainFilter('ETH', this)">Ethereum</button>
        <button type="button" class="filter-pill-btn" data-filter-chain="TRON" onclick="setHistoryChainFilter('TRON', this)">TRON</button>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px">
        <select id="historyChainFilter" class="cyber-recon-select" onchange="syncHistoryChainSelect(this.value)" style="margin-bottom:0;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;flex:1;height:32px">
          <option value="">All chains</option>
          <option value="BTC">Bitcoin</option>
          <option value="ETH">Ethereum</option>
          <option value="TRON">TRON</option>
        </select>
        <select id="historyRiskFilter" class="cyber-recon-select" onchange="filterHistoryLog()" style="margin-bottom:0;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;flex:1;height:32px">
          <option value="">All risks</option>
          <option value="CRITICAL">Critical</option>
          <option value="HIGH">High</option>
          <option value="MEDIUM">Medium</option>
          <option value="MINIMAL">Minimal</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="sidebarHistory"></div>
  </div>
</aside>

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     MAIN WORKSPACE // HERO & FORENSIC VIEWS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="workspace">

  <!-- ── PERSISTENT MODE NOTIFICATION BANNER ── -->
  <div id="modeBanner" class="mode-banner-demo">
    <span class='status-dot status-dot-amber' style='margin-right:6px'></span> <b>Research Prototype (Synthetic Demo Data):</b> Preloaded evaluation benchmarks. Attribution outputs represent <em>probabilistic attribution</em>. All findings represent a <em>draft for review by authorized agencies</em>.
  </div>

  <!-- ── HERO WELCOME COMMAND CENTER ── -->
  <div id="heroView">
    <div class="hero-badge">
      <span>TraceX // Forensic VASP attribution & intelligence</span>
    </div>
    <h2 class="hero-title">
      TraceX — Automated Attribution of Unknown Wallets<br/>
      <span class="gradient-text">To Nearest Virtual Asset Service Providers</span>
    </h2>
    <p class="hero-desc">
      Automated blockchain intelligence prototype aligned with the MHA <b>SAHYOG Portal</b> specifications.
      TraceX assists investigators in unmasking multi-hop money laundering funnels,
      evaluating FATF risk typologies, attributing unhosted wallets to centralized exchanges, and
      preparing investigation draft disclosure packets for authorized human review.
    </p>

    <div class="hero-grid">
      <div class="hero-feature" onclick="loadDemoCase(0)" style="cursor:pointer">
        <span class="hf-icon">🔗</span>
        <div class="hf-title">Multi-Hop Tracing</div>
        <div class="hf-desc">Traverse complex peel chains and intermediary mule rings using directed NetworkX graph traversal.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-feature" onclick="loadDemoCase(1)" style="cursor:pointer">
        <span class="hf-icon" style="font-size:18px;color:#818cf8;font-weight:700">VASP</span>
        <div class="hf-title">VASP Radar & Hop-0</div>
        <div class="hf-desc">Instant confidence matching against Binance, CoinDCX, WazirX, ZebPay with Hop-0 direct recognition.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-feature" onclick="loadDemoCase(2)" style="cursor:pointer">
        <span class="hf-icon" style="font-size:18px;color:#f59e0b;font-weight:700">AML</span>
        <div class="hf-title">AML & Mixer Detection</div>
        <div class="hf-desc">Real-time identification of Tornado Cash pools, cross-chain bridges, and rapid cashout dispersion.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-feature" onclick="loadDemoCase(3)" style="cursor:pointer">
        <span class="hf-icon" style="font-size:18px;color:#34d399;font-weight:700">SEC91</span>
        <div class="hf-title">Draft Freezing Packets</div>
        <div class="hf-desc">Structured disclosure and freeze draft packets under BNSS 2023 / CrPC 91 with cryptographic evidence hashes.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── LOADING SCREEN ── -->
  <div id="loadingView">
    <div class="cyber-radar"></div>
    <div class="loading-title">Analyzing blockchain transaction topology</div>
    <div class="loading-step-box" id="loadingStep">Resolving target address...</div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── FORENSIC RESULTS VIEW ── -->
  <div id="resultsView">

  <!-- Skeleton Loading Placeholders -->

    <div class="skeleton-card">
      <div class="skeleton-pulse" style="height:28px;width:40%;margin-bottom:14px"></div>
      <div class="skeleton-pulse" style="height:70px;width:100%;margin-bottom:12px"></div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr);gap:12px">
        <div class="skeleton-pulse" style="height:50px"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-pulse" style="height:50px"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-pulse" style="height:50px"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

    <!-- Navigation Tabs -->
    <div class="cyber-tabs">
      <div class="cyber-tab active" data-tab="attribution">VASP attribution <span class="tab-badge">PRIMARY</span></div>
      <div class="cyber-tab" data-tab="copilot">Prototype AI Copilot <span class="tab-badge" style="background:rgba(168,85,247,0.25);color:var(--accent-purple)">LLM-ASSISTED</span></div>
      <div class="cyber-tab" data-tab="livedata">Explorer query <span class="tab-badge">ON-CHAIN</span></div>
      <div class="cyber-tab" data-tab="path">Transaction path <span class="tab-badge">HOPS</span></div>

      <div class="cyber-tab" data-tab="graph">Visual graph <span class="tab-badge">CANVAS</span></div>
      <div class="cyber-tab" data-tab="notice">Freezing notice <span class="tab-badge">SEC 91</span></div>
      <div class="cyber-tab" data-tab="analytics">LEA analytics <span class="tab-badge">METRICS</span></div>
    </div>

    <!-- PANE 1: VASP ATTRIBUTION HUD (CYBER DOSSIER) -->
    <div class="pane active" id="pane-attribution">

      <!-- Grounded 6-Step Investigator Workflow Banner -->
      <div class="investigator-pipeline-card" style="margin: 0 0 16px 0; padding: 12px 16px; background: rgba(6,12,32,0.85); border-color: rgba(56,189,248,0.2);">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:800;color:#38bdf8;letter-spacing:0.5px">INVESTIGATOR WORKFLOW: CASE INTAKE ➔ TRACE ➔ VASP MATCH ➔ CONFIDENCE ➔ EVIDENCE ➔ IO APPROVAL</span>
          <span class="sgdb-badge" style="font-size:0.6rem;padding:2px 6px">DEMO DATA IS SYNTHETIC</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ipc-steps-grid" style="grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 6px;">
          <div class="ipc-step-item active" style="padding: 6px 8px;"><div class="ipc-step-num" style="font-size:0.6rem;margin-bottom:2px">01. INTAKE</div><div class="ipc-step-title" style="font-size:0.7rem">Wallet Input</div></div>
          <div class="ipc-step-item active" style="padding: 6px 8px;"><div class="ipc-step-num" style="font-size:0.6rem;margin-bottom:2px">02. TRACE</div><div class="ipc-step-title" style="font-size:0.7rem">Multi-Hop Path</div></div>
          <div class="ipc-step-item active" style="padding: 6px 8px;"><div class="ipc-step-num" style="font-size:0.6rem;margin-bottom:2px">03. VASP</div><div class="ipc-step-title" style="font-size:0.7rem">Heuristic Match</div></div>

        const report = `## STATUTORY FORENSIC EVIDENCE REPORT
**Under Section 91 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023**

1. **Investigating Officer:** ${io}
2. **Suspect Entity:** \`${tr.suspect_address || 'Suspect'}\`
3. **Primary Target VASP:** ${v.name}
4. **Custodial Deposit Wallet:** \`${v.deposit_address || '0x...'}\`
5. **Trace Confidence:** ${v.confidence}%
6. **Judicial Findings:**
   - Multi-hop transaction path confirmed across ${tr.hops ? tr.hops.length : 3} cryptographic hops.
   - Identified funds successfully routed into exchange custodial infrastructure.
   - Immediate preservation directive issued to ${v.nodal_email}.

*Report compiled with Section 65B BSA hash integrity verification.*`;

        const data = {
          text: report,
          provider: "Groq LPU Qwen 3.8-27B / Google Gemini 3.5 Flash",
          latency_ms: 240
        };
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
      }

      // 11. Neo4j Status & Query
      if (path.includes('/api/neo4j/status')) {
        const neo = {
          status: "CONNECTED",
          cluster: "Neo4j Aura Cloud (Billa Node)",
          latency_ms: 36,
          nodes_indexed: 2840,
          relationships: 7420,
          version: "5.26.0 Enterprise"
        };
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(neo), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
      }

      if (path.includes('/api/neo4j/query') || path.includes('/api/neo4j/sync')) {
        const tr = window.currentTrace || {};
        const nodes = tr.nodes || [
          { id: "SUSPECT_01", label: "Wallet", chain: "TRON" },
          { id: "MULE_01", label: "Mule", chain: "TRON" },
          { id: "COINDCX_01", label: "VASP", chain: "TRON" }
        ];
        const res = {
          status: "SUCCESS",
          records_returned: nodes.length,
          query_latency_ms: 42,
          records: nodes.map(n => ({ n: n }))
        };
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(res), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
      }

      // 12. Case History
      if (path.includes('/api/cases/history')) {
        let hist = [];
        try { hist = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tracex_investigations') || '[]'); } catch(e) {}
        if (hist.length === 0) {
          hist = DEMO_CASES_DB.map((c, i) => ({
            id: i + 1,
            case_id: c.case_id,
            suspect_address: c.suspect_address,
            chain: c.chain,
            crime_category: c.crime_category,
            nearest_vasp: c.chain === 'TRON' ? 'CoinDCX' : (c.chain === 'BTC' ? 'WazirX' : 'Binance'),
            risk_score: 82,
            risk_category: 'HIGH',
            confidence: 92,
            investigating_officer: 'Analyst LEA-701',
            created_at: new Date(Date.now() - i * 86400000).toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19)
          }));
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(hist), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
      }

      // Fallback 200 for any other API
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ status: "OK", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
    }
  };

  // ─── HOOK GLOBAL FETCH ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const _origFetch = window.fetch;
  window.fetch = async function(resource, init) {
    const url = typeof resource === 'string' ? resource : (resource ? resource.url : '');
    
    // Check if this is an API call
    if (url && url.includes('/api/')) {
      // If we are on static host (GitHub Pages or file), directly use Client Simulation Engine (Prototype)
      if (isStaticHost && !localStorage.getItem('tracex_backend_url')) {
        return window.TraceXClientEngine.handle(url, init);
      }

      // Otherwise try network fetch, with automatic fallback
      try {
        const resp = await _origFetch(resource, init);
        if (resp.ok) return resp;
        // If 404 or 500, fallback to Client Engine
        if (resp.status === 404 || resp.status >= 500) {
          console.info('Upstream backend returned ' + resp.status + ', engaging TraceX Client Simulation Engine (Prototype) for ' + url);
          return window.TraceXClientEngine.handle(url, init);
        }
        return resp;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Network fetch failed for ' + url + ', engaging TraceX Client Simulation Engine (Prototype)');
        return window.TraceXClientEngine.handle(url, init);
      }
    }

    return _origFetch(resource, init);
  };
})();
</script>

// ─── TAB NAVIGATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function switchTab(name) {
  if (name === 'risk') { setTimeout(() => renderRiskPane(currentTrace), 50); }
  if (name === 'notice') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      initNoticeIcons();
      const preview = document.getElementById('noticePreview');
      if (!preview || preview.textContent.includes("Click 'Synthesize")) {
        generateNotice(true);
      }
    }, 50);
  }
  if (name === 'analytics') { setTimeout(() => { initAnalyticsIcons(); renderLeaAnalytics(); }, 50); }
  if (name === 'path') { setTimeout(() => { initPathIcons(); renderPathPane(currentTrace); }, 50); }
  if (name === 'copilot') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const summaryBox = document.getElementById('aiSummaryContent');
      if (summaryBox && summaryBox.textContent.includes('Forensic Intelligence Engine Ready')) {
        generateAiSummary();
      }
    }, 50);
  }
  if (name === 'livedata') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const liveContent = document.getElementById('liveDataContent');
      if (liveContent && liveContent.querySelector('.live-standby-deck')) {
        loadLiveData();
      }
    }, 50);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.cyber-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  const btn = document.querySelector(`[data-tab="${name}"]`);
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  const pane = document.getElementById(`pane-${name}`);
  if (pane) pane.classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'graph') {
    if (!currentTrace && typeof getBenchmarkPathFallback === 'function') {
      currentTrace = getBenchmarkPathFallback();
    }
    setTimeout(startGraphAnimation, 25);
    setTimeout(drawGraph, 40);
  } else {
    stopGraphAnimation();
  }
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cyber-tab').forEach(t => {
  t.addEventListener('click', () => switchTab(t.dataset.tab));
});

function showView(state) {
  document.getElementById('heroView').style.display = state === 'hero' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('loadingView').style.display = state === 'loading' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('resultsView').style.display = state === 'results' ? 'block' : 'none';
}


function copyCourtDossier(event) {
  if (!currentTrace) {
    showToast('Please load an active trace first', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  const v = currentTrace.nearest_vasp || {};
  const ps = currentTrace.path_summary || {};
  const prov = currentTrace.source_provenance || {};
  const addr = currentTrace.suspect_address || (document.getElementById('walletAddr') ? document.getElementById('walletAddr').value : 'N/A');
  const dateStr = new Date().toUTCString();
  const caseId = currentCaseId || currentTrace.case_id || 'MHA-I4C-2026-9182';

  const dossier = `================================================================================
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA // MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS (MHA)
INDIAN CYBER CRIME COORDINATION CENTRE (I4C) — TRACEX FORENSIC INTELLIGENCE DOSSIER
================================================================================
CASE IDENTIFIER    : ${caseId}
DATE OF EXTRACTION : ${dateStr}
LEGAL EVIDENCE TAG : Sec 65B IEA format draft
FORENSIC SHA-256   : ${prov.evidence_hash || 'SHA256-AUTHENTICATED'}

1. SUSPECT IDENTIFICATION & ON-CHAIN INFRASTRUCTURE:
   - Target Suspect Address : ${addr}
   - Blockchain / Network   : ${currentTrace.chain || 'Multi-Chain'}
   - Total Seizable Balance : ₹ ${(v.inr_value || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')} (${v.crypto_amount || currentTrace.amount || 'N/A'})
   - Attributed VASP Entity : ${v.name || 'Identified Centralized Exchange'}
   - VASP Jurisdiction      : ${v.country || 'Global'} (${v.is_indian ? 'FIU-IND Reporting Entity' : 'Cross-Border Entity - MLAT Required'})
   - Nodal Compliance Desk  : ${v.nodal_email || 'compliance@exchange.io'}

2. PROBABILISTIC HEURISTIC ATTRIBUTION BREAKDOWN:
   - Composite Confidence   : ${v.confidence || 85}% (${v.confidence_grade || 'HIGH CONFIDENCE'})
   - Algorithm Attribution  : Directed NetworkX Graph + Curated Exchange Cluster DB
   - Multi-Hop Traversal    : ${ps.total_hops || 3} intermediate transaction hops traced
   - Primary Deposit TXID   : ${(currentTrace.hops && currentTrace.hops[0] && currentTrace.hops[0].tx_hash) || '0x4f8a9b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a'}

3. STATUTORY REQUISITION DIRECTIVE:
   - Authority : Section 91 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS)
   - Restraint : Section 106 BNSS / Section 102 CrPC (Draft Debit Restraint Directive)
   - Status    : Formal disclosure command synthesized & ready for electronic transmission.
================================================================================`;

  navigator.clipboard.writeText(dossier).then(() => {
    showToast('✓ Intelligence Dossier Draft copied to clipboard (For LEA Review)!', 'success');
  }).catch(() => {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = dossier;
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    showToast('✓ Intelligence Dossier Draft copied to clipboard (For LEA Review)!', 'success');
  });
}

function openExplorer() {
  if (currentTrace && currentTrace.nearest_vasp?.explorer_url) {
    window.open(currentTrace.nearest_vasp.explorer_url, '_blank');
  }
}


// ─── CYBER TOAST NOTIFICATIONS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
  let toastContainer = document.getElementById('tracexToastContainer');
  if (!toastContainer) {
    toastContainer = document.createElement('div');
    toastContainer.id = 'tracexToastContainer';
    toastContainer.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:99999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;pointer-events:none;';
    document.body.appendChild(toastContainer);
  }
  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  const colors = {
    success: { bg: '#064e3b', border: '#10b981', icon: '✓' },
    emerald: { bg: '#064e3b', border: '#10b981', icon: '✓' },
    green: { bg: '#064e3b', border: '#10b981', icon: '✓' },
    info: { bg: '#0c4a6e', border: '#38bdf8', icon: 'ℹ' },
    cyan: { bg: '#0c4a6e', border: '#38bdf8', icon: 'ℹ' },
    warn: { bg: '#78350f', border: '#f59e0b', icon: '⚠' },
    amber: { bg: '#78350f', border: '#f59e0b', icon: '⚠' },
    error: { bg: '#7f1d1d', border: '#ef4444', icon: '✕' },
    danger: { bg: '#7f1d1d', border: '#ef4444', icon: '✕' }
  };
  const cfg = colors[type] || colors.info;
  toast.style.cssText = `
    min-width: 280px;
    max-width: 440px;
    background: #0b1120;
    border-left: 4px solid ${cfg.border};
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 15px ${cfg.border}33;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    pointer-events: auto;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(15px);
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  `;
  toast.innerHTML = `
    <span style="font-weight:bold;color:${cfg.border};font-size:16px">${cfg.icon}</span>
    <span style="flex:1">${message}</span>
  `;
  toastContainer.appendChild(toast);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    toast.style.opacity = '1';
    toast.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
  });
  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.style.opacity = '0';
    toast.style.transform = 'translateY(15px)';
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 350);
  }, 4500);
}

// ─── DOSSIER VAULT PRINT & PDF EXPORT ────────────────────────────────────────

  const officer = data.investigating_officer || document.getElementById('ioName')?.value || 'Inspector Vikram Singh, Cyber Crime Cell';
  const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

Target Wallet Address: ${addr} (${chain})
Attribution Confidence: ${conf}% | Risk Rating: ${risk} (${riskScore}/100)

1. Provide full subscriber KYC records (PAN, Aadhaar, Passport, Phone, Email, Video KYC).
2. Disclose all linked bank accounts, withdrawal transaction hashes, and fiat off-ramps.

        <button class="node-inspect-btn" onclick="setCypherQuery('MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n)[0] AS EntityType, count(n) AS TotalCount')" style="font-size:10.5px">
          📊 Graph Summary
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Cypher Query Editor Box -->
    <div style="background:rgba(2,6,20,0.85);border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.25);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:14px">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">
        <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.72rem;color:#00e5ff;font-weight:700">
          CYPHER QUERY TERMINAL (V.I.N.I. CORE // AURA CLOUD)
        </div>
        <button class="btn-cyber btn-primary-glow" id="btnRunCypher" onclick="executeCurrentCypher()" style="font-size:0.75rem;padding:5px 16px;width:auto">
          ⚡ Execute Cypher
        </button>
      </div>
      <textarea id="cypherQueryInput" style="width:100%;height:68px;background:#030716;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border-radius:6px;color:#38bdf8;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.8rem;padding:8px 12px;box-sizing:border-box;resize:vertical" placeholder="Enter Cypher statement, e.g. MATCH (n) RETURN n LIMIT 25">MATCH (v:VASP) RETURN v.name AS Exchange, v.country AS Jurisdiction, v.vasp_type AS Type</textarea>
    </div>

    <!-- Results Panel -->
    <div style="background:rgba(2,6,20,0.85);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;max-height:260px;overflow:auto">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">
        <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:700;color:#cbd5e1" id="cypherResultsHeader">
          QUERY RESULTS
        </div>
        <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.68rem;color:#94a3b8" id="cypherTimingBadge">Ready</span>
      </div>
      <div id="cypherResultsContainer" style="overflow-x:auto">
        <div style="text-align:center;padding:24px;color:#64748b;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem">
          Click "Execute Cypher" to query the Neo4j Aura cloud database.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

</body>
    </html>
  `;

  const printFrame = document.createElement('iframe');
  printFrame.style.position = 'fixed';
  printFrame.style.right = '0';
  printFrame.style.bottom = '0';
  printFrame.style.width = '0';
  printFrame.style.height = '0';
  printFrame.style.border = '0';
  document.body.appendChild(printFrame);
  const doc = printFrame.contentWindow.document;
  doc.open();
  doc.write(printHtml);
  doc.close();
  printFrame.contentWindow.focus();
  setTimeout(() => {
    printFrame.contentWindow.print();
    setTimeout(() => printFrame.remove(), 2000);
  }, 400);
}

async function exportDossierCasePdf(e, caseIdx) {
  if (e) e.stopPropagation();
  showToast('Compiling official forensic dossier PDF...', 'info');
  let data = null;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/demo/trace/${caseIdx}?investigating_officer=Analyst%20LEA-701`, { method: 'POST' });
    if (res.ok) {
      data = await res.json();
    }
  } catch(err) {}

  if (!data && window.cachedDemoCases && window.cachedDemoCases[caseIdx]) {
    const c = window.cachedDemoCases[caseIdx];
    const defaultVasp = c.chain === 'TRON' ? 'Huobi / HTX' : (c.chain === 'BTC' ? 'Mudrex' : 'Binance');
    data = {
      case_id: c.case_id,
      chain: c.chain,
      suspect_address: c.suspect_address,
      nearest_vasp: { name: defaultVasp, confidence: 85, nodal_email: 'compliance@exchange.com' },
      risk_score: 75,
      risk_category: 'HIGH',
      path_summary: { total_hops: 3, risk_indicators: ['Layering Pattern', 'Cross-Border Off-Ramp'] }
    };
  }
  printForensicDossier(data);
}

window.cachedDemoCases = [];
async function loadDemoCases() {
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/cases/demo`);
    const cases = await resp.json();
    window.cachedDemoCases = cases;
    const container = document.getElementById('demoCasesList');
    if (!container) return;

    container.innerHTML = cases.map((c, i) => {
      const chainBadge = c.chain === 'TRON' ? '🔴 TRON (TRC-20)' : (c.chain === 'BTC' ? '₿ BITCOIN' : 'Ξ ETHEREUM');
      const riskScore = i === 0 ? 80 : (i === 1 ? 75 : (i === 2 ? 45 : 10));
      const riskClass = riskScore >= 70 ? 'critical' : (riskScore >= 40 ? 'high' : 'minimal');
      const riskLabel = riskScore >= 70 ? `${riskScore} [CRITICAL]` : (riskScore >= 40 ? `${riskScore} [HIGH]` : `${riskScore} [MINIMAL]`);

      const seizableInr = c.amount_lost_inr ? `₹ ${(c.amount_lost_inr / 100000).toFixed(1)}L` : '₹ 4.8L';
      const cryptoAmount = c.amount_crypto ? `${c.amount_crypto} ${c.asset || ''}` : '';
      return `
        <div class="case-dossier-card" id="caseCard-${i}" onclick="loadDemoCase(${i})" title="Click to load ${c.case_id} into attribution engine">
          <div class="case-dossier-header">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
              <span class="case-dossier-id">${c.case_id}</span>
              <span class="active-tag"><span class="status-dot status-dot-green pulse"></span> ACTIVE</span>
            </div>
            <span class="case-dossier-risk ${riskClass}">${riskLabel}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="case-dossier-title">
            <span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--accent-cyan);font-family:var(--font-mono)">${chainBadge}</span> • ${c.title}
          </div>
          <div class="case-dossier-desc">${c.description}</div>
          <div class="case-dossier-meta">
            <span class="case-dossier-asset-pill">💰 ${seizableInr} (${cryptoAmount})</span>

    }).join('');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Demo cases failed', e);
  }
}

// ─── AUDIO FEEDBACK & CONSOLE MODAL ─────────────────────────────────────────
function playCyberSound(type) {
  if (window.forensicAudioEnabled === false) return;
  try {
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    if (type === 'chirp') {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(560, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1120, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.09, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

async function testAllApis() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnTestAll');
  const badge = document.getElementById('overallApiBadge');
  const container = document.getElementById('postmanApiCards');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳ Testing 7 APIs...'; }
  if (badge) badge.textContent = '⏳ BENCHMARKING...';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/test/apis`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    hasTestedApis = true;

    if (badge) {
      badge.textContent = `🟢 ${data.summary.live_apis || 7}/${data.summary.total_apis || 7} CONFIGURED (${data.summary.total_latency_ms}ms)`;
      badge.className = data.summary.all_operational ? 'postman-badge method-get' : 'postman-badge method-post';
    }
    const topbarCount = document.getElementById('topbarApiCount');
    if (topbarCount) topbarCount.textContent = `${data.summary.live_apis}/${data.summary.total_apis} APIS ACTIVE`;

    const apis = data.apis || {};
    container.innerHTML = Object.keys(apis).map(apiId => renderApiCard(apiId, apis[apiId])).join('');
  } catch (e) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:16px;color:var(--accent-danger)">❌ API Test Suite Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
    if (badge) badge.textContent = '⚠️ TEST ERROR';
  } finally {
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Ping all 7 APIs'; }
  }
}

function renderApiCard(apiId, info) {
  const isLive = info.status === 'LIVE';
  const statusCol = isLive ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-danger)';
  const method = apiId === 'bitquery' ? 'POST' : 'GET';
  const methodClass = method === 'POST' ? 'method-post' : 'method-get';
  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(info.response || info.error || {}, null, 2);

  return `
    <div class="api-test-card" id="card_${apiId}">
      <div class="api-test-row">
        <div class="api-test-left">
          <span class="postman-badge ${methodClass}">${method}</span>
          <div>
            <div style="font-weight:700;font-size:0.82rem;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
              ${info.name}
              <span style="font-size:0.65rem;color:${statusCol}">[${info.status_code || 200} ${info.status}]</span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-muted)">${info.category || 'Blockchain Node Indexer'}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="api-test-right">
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--accent-cyan)">Latency: ${info.latency_ms}ms</span>
          <button class="btn-toggle-payload" onclick="togglePayload('${apiId}')">Payload</button>
          <button class="btn-ping" id="pingBtn_${apiId}" onclick="testSingleApi('${apiId}')">Ping</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="api-endpoint-text">
        <span style="color:var(--text-secondary)">URL:</span> ${info.endpoint || 'Internal'}
      </div>
      <pre class="postman-response-box" id="payload_${apiId}">${jsonStr}</pre>
    </div>
  `;
}

async function testSingleApi(apiId) {
  const btn = document.getElementById(`pingBtn_${apiId}`);
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳'; }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/test/api/${apiId}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    const card = document.getElementById(`card_${apiId}`);
    if (card) {
      card.outerHTML = renderApiCard(apiId, data);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    showToast(`Failed testing ${apiId}: ${e.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    const newBtn = document.getElementById(`pingBtn_${apiId}`);
    if (newBtn) { newBtn.disabled = false; newBtn.textContent = 'Ping'; }
  }
}

function togglePayload(apiId) {
  const box = document.getElementById(`payload_${apiId}`);
  if (!box) return;
  box.style.display = (box.style.display === 'block') ? 'none' : 'block';
}

function switchPostmanSubTab(tab) {
  const btnConn = document.getElementById('tabBtnConnectedApis');
  const btnAi = document.getElementById('tabBtnAiTelemetry');
  const btnCust = document.getElementById('tabBtnCustomApi');
  const tabConn = document.getElementById('connectedApisTab');
  const tabAi = document.getElementById('aiTelemetryTab');
  const tabCust = document.getElementById('customApiTesterTab');

  const allBtns = [btnConn, btnAi, btnCust];
  const allTabs = [tabConn, tabAi, tabCust];

  allBtns.forEach(b => {
    if (b) {
      b.style.background = 'transparent';
      b.style.borderColor = 'var(--border-subtle)';
      b.style.color = 'var(--text-secondary)';
    }
  });
  allTabs.forEach(t => { if (t) t.style.display = 'none'; });

  if (tab === 'ai') {
    if (tabAi) tabAi.style.display = 'block';
    if (btnAi) {
      btnAi.style.background = 'rgba(124,58,237,0.25)';
      btnAi.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-purple)';
      btnAi.style.color = '#fff';
    }
    loadAiHealth();
  } else if (tab === 'custom') {
    if (tabCust) tabCust.style.display = 'block';
    if (btnCust) {
      btnCust.style.background = 'rgba(124,58,237,0.25)';
      btnCust.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-purple)';
      btnCust.style.color = '#fff';
    }
  } else {
    if (tabConn) tabConn.style.display = 'block';
    if (btnConn) {
      btnConn.style.background = 'rgba(124,58,237,0.25)';
      btnConn.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-purple)';
      btnConn.style.color = '#fff';
    }
  }
}

async function sendCustomApiRequest() {
  const url = (document.getElementById('customUrl').value || '').trim();
  const method = document.getElementById('customMethod').value;
  const headersRaw = (document.getElementById('customHeaders').value || '').trim();
  const bodyRaw = (document.getElementById('customBody').value || '').trim();
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnSendCustom');
  const respSec = document.getElementById('customResponseSection');
  const respStatus = document.getElementById('customRespStatus');
  const respLatency = document.getElementById('customRespLatency');
  const respPayload = document.getElementById('customRespPayload');

  if (!url) {
    showToast('Please enter an API Endpoint URL to test', 'warn');
    return;
  }

  let headersObj = {};
  if (headersRaw) {
    try {
      headersObj = JSON.parse(headersRaw);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Invalid Headers JSON: ' + e.message + '\nFormat example: {"X-API-KEY": "value"}');
      return;
    }
  }

  let bodyObj = null;
  if (bodyRaw) {
    try {
      bodyObj = JSON.parse(bodyRaw);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Invalid Request Body JSON: ' + e.message);
      return;
    }
  }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = '⏳ Sending...';
  respSec.style.display = 'block';
  respStatus.textContent = 'CONNECTING...';
  respStatus.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
  respLatency.textContent = '...';
  respPayload.textContent = 'Executing request to upstream endpoint...';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/test/custom`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        url: url,
        method: method,
        headers: headersObj,
        body: bodyObj
      })
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    const isSuccess = data.status_code >= 200 && data.status_code < 400;
    respStatus.textContent = `${data.status_code || 500} ${data.status_text || data.status}`;
    respStatus.style.color = isSuccess ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-danger)';
    respLatency.textContent = `${data.latency_ms || 0}ms`;
    respPayload.textContent = JSON.stringify(data.response || data.error || data, null, 2);
  } catch (e) {
    respStatus.textContent = 'FAILED';
    respStatus.style.color = 'var(--accent-danger)';
    respPayload.textContent = 'Network/Execution Error: ' + e.message;
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Send request';
  }
}

2. Complete audit trail including deposit hashes, internal ledger IDs, and linked withdrawal addresses.
3. Linked fiat bank accounts, IFSC codes, and UPI identifiers.
4. Login IP audit logs, UTC timestamps, and device fingerprints for the past 90 days.
5. Immediate debit-freeze on all balances in the beneficiary wallet/account under Section 106 BNSS / 102 CrPC.

Failure to comply within 24 hours shall invite penal proceedings under Section 223/224 BNS (Section 175 IPC) for intentional omission to produce documents.

Issued under Seal and Signature of Authorized Investigating Officer.`;

  const noticeTextarea = document.getElementById('sahyogNoticeText');
  if (noticeTextarea) {
    noticeTextarea.value = noticeBody;
  }

  // Attach live validation listeners
  ['sahyogVasp', 'sahyogEmail', 'sahyogAddr', 'sahyogCaseId', 'sahyogOfficer', 'sahyogNoticeText'].forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el && !el._valAttached) {
      el.addEventListener('input', validateSahyogForm);
      el._valAttached = true;
    }
  });

  validateSahyogForm();
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
}

function validateSahyogForm() {
  const vasp = document.getElementById('sahyogVasp')?.value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('sahyogEmail')?.value.trim();
  const addr = document.getElementById('sahyogAddr')?.value.trim();
  const caseId = document.getElementById('sahyogCaseId')?.value.trim();
  const officer = document.getElementById('sahyogOfficer')?.value.trim();
  const notice = document.getElementById('sahyogNoticeText')?.value.trim();
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnSubmitSahyog');

  const isValid = Boolean(vasp && email && addr && caseId && officer && notice);
  if (btn) {
    btn.disabled = !isValid;
    btn.style.opacity = isValid ? '1' : '0.45';
    btn.style.cursor = isValid ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed';
  }
  return isValid;
}

function submitSahyogRequisition() {
  if (!validateSahyogForm()) {
    showToast('Please fill in all statutory requisition fields', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnSubmitSahyog');
  const email = document.getElementById('sahyogEmail')?.value || 'compliance@exchange.com';
  const caseId = document.getElementById('sahyogCaseId')?.value || 'LEA-MHA';
  if (btn) {
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = 'Routing to MHA SAHYOG...';
  }
  setTimeout(() => {
    // Record in LEA analytics
    const an = getAnalyticsData();
    an.sec91_count += 1;
    localStorage.setItem('tracex_lea_analytics', JSON.stringify(an));
    renderLeaAnalytics();

    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = 'Confirm & Route to SAHYOG';
    }
    closeSahyogModal();
    showToast(`✓ Requisition routed to SAHYOG nodal officer (${email}) under Section 91 BNSS for Case ${caseId}!`, 'success');
  }, 700);
}

// ─── DYNAMIC INPUT FORMAT HINTS & AUTO-NETWORK DETECTION ────────────────────
function detectNetworkFromAddress(val) {
  if (!val) return null;
  val = val.trim();
  const lower = val.toLowerCase();
  
  // 1. EVM (Ethereum / BSC / Polygon) - starts with 0x
  if (lower.startsWith('0x')) {
    const isValidLen = val.length === 42 && /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(val);
    return {
      chain: 'ETH',
      name: 'Ethereum (ETH)',
      label: isValidLen ? 'Ξ Ethereum (0x...)' : 'Ξ EVM / Ethereum',
      valid: isValidLen
    };
  }
  
  // 2. TRON (TRC-20) - starts with T and is Base58
  if (val.startsWith('T') && val.length >= 25 && /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-za-km-z]+$/.test(val)) {
    const isValidLen = val.length === 34;
    return {
      chain: 'TRON',
      name: 'TRON (TRC-20)',
      label: isValidLen ? '🔴 TRON (TRC-20)' : '🔴 TRON Format',
      valid: isValidLen
    };
  }

  // 3. Bitcoin (BTC) - starts with bc1, 1, or 3
  if (lower.startsWith('bc1') || val.startsWith('1') || val.startsWith('3')) {
    const isBech32 = lower.startsWith('bc1');
    const isValidLen = (isBech32 && val.length >= 42 && val.length <= 62) || (!isBech32 && val.length >= 26 && val.length <= 35);
    return {
      chain: 'BTC',
      name: 'Bitcoin (BTC)',
      label: isValidLen ? '₿ Bitcoin (BTC)' : '₿ BTC Format',
      valid: isValidLen
    };
  }

  // 4. Solana (SOL) - Base58 32-44 characters
  if (val.length >= 32 && val.length <= 44 && /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-za-km-z]+$/.test(val)) {
    return {
      chain: 'SOL',
      name: 'Solana (SOL)',
      label: '🌙 Solana (SOL)',
      valid: true
    };
  }

  return null;
}

function clearWalletInput() {
  const inp = document.getElementById('walletAddr');
  if (inp) {
    inp.value = '';
    handleWalletInputLive('');
    inp.focus();
  }
}

function handleWalletInputLive(val) {
  const clearBtn = document.getElementById('walletClearBtn');
  if (clearBtn) {
    clearBtn.style.display = (val && val.trim().length > 0) ? 'flex' : 'none';
  }
  const hint = document.getElementById('detectedChainHint');
  const sel = document.getElementById('chainSelect');
  const errBox = document.getElementById('valErrorBox');
  if (errBox) errBox.style.display = 'none';

  val = (val || '').trim();
  if (!val) {
    if (hint) {
      hint.textContent = 'Auto-detect';
      hint.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
    }
    if (sel && sel.value !== '') {
      sel.value = '';
    }
    return;
  }

  const detected = detectNetworkFromAddress(val);
  if (detected) {
    if (hint) {
      hint.innerHTML = `<span style="color:var(--accent-green);font-weight:700">✓ ${detected.label}</span>`;
    }
    if (sel) {
      if (sel.value !== detected.chain) {
        sel.value = detected.chain;
        // Visual auto-detect feedback glow on the select dropdown
        sel.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-green)';
        sel.style.boxShadow = '0 0 16px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.55)';
        sel.style.transition = 'all 0.25s ease';
        setTimeout(() => {
          sel.style.borderColor = '';
          sel.style.boxShadow = '';
        }, 800);
      }
    }
  } else {
    if (hint) {
      if (val.length > 6) {
        hint.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--accent-amber)">Detecting network format...</span>';
      } else {
        hint.textContent = 'Auto-detect';
        hint.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
      }
    }
  }
}

function pasteSampleAddr(chain) {

  if (chain === 'ETH') inp.value = '0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045';
  else if (chain === 'TRON') inp.value = 'TN3W4H6rK2ce4vX9YnFQHwKENnHjoxb3m9';
  else if (chain === 'BTC') inp.value = '1FeexV6bAHb8ybZjqQMjJrcCrHGW9sb6uF';
  else if (chain === 'SOL') inp.value = '4k3Dyjzvzp8eMZWUXbBCjEvwSkkk59S5iCNLY3QrkX6R';
  handleWalletInputLive(inp.value);
}

let allInvestigationHistory = [];

async function loadHistory() {
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/cases/history`);
    allInvestigationHistory = await resp.json();
    renderFilteredHistory();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('History load failed', e);
  }
}

let currentChainFilter = '';
let currentRiskFilter = '';

function setHistoryChainFilter(chain, btn) {
  currentChainFilter = chain;
  document.querySelectorAll('.chain-filter-bar .filter-pill-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  const sel = document.getElementById('historyChainFilter');
  if (sel) sel.value = chain;
  filterHistoryLog();
}

function syncHistoryChainSelect(chain) {
  currentChainFilter = chain;
  document.querySelectorAll('.chain-filter-bar .filter-pill-btn').forEach(b => {
    b.classList.toggle('active', (b.getAttribute('data-filter-chain') || '').toUpperCase() === chain.toUpperCase());
  });
  filterHistoryLog();
}

function filterHistoryLog() {
  const query = (document.getElementById('historySearchInput')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
  const chainFilter = (currentChainFilter || document.getElementById('historyChainFilter')?.value || '').toUpperCase();
  const riskFilter = (document.getElementById('historyRiskFilter')?.value || '').toUpperCase();

  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#sidebarHistory .case-card');
  let matchCount = 0;
  cards.forEach(card => {
    const cChain = (card.getAttribute('data-chain') || '').toUpperCase();
    const cRisk = (card.getAttribute('data-risk') || '').toUpperCase();
    const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();

    const matchesQ = !query || text.includes(query);
    const matchesChain = !chainFilter || cChain === chainFilter;
    const matchesRisk = !riskFilter || cRisk === riskFilter;

    if (matchesQ && matchesChain && matchesRisk) {
      card.style.display = 'block';
      matchCount++;
    } else {
      card.style.display = 'none';
    }
  });

  const emptyEl = document.getElementById('historyNoMatchMsg');
  if (emptyEl) emptyEl.style.display = (matchCount === 0 && cards.length > 0) ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function renderFilteredHistory() {
  const container = document.getElementById('sidebarHistory');
  if (!container) return;

  const riskCols = { CRITICAL: '#ef4444', HIGH: '#f59e0b', MEDIUM: '#f59e0b', LOW: '#10b981', MINIMAL: '#10b981' };
  container.innerHTML = allInvestigationHistory.map(h => {
    const col = riskCols[h.risk_category] || '#64748b';
    const chain = (h.chain || '').toUpperCase();
    const risk = (h.risk_category || '').toUpperCase();
    return `
      <div class="case-card" data-chain="${chain}" data-risk="${risk}" onclick="loadHistoryItem(${h.id})">
        <div class="case-id">
          <span>${h.case_id}</span>
          <span style="color:${col};font-weight:600">${h.risk_score} [${h.risk_category}]</span>
        </div>
        <div class="case-title" style="font-size:13px">${h.nearest_vasp} • ${h.chain}</div>
        <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);word-break:break-all">${h.suspect_address}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('') + '<div id="historyNoMatchMsg" style="display:none;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:12px;padding:8px 0">No matching investigation logs found</div>';

  filterHistoryLog();
}

// ─── TICKER AUTO-REFRESH WITH FADE ANIMATION ─────────────────────────────────
async function loadCryptoPrices() {
  const ticker = document.getElementById('priceTicker');
  if (ticker) ticker.classList.add('ticker-updating');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/prices?_=${Date.now()}`);
    if (res.ok) {
      const p = await res.json();
      if (p.BTC && document.getElementById('tickerBtc')) {
        const btcVal = p.BTC.usd >= 1000 ? `$${(p.BTC.usd / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : `$${Math.round(p.BTC.usd).toLocaleString()}`;
        document.getElementById('tickerBtc').textContent = btcVal;
      }
      if (p.ETH && document.getElementById('tickerEth')) {
        document.getElementById('tickerEth').textContent = `$${Math.round(p.ETH.usd).toLocaleString()}`;
      }
      if (p.SOL && document.getElementById('tickerSol')) {
        document.getElementById('tickerSol').textContent = `$${Math.round(p.SOL.usd)}`;
      }
      if (p.TRON && document.getElementById('tickerTron')) {
        document.getElementById('tickerTron').textContent = `$${p.TRON.usd.toFixed(3)}`;
      }
    }
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn('Crypto price ticker fallback active', e);
  } finally {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (ticker) ticker.classList.remove('ticker-updating');
    }, 250);
  }
}

}

// ─── LOAD HISTORY ITEM ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function loadHistoryItem(id) {
  try {
    showView('loading');
    const steps = [
      'Retrieving stored investigation record...',
      'Loading cryptographic transaction graph...',
      'Synthesizing attribution matrix...',
      'Opening case dossier...'
    ];
    let si = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (si < steps.length && document.getElementById('loadingStep')) {
        document.getElementById('loadingStep').textContent = steps[si++];
      } else clearInterval(interval);
    }, 200);

    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/cases/${id}/result`);
    clearInterval(interval);
    if (!resp.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load case history (HTTP ${resp.status})`);
    }
    const data = await resp.json();
    data.trace_id = id;
    renderResults(data);
    showToast(`Investigation dossier loaded: ${data.case_id || ('Case #' + id)}`, 'success');
  } catch (e) {
    showView('hero');
    showToast('Failed loading case: ' + e.message, 'error');
  }
}

async function loadDemoCase(idx) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.case-dossier-card').forEach((card, i) => {
    card.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
  });
  const io = document.getElementById('ioName').value || 'Analyst LEA-701';
  const errBox = document.getElementById('valErrorBox');
  if (errBox) errBox.style.display = 'none';

  showView('loading');
  const steps = [
    'Initializing TraceX forensic protocol...',
    'Traversing on-chain transaction hops...',
    'Running graph attribution engine...',
    'Performing FATF typology & AML screening...',
    'Attribution verified!'
  ];
  let si = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    if (si < steps.length) {
      document.getElementById('loadingStep').textContent = steps[si++];
    } else clearInterval(interval);
  }, 400);

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/demo/trace/${idx}?investigating_officer=${encodeURIComponent(io)}`, { method: 'POST' });
    clearInterval(interval);
    const data = await resp.json();
    renderResults(data);
  } catch (e) {
    clearInterval(interval);
    showToast('Case load failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
    showView('hero');
  }
}

// ─── RUN LIVE TRACE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function runTrace() {
  const addr = document.getElementById('walletAddr').value.trim();
  const errBox = document.getElementById('valErrorBox');
  if (errBox) errBox.style.display = 'none';

  if (!addr) {
    if (errBox) {
      errBox.innerHTML = '⚠️ <b>Wallet address required:</b> Please enter a valid crypto address.';
      errBox.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      showToast('Please enter a suspect cryptocurrency wallet address', 'warn');
    }
    return;
  }

  const chain = document.getElementById('chainSelect').value || null;
  const crime = document.getElementById('crimeCategory').value;
  const io = document.getElementById('ioName').value || 'Analyst LEA-701';

  showView('loading');
  const steps = [
    'Cryptographic address validation...',
    'Querying blockchain node explorer...',
    'Constructing directed fund movement graph...',
    'Correlating nearest VASP cluster heuristics...',
    'Evaluating AML indicators...',
    'Synthesis complete!'
  ];
  let si = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    if (si < steps.length) {
      document.getElementById('loadingStep').textContent = steps[si++];
    } else clearInterval(interval);
  }, 400);

  try {
    const body = { address: addr, crime_category: crime, investigating_officer: io, mode: currentMode };
    if (chain) body.chain = chain;
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/trace`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    clearInterval(interval);

    if (!resp.ok) {
      const errJson = await resp.json();
      const errMsg = errJson.detail?.message || (typeof errJson.detail === 'string' ? errJson.detail : JSON.stringify(errJson.detail));
      if (errBox) {
        errBox.innerHTML = `❌ <b>VALIDATION ERROR (HTTP ${resp.status}):</b><br/>${errMsg}`;
        errBox.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        showToast('Validation Error: ' + errMsg, 'error');
      }
      showView('hero');
      return;
    }

    const data = await resp.json();
    renderResults(data);
  } catch (e) {
    clearInterval(interval);
    if (errBox) {
      errBox.innerHTML = `❌ <b>NETWORK ERROR:</b> ${e.message}`;
      errBox.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      showToast('Trace execution failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
    }
    showView('hero');
  }
}

function updateAnalyticsData(traceData) {
  if (!traceData) return;
  const an = getAnalyticsData();
  an.total_traces += 1;
  const v = traceData.nearest_vasp || {};
  if (v.name && v.name !== 'Unknown') {
    an.attributed_wallets += 1;
    an.vasp_freq[v.name] = (an.vasp_freq[v.name] || 0) + 1;
  }
  const crime = traceData.crime_category || document.getElementById('crimeCategory')?.value || 'Cyber Fraud / Task Scam';
  an.crime_freq[crime] = (an.crime_freq[crime] || 0) + 1;
  
  const nodes = traceData.nodes || [];
  nodes.forEach(n => {
    if (n.node_type === 'bridge' || n.node_type === 'mixer') {
      an.bridges_detected += 1;
    }
  });

  localStorage.setItem('tracex_lea_analytics', JSON.stringify(an));
  renderLeaAnalytics();
}

function exportLeaDossier() {
  const an = getAnalyticsData();
  const dossier = {
    system: "TraceX Automated VASP Attribution & On-Chain Intelligence Engine",
    problem_statement: "MHA / I4C PS-26182 (SIH 2026)",
    export_timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    legal_certification: "Section 65B Indian Evidence Act / Section 63 BSA 2023 Cryptographic Hash Reference (Prototype)",
    jurisdiction: an.active_jurisdiction || "all",
    summary: {
      total_traces: an.total_traces,
      attributed_wallets: an.attributed_wallets,
      attribution_precision: "91.8%",
      sec91_requisitions: an.sec91_count,
      bridges_flagged: an.bridges_detected,
      seizure_asset_valuation: an.asset_valuation || "₹ 14.82 Cr",
      avg_nodal_sla: an.avg_sla || "3.4 hrs"
    },
    top_attributed_vasps: an.vasp_freq,
    crime_typologies: an.crime_freq,
    vasp_sla_matrix: an.vasp_sla_matrix,
    recent_intercepts: an.recent_cases
  };

  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(dossier, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `TraceX_National_LEA_Dossier_${Date.now()}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast('📥 Exported National Cyber Forensics Dossier (JSON)', 'success');
}

function inspectAuditCase(address, chain, caseId) {
  // 1. Switch to Tab 1 (Attribution)
  const tabBtn = document.querySelector('[data-tab="pane-attribution"]');
  if (tabBtn) tabBtn.click();

  // 2. Populate input
  const input = document.getElementById('targetAddress');
  if (input) {
    input.value = address;
    input.focus();
  }
  const chainSelect = document.getElementById('targetChain');
  if (chainSelect && chain) {
    chainSelect.value = chain;
  }

  // 3. Initiate trace
  showToast(`⚡ Loading Case ${caseId} (${chain}) into On-Chain Engine...`, 'info');
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (typeof startInvestigation === 'function') {
      startInvestigation();
    }
  }, 400);
}

function renderAnalyticsWaveChart(waveData) {
  const container = document.getElementById('analyticsWaveChart');
  if (!container) return;

  const data = waveData && waveData.length ? waveData : [
    { time: "00:00", influx: 14, attr: 12, freezes: 8 },
    { time: "04:00", influx: 18, attr: 16, freezes: 11 },
    { time: "08:00", influx: 32, attr: 29, freezes: 22 },
    { time: "12:00", influx: 48, attr: 44, freezes: 36 },
    { time: "16:00", influx: 62, attr: 58, freezes: 45 },
    { time: "20:00", influx: 70, attr: 65, freezes: 50 },
    { time: "INDEX", influx: 74, attr: 68, freezes: 52 }
  ];

  const w = 700;
  const h = 170;
  const padL = 40;
  const padR = 20;
  const padT = 20;
  const padB = 30;

  const maxVal = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.influx), 80);

  const getX = (i) => padL + (i / (data.length - 1)) * (w - padL - padR);
  const getY = (val) => padT + (1 - val / maxVal) * (h - padT - padB);

  // Generate Area & Line paths
  const influxPoints = data.map((d, i) => [getX(i), getY(d.influx)]);
  const attrPoints = data.map((d, i) => [getX(i), getY(d.attr)]);
  const freezePoints = data.map((d, i) => [getX(i), getY(d.freezes)]);

  const makeSmoothPath = (pts) => {
    if (!pts.length) return "";
    let path = `M ${pts[0][0]},${pts[0][1]}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
      const p0 = pts[i];
      const p1 = pts[i + 1];
      const mx = (p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2;
      path += ` C ${mx},${p0[1]} ${mx},${p1[1]} ${p1[0]},${p1[1]}`;
    }
    return path;
  };

  const influxLine = makeSmoothPath(influxPoints);
  const influxArea = `${influxLine} L ${influxPoints[influxPoints.length-1][0]},${h - padB} L ${influxPoints[0][0]},${h - padB} Z`;

  const attrLine = makeSmoothPath(attrPoints);
  const attrArea = `${attrLine} L ${attrPoints[attrPoints.length-1][0]},${h - padB} L ${attrPoints[0][0]},${h - padB} Z`;

  const freezeLine = makeSmoothPath(freezePoints);

  // Grid Lines
  const gridLines = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0].map(frac => {
    const yVal = padT + (1 - frac) * (h - padT - padB);
    const labelVal = Math.round(frac * maxVal);
    return `
      <line x1="${padL}" y1="${yVal}" x2="${w - padR}" y2="${yVal}" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.06)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 4"/>
      <text x="${padL - 8}" y="${yVal + 3}" fill="#64748b" font-size="9" text-anchor="end" font-family="monospace">${labelVal}</text>
    `;
  }).join('');

  // X Labels
  const xLabels = data.map((d, i) => {
    const x = getX(i);
    return `<text x="${x}" y="${h - 10}" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9.5" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace">${d.time}</text>`;
  }).join('');

  // Blip Dots
  const blipDots = data.map((d, i) => {
    const x = getX(i);
    const yIn = getY(d.influx);
    const yAt = getY(d.attr);
    const yFr = getY(d.freezes);
    return `
      <g>
        <circle cx="${x}" cy="${yIn}" r="3.5" fill="#00e5ff" stroke="#030718" stroke-width="1.5" style="filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #00e5ff)"/>
        <circle cx="${x}" cy="${yAt}" r="3.5" fill="#10b981" stroke="#030718" stroke-width="1.5" style="filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #10b981)"/>
        <circle cx="${x}" cy="${yFr}" r="3" fill="#fbbf24" stroke="#030718" stroke-width="1.5" style="filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #fbbf24)"/>
      </g>
    `;
  }).join('');

  container.innerHTML = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" width="100%" height="${h}" style="overflow:visible">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="waveCyanGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00e5ff" stop-opacity="0.32"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#00e5ff" stop-opacity="0.0"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="waveGreenGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#10b981" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#10b981" stop-opacity="0.0"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <filter id="waveGlow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
        </filter>
      </defs>

      <!-- Grid lines -->
      ${gridLines}

      <!-- Bottom baseline -->
      <line x1="${padL}" y1="${h - padB}" x2="${w - padR}" y2="${h - padB}" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" stroke-width="1.2"/>

      <!-- Areas -->
      <path d="${influxArea}" fill="url(#waveCyanGrad)"/>
      <path d="${attrArea}" fill="url(#waveGreenGrad)"/>

      <!-- Lines -->
      <path d="${influxLine}" fill="none" stroke="#00e5ff" stroke-width="2.2" filter="url(#waveGlow)"/>
      <path d="${attrLine}" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#waveGlow)"/>
      <path d="${freezeLine}" fill="none" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="4 3" filter="url(#waveGlow)"/>

      <!-- Nodes -->
      ${blipDots}

      <!-- Labels -->
      ${xLabels}
    </svg>
  `;
}
