// ─── INTERACTIVE CANVAS GRAPH WITH Fund Flow Visualizer & REAL-TIME FLOW ───────────────
let graphZoom = 1.0;
let graphPanX = 0;
let graphPanY = 0;
let graphNodePositions = [];
let graphFlowActive = true;
let graphAnimationRunning = false;
let graphAnimFrameId = null;
let graphPulseTime = 0;
let graphFlowProgress = 0;
let hoveredNodeIndex = -1;
let selectedNodeIndex = -1;
let currentInspectedNode = null;
let isGraphDragging = false;
let dragStartX = 0;
let dragStartY = 0;
let graphWheelZoomActive = false;
let graphConstellation = [];

function initGraphConstellation(w, h) {
  graphConstellation = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
    graphConstellation.push({
      x: Math.random() * w,
      y: Math.random() * h,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
      radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.8,
      alpha: Math.random() * 0.35 + 0.15
    });
  }
}

function zoomGraph(factor) {
  graphZoom *= factor;
  if (graphZoom < 0.4) graphZoom = 0.4;
  if (graphZoom > 2.8) graphZoom = 2.8;
  if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
}

function resetGraphZoom() {
  graphZoom = 1.0;
  graphPanX = 0;
  graphPanY = 0;
  if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
}

function toggleWheelZoom() {
  graphWheelZoomActive = !graphWheelZoomActive;
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnWheelZoom');
  if (btn) {
    if (graphWheelZoomActive) {
      btn.innerHTML = '🖱️ Wheel Zoom: ON';
      btn.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.45)';
      btn.style.background = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)';
      btn.style.boxShadow = '0 0 10px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25)';
      showToast('🖱️ Wheel Zoom ON (scroll mouse wheel to zoom)', 'info');
    } else {
      btn.innerHTML = '🖱️ Wheel Zoom: OFF';
      btn.style.color = '#94a3b8';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
      btn.style.background = 'transparent';
      btn.style.boxShadow = 'none';
      showToast('🖱️ Wheel Zoom OFF (normal page scrolling restored)', 'info');
    }
  }
}

function toggleFlowAnimation() {
  graphFlowActive = !graphFlowActive;
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnFlowToggle');
  if (btn) {
    if (graphFlowActive) {
      btn.innerHTML = '⚡ Flow: ON';
      btn.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35)';
      btn.style.background = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1)';
      startGraphAnimation();
    } else {
      btn.innerHTML = '⚡ Flow: OFF';
      btn.style.color = '#94a3b8';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
      btn.style.background = 'transparent';
      stopGraphAnimation();
      drawGraph();
    }
  }
}

function exportGraphSnapshot() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('graphCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  const caseRef = currentCaseId || ('CASE-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-6));
  link.download = `TraceX_Topology_${caseRef}.png`;
  link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  showToast('📷 HD Topology Map exported for LEA Dossier', 'success');
}

function startGraphAnimation() {
  if (!graphFlowActive) {
    drawGraph();
    return;
  }
  if (graphAnimationRunning) return;
  const pane = document.getElementById('pane-graph');
  if (!pane || !pane.classList.contains('active')) return;
  graphAnimationRunning = true;
  function loop() {
    if (!graphAnimationRunning) return;
    graphPulseTime += 1;
    if (graphFlowActive) {
      graphFlowProgress += 0.0075;
      if (graphFlowProgress >= 1.0) graphFlowProgress -= 1.0;
    }
    drawGraph();
    graphAnimFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  graphAnimFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function stopGraphAnimation() {
  graphAnimationRunning = false;
  if (graphAnimFrameId) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(graphAnimFrameId);
    graphAnimFrameId = null;
  }
}

// ─── MAIN GRAPH DRAW FUNCTION ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawGraph() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('graphCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const W = rect.width || canvas.offsetWidth || 1000;
  const H = 420;

  if (canvas.width !== Math.floor(W * dpr) || canvas.height !== Math.floor(H * dpr)) {
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
  }

  ctx.save();
  ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

  const cy = H / 2;

  // 1. Subdued Background Gradient
  const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, cy, 40, W / 2, cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#090e24');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#050817');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#020309');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // 2. Coordinate Grid Matrix with Crosshairs
  const gridSize = 45;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.04)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += gridSize) {
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += gridSize) {
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // Draw Grid Crosshairs (+)
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)';
  for (let x = gridSize; x < W; x += gridSize * 2) {
    for (let y = gridSize; y < H; y += gridSize * 2) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - 3, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, y);
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - 3);
      ctx.lineTo(x, y + 3);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // 3. Drifting Constellation Dust Particles
  if (graphConstellation.length === 0) initGraphConstellation(W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
  for (let i = 0; i < graphConstellation.length; i++) {
    const p = graphConstellation[i];
    p.x = (p.x + p.vx + W) % W;
    p.y = (p.y + p.vy + H) % H;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${p.alpha})`;
    ctx.fill();

    // Subtle connection lines between proximate dust points
    for (let j = i + 1; j < graphConstellation.length; j++) {
      const p2 = graphConstellation[j];
      const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - p2.x, p.y - p2.y);
      if (dist < 65) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
        ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(99, 102, 241, ${(1 - dist / 65) * 0.08})`;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Border Brackets [ ]
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  const cornerLen = 14;
  // Top-Left
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, 12 + cornerLen); ctx.lineTo(12, 12); ctx.lineTo(12 + cornerLen, 12);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Top-Right
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W - 12 - cornerLen, 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, 12 + cornerLen);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Bottom-Left
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, H - 12 - cornerLen); ctx.lineTo(12, H - 12); ctx.lineTo(12 + cornerLen, H - 12);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Bottom-Right
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W - 12 - cornerLen, H - 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, H - 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, H - 12 - cornerLen);
  ctx.stroke();

  // HUD Telemetry Overlays
  ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.55)';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('◈ TOPOLOGY MATRIX // SYSTEM: TRACEX-NEURAL // PS-26182', 18, 22);

  // Seamless Fallback to Benchmark Case if currentTrace is not yet initialized
  const traceData = currentTrace || (typeof getBenchmarkPathFallback === 'function' ? getBenchmarkPathFallback() : null);
  const nodes = (traceData && traceData.nodes && traceData.nodes.length > 0) ? traceData.nodes : [];
  const rawEdges = (traceData && (traceData.edges || traceData.links)) ? (traceData.edges || traceData.links) : [];
  const edges = rawEdges.map((e, idx) => {
    const srcNode = nodes[idx];
    const dstNode = nodes[idx + 1];
    return {
      ...e,
      from: e.from || e.source || (srcNode ? (srcNode.address || srcNode.id) : ''),
      to: e.to || e.target || (dstNode ? (dstNode.address || dstNode.id) : ''),
      amount: e.amount || (e.value ? (e.value + ' ' + (traceData?.asset || 'USDT')) : ''),
      tx_hash: e.tx_hash || e.hash || '',
      speed: e.speed || '2-5 min transfer'
    };
  });

  // Clean, Non-Colliding Bottom Telemetry
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(`HOPS: ${nodes.length} | FLOW: ${graphFlowActive ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`, W - 18, H - 14);

  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  const caseRef = (traceData && traceData.case_id) || currentCaseId || 'BENCHMARK-26182';
  ctx.fillText(`◈ CASE: ${caseRef}`, 18, H - 14);

  // 5. IF NO ACTIVE TRACE AND NO BENCHMARK: RENDER AWESOME RECON RADAR SCREEN
  if (nodes.length === 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, cy);

    // Concentric Range Rings
    [60, 120, 180, 230].forEach((r, idx) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = idx === 3 ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25)' : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.setLineDash(idx % 2 === 1 ? [4, 6] : []);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      
      // Range Ring Text
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3)';
      ctx.font = '9px JetBrains Mono';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText(`${r * 4}m`, r + 3, -4);
    });

    // Crosshair axis
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-230, 0); ctx.lineTo(230, 0);
    ctx.moveTo(0, -230); ctx.lineTo(0, 230);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Rotating Radar Sweep Beam
    const sweepAngle = graphPulseTime * 0.03;
    const sweepGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 230);
    sweepGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35)');
    sweepGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.0)');

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 230, sweepAngle - 0.45, sweepAngle);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = sweepGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    // Leading laser line of radar
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(sweepAngle) * 230, Math.sin(sweepAngle) * 230);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Standby Text Banner in Center
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 15, 36, 0.85)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(-210, -32, 420, 64, 10);
    else ctx.rect(-210, -32, 420, 64);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px Space Grotesk';
    ctx.fillText('◈ TOPOLOGY RECONNAISSANCE ENGINE ACTIVE', 0, -10);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = '11px JetBrains Mono';
    ctx.fillText('Execute a trace or select a benchmark case to map transaction hops', 0, 12);

    ctx.restore();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  // 6. IF TRACE ACTIVE: RENDER MULTI-HOP GRAPH WITH USER PAN & ZOOM
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W / 2 + graphPanX, cy + graphPanY);
  ctx.scale(graphZoom, graphZoom);
  ctx.translate(-W / 2, -cy);

  // Calculate Node Positions
  const nodeCount = nodes.length;
  if (nodeCount === 1) {
    // Single Hop (Direct VASP Hop-0)
    graphNodePositions = [{
      x: W / 2,
      y: cy,
      node: nodes[0],
      index: 0
    }];
  } else {
    const padX = Math.max(100, W * 0.11);
    const availW = W - padX * 2;
    const stepX = availW / (nodeCount - 1);
    graphNodePositions = nodes.map((n, i) => {
      const wave = Math.sin(i * 1.5 + 0.35) * (H * 0.15);
      return {
        x: padX + i * stepX,
        y: cy + wave,
        node: n,
        index: i
      };
    });
  }

  // Helper function for roundRect fallback
  function drawPill(rx, ry, rw, rh, rad) {
    if (ctx.roundRect) {
      ctx.roundRect(rx, ry, rw, rh, rad);
    } else {
      ctx.rect(rx, ry, rw, rh);
    }
  }

  // Helper to get entity info
  function getEntityMeta(n, idx) {
    const type = n.node_type || (idx === 0 ? 'suspect' : (idx === nodeCount - 1 ? 'exchange_deposit' : 'intermediary'));
    if (type === 'suspect' || idx === 0) {
      return { col: '#ef4444', icon: '⚠', tag: 'SUSPECT ORIGIN' };
    }
    if (type === 'exchange_deposit' || idx === nodeCount - 1) {
      return { col: '#10b981', icon: '🏛', tag: 'VASP GATEWAY' };
    }
    if (type === 'mixer') {
      return { col: '#a855f7', icon: '☍', tag: 'MIXER PROTOCOL' };
    }
    if (type === 'bridge') {
      return { col: '#38bdf8', icon: '⌥', tag: 'CROSS-CHAIN BRIDGE' };
    }
    return { col: '#f59e0b', icon: '⇄', tag: `MULE LAYER ${idx}` };
  }

  // 7. DRAW EDGES & ELECTRIC FLOW
  edges.forEach((e, i) => {
    let src = graphNodePositions.find(p => p.node && (p.node.id === e.from || p.node.address === e.from || p.node.id === e.source || p.node.address === e.source)) || graphNodePositions[i];
    let dst = graphNodePositions.find(p => p.node && (p.node.id === e.to || p.node.address === e.to || p.node.id === e.target || p.node.address === e.target)) || graphNodePositions[i + 1];
    if (!src || !dst) return;

    const srcMeta = getEntityMeta(src.node, src.index);
    const dstMeta = getEntityMeta(dst.node, dst.index);

    const dx = dst.x - src.x;
    const dy = dst.y - src.y;
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

    // Outer Glow Conduit
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(src.x, src.y);
    ctx.lineTo(dst.x, dst.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.22)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Inner Neon Core Line (Gradient from source color to destination color)
    const lineGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(src.x, src.y, dst.x, dst.y);
    lineGrad.addColorStop(0, srcMeta.col + '99');
    lineGrad.addColorStop(1, dstMeta.col + '99');

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(src.x, src.y);
    ctx.lineTo(dst.x, dst.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = lineGrad;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Directional Holographic Chevrons
    [0.32, 0.68].forEach(t => {
      const cxPos = src.x + dx * t;
      const cyPos = src.y + dy * t;
      const chevSize = 6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cxPos - Math.cos(angle - 0.5) * chevSize, cyPos - Math.sin(angle - 0.5) * chevSize);
      ctx.lineTo(cxPos, cyPos);
      ctx.lineTo(cxPos - Math.cos(angle + 0.5) * chevSize, cyPos - Math.sin(angle + 0.5) * chevSize);
      ctx.strokeStyle = dstMeta.col;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    });

    // Real-Time Electric Fund Flow Photons
    if (graphFlowActive) {
      const photonCount = 3;
      for (let k = 0; k < photonCount; k++) {
        const pt = (graphFlowProgress + k / photonCount) % 1.0;
        const px = src.x + dx * pt;
        const py = src.y + dy * pt;

        // Draw Comet Tail (3 trail points)
        for (let tr = 1; tr <= 3; tr++) {
          const trailT = (pt - tr * 0.02 + 1.0) % 1.0;
          const tx = src.x + dx * trailT;
          const ty = src.y + dy * trailT;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(tx, ty, 3 - tr * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = dstMeta.col + (tr === 1 ? '70' : (tr === 2 ? '40' : '15'));
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // Photon Head
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowColor = dstMeta.col;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, 3.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, 5.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = dstMeta.col + '88';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

    // Floating Glass Pill Badge for Transaction Amount
    const mx = (src.x + dst.x) / 2;
    const my = (src.y + dst.y) / 2 - 16;
    const amtText = e.amount || '';
    if (amtText) {
      ctx.font = 'bold 10px JetBrains Mono';
      const textWidth = ctx.measureText(amtText).width;
      const pillW = textWidth + 24;
      const pillH = 20;
      const px = mx - pillW / 2;
      const py = my - pillH / 2;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      drawPill(px, py, pillW, pillH, 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8, 12, 28, 0.9)';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      // Icon + Amount text
      ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
      ctx.fillText('⚡', px + 5, my);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
      ctx.fillText(amtText, px + 17, my);
    }
  });

  // 8. DRAW HOLOGRAPHIC MULTI-RING NODES
  graphNodePositions.forEach((p, i) => {
    const n = p.node;
    const meta = getEntityMeta(n, i);
    const radius = 22;
    const isHovered = (hoveredNodeIndex === i);
    const isSelected = (selectedNodeIndex === i);
    const isActiveFocus = (isHovered || isSelected);

    // Layer 1: Ambient Pulsing Aura
    const pulseRad = radius + 8 + Math.sin(graphPulseTime * 0.05 + i) * 4;
    const auraGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, radius, p.x, p.y, pulseRad + 6);
    auraGrad.addColorStop(0, meta.col + (isActiveFocus ? '45' : '25'));
    auraGrad.addColorStop(1, meta.col + '00');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, pulseRad + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = auraGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    // Layer 2: Rotating Dashed HUD Scanner Ring
    const ringAngle = graphPulseTime * 0.02 * (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.rotate(ringAngle);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, radius + 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = meta.col + (isActiveFocus ? 'cc' : '77');
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // 4 Micro Tick Crosshairs on HUD ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = meta.col;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5].forEach(ang => {
      const tx1 = Math.cos(ang) * (radius + 4);
      const ty1 = Math.sin(ang) * (radius + 4);
      const tx2 = Math.cos(ang) * (radius + 10);
      const ty2 = Math.sin(ang) * (radius + 10);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx1, ty1);
      ctx.lineTo(tx2, ty2);
      ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.restore();

    // Layer 3: Solid Core Metallic Sphere
    const sphereGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x - 5, p.y - 5, 2, p.x, p.y, radius);
    sphereGrad.addColorStop(0, meta.col);
    sphereGrad.addColorStop(0.7, meta.col + 'dd');
    sphereGrad.addColorStop(1, '#060814');

    ctx.save();
    if (isActiveFocus) {
      ctx.shadowColor = isSelected ? '#c084fc' : meta.col;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = sphereGrad;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = isActiveFocus ? '#ffffff' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)';
    ctx.lineWidth = isActiveFocus ? 2.5 : 1.8;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Layer 4: Center Hop Number & Icon
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Space Grotesk';
    ctx.fillText(`${meta.icon} ${i}`, p.x, p.y);

    // Layer 5: Active Target Lock Brackets [ ] when hovered or selected
    if (isActiveFocus) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = isSelected ? '#c084fc' : '#38bdf8';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      const bSize = radius + 12;
      const bLen = 8;
      // Top-Left bracket
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x - bSize, p.y - bSize + bLen);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - bSize, p.y - bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - bSize + bLen, p.y - bSize);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Top-Right bracket
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + bSize - bLen, p.y - bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + bSize, p.y - bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + bSize, p.y - bSize + bLen);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Bottom-Left bracket
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x - bSize, p.y + bSize - bLen);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - bSize, p.y + bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - bSize + bLen, p.y + bSize);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Bottom-Right bracket
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + bSize - bLen, p.y + bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + bSize, p.y + bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + bSize, p.y + bSize - bLen);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Layer 6: Floating Pill Container for Entity Label & Address
    const labelY = p.y + radius + 12;
    const rawAddr = n.address || n.id || '';
    const shortAddr = rawAddr.length > 10 ? (rawAddr.slice(0, 6) + '...' + rawAddr.slice(-4)) : (rawAddr || 'N/A');
    const tagText = meta.tag;

    ctx.font = 'bold 10px Space Grotesk';
    const tagW = ctx.measureText(tagText).width;
    ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono';
    const addrW = ctx.measureText(shortAddr).width;
    const labelPillW = Math.max(tagW, addrW) + 20;
    const labelPillH = 32;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    drawPill(p.x - labelPillW / 2, labelY, labelPillW, labelPillH, 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(7, 11, 26, 0.9)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = isHovered ? meta.col : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Label Line 1: Tag
    ctx.font = 'bold 10px Space Grotesk';
    ctx.fillStyle = meta.col;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText(tagText, p.x, labelY + 4);

    // Label Line 2: Address
    ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono';
    ctx.fillStyle = isHovered ? '#38bdf8' : '#94a3b8';
    ctx.fillText(shortAddr, p.x, labelY + 17);
  });

  ctx.restore();
  ctx.restore();
}

// ─── INTERACTIVE LISTENERS (DRAG PAN, WHEEL ZOOM, HOVER, CLICK) ─────────────
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('graphCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;

  // 1. Mouse Down: Start Pan Drag
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isGraphDragging = true;
    dragStartX = e.clientX - graphPanX;
    dragStartY = e.clientY - graphPanY;
    canvas.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
  });

  // 2. Window Mouse Up: End Pan Drag
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
    if (isGraphDragging) {
      isGraphDragging = false;
      if (canvas) canvas.style.cursor = hoveredNodeIndex !== -1 ? 'pointer' : 'crosshair';
    }
  });

  // 3. Mouse Move: Hover Detection & Tooltip
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;

    if (isGraphDragging) {
      graphPanX = e.clientX - dragStartX;
      graphPanY = e.clientY - dragStartY;
      if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
      return;
    }

    const W = rect.width;
    const H = 420;
    const cy = H / 2;

    // Inverse matrix transform
    const tx = (mouseX - (W / 2 + graphPanX)) / graphZoom + W / 2;
    const ty = (mouseY - (cy + graphPanY)) / graphZoom + cy;

    let foundIdx = -1;
    for (let p of graphNodePositions) {
      const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - tx, p.y - ty);
      if (dist <= 28) {
        foundIdx = p.index;
        break;
      }
    }

    hoveredNodeIndex = foundIdx;
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('graphHoverTooltip');

    if (foundIdx !== -1) {
      canvas.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      const p = graphNodePositions[foundIdx];
      const targetNode = p.node;
      if (tooltip) {
        tooltip.style.display = 'block';
        tooltip.style.left = `${Math.min(mouseX + 15, W - 260)}px`;
        tooltip.style.top = `${Math.min(mouseY + 15, H - 120)}px`;

        const isSuspect = (foundIdx === 0);
        const isVasp = (foundIdx === graphNodePositions.length - 1);
        const col = isSuspect ? '#ef4444' : (isVasp ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b');
        const roleName = isSuspect ? '⚠ SUSPECT WALLET' : (isVasp ? '🏛 VASP GATEWAY' : `⇄ MULE HOP #${foundIdx}`);

        tooltip.innerHTML = `
          <div class="tt-header">
            <span style="color:${col};font-weight:700">${roleName}</span>
            <span style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;background:${col}22;border:1px solid ${col}55;color:${col}">${targetNode.risk_badge || 'ACTIVE'}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tt-addr">${targetNode.address || 'N/A'}</div>
          <div class="tt-meta">
            <span>Amount: <strong style="color:var(--accent-green)">${targetNode.amount || 'N/A'}</strong></span>
            <span>Type: <strong style="color:#fff">${targetNode.wallet_classification || targetNode.node_type || 'Unhosted'}</strong></span>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:10px;color:#38bdf8;margin-top:6px;text-align:right">👉 Click node for full forensics</div>
        `;
      }
    } else {
      canvas.style.cursor = 'crosshair';
      if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';
    }

    if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
  });

  // 4. Mouse Leave
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
    hoveredNodeIndex = -1;
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('graphHoverTooltip');
    if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';
    if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
  });

  // 5. Wheel Zoom (Only zooms if Wheel Zoom option is ON or user holds Ctrl key; otherwise normal page scroll happens)
  canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
    if (graphWheelZoomActive || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const factor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;
      zoomGraph(factor);
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  // 6. Click on Node: Open Inspection Drawer
  canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const W = rect.width;
    const H = 420;
    const cy = H / 2;

    const tx = (clickX - (W / 2 + graphPanX)) / graphZoom + W / 2;
    const ty = (clickY - (cy + graphPanY)) / graphZoom + cy;

    for (let p of graphNodePositions) {
      const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - tx, p.y - ty);
      if (dist <= 30) {
        inspectGraphNode(p.node, p.index);
        return;
      }
    }
  });
});

function inspectGraphNode(node, idx) {
  selectedNodeIndex = idx;
  currentInspectedNode = node;
  const drawer = document.getElementById('nodeInspectorDrawer');
  const title = document.getElementById('inspectNodeTitle');
  const body = document.getElementById('inspectNodeBody');
  if (!drawer || !node) return;

  const isSuspect = (idx === 0);
  const isVasp = (idx === graphNodePositions.length - 1);
  const roleLabel = isSuspect ? 'Suspect Origin' : (isVasp ? 'VASP Exit Gateway' : `Hop ${idx} Intermediary Mule`);

  // Update Header Status Pill
  const pill = document.getElementById('graphTargetPill');
  const targetPillText = document.getElementById('targetPillText');
  if (pill && targetPillText) {
    pill.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    targetPillText.textContent = `🎯 Hop ${idx} [${roleLabel}]`;
  }

  if (title) {
    title.innerHTML = `
      <span>⚡ Target Acquired: Hop ${idx} // ${roleLabel}</span>
      <span class="badge-cyber" style="background:rgba(168,85,247,0.25);border:1px solid #c084fc;color:#e9d5ff;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;margin-left:8px;border-radius:4px">DOCKED BELOW GRAPH</span>
    `;
  }
  if (body) {
    const riskBadge = node.risk_badge || 'MODERATE';
    const riskColor = riskBadge === 'CRITICAL' || riskBadge === 'HIGH' ? '#ef4444' : (riskBadge === 'MINIMAL' ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b');

    body.innerHTML = `
      <div>
        <div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px">Full Address</div>
        <div style="color:var(--accent-cyan);word-break:break-all;font-size:11px">${node.address || 'N/A'}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px">Entity Classification</div>
        <div style="color:#fff;font-weight:600">${node.wallet_classification || node.node_type || 'Unhosted Wallet'}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px">Value Handled</div>
        <div style="color:var(--accent-green);font-weight:600">${node.amount || 'N/A'}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px">FATF Risk Severity</div>
        <div style="color:${riskColor};font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
          <span class="status-dot" style="background:${riskColor}"></span>
          <span>${riskBadge}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
  drawer.style.display = 'block';
  drawer.classList.remove('pulse-glow');
  void drawer.offsetWidth;
  drawer.classList.add('pulse-glow');

  // Smooth scroll so the drawer is immediately in view
  setTimeout(() => {
    drawer.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
  }, 40);

  showToast(`🎯 Hop ${idx} details loaded below graph ↓`, 'info');
  if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
}

function copyCurrentInspectNode() {
  if (currentInspectedNode && currentInspectedNode.address) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentInspectedNode.address).then(() => {
      showToast('✓ Address copied to clipboard', 'success');
      const btn = document.getElementById('inspectCopyBtn');
      if (btn) {
        btn.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#10b981;font-weight:700">✓ Copied!</span>';
        btn.style.borderColor = '#10b981';
        btn.style.background = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.innerHTML = '📋 Copy Address';
          btn.style.borderColor = '';
          btn.style.background = '';
        }, 1500);
      }
    }).catch(() => {
      prompt('Copy address: Ctrl+C, Enter', currentInspectedNode.address);
    });
  }
}

function closeNodeInspector() {
  selectedNodeIndex = -1;
  const drawer = document.getElementById('nodeInspectorDrawer');
  if (drawer) drawer.style.display = 'none';
  const pill = document.getElementById('graphTargetPill');
  if (pill) pill.style.display = 'none';
  if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  const pane = document.getElementById('pane-graph');
  if (pane && pane.classList.contains('active')) {
    drawGraph();
  }
});

// ─── LIVE DATA TERMINAL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function loadLiveData() {
  if (!currentTrace) {
    currentTrace = {
      suspect_address: 'TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t',
      chain: 'TRON',
      case_id: 'DEMO-SIH26182-001',
      nearest_vasp: { name: 'CoinDCX Nodal Compliance', confidence: 88, inr_value: 480000, is_indian: true }
    };
  }
  const addr = currentTrace.suspect_address;
  const chain = currentTrace.chain;
  const container = document.getElementById('liveDataContent');
  const btn = document.getElementById('loadLiveBtn');

  btn.textContent = '⏳ Querying On-Chain APIs...';
  btn.disabled = true;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--text-muted)">
      <div class="cyber-radar" style="margin:auto;margin-bottom:16px"></div>
      <div>Dispatching queries to PublicAML, Chainabuse, and Explorer nodes...</div>
    </div>
  `;

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/live/${encodeURIComponent(addr)}?chain=${chain}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    renderLiveData(data);
  } catch (e) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="color:var(--accent-danger);padding:20px">❌ Query Failed: ${e.message}</div>`;
  } finally {
    btn.textContent = '🔄 Refresh Query Data';
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
}

function renderLiveData(data) {
  const bc = data.blockchain_data || {}, aml = data.aml_check || {}, ca = data.chainabuse || {}, bq = data.bitquery || {};
  const isSanctioned = aml.is_sanctioned;
  const amlCol = isSanctioned === true ? '#f43f5e' : isSanctioned === false ? '#34d399' : '#fbbf24';

  // 1. Recent Transactions Table
  let txListHtml = '';
  if (bc.recent_txs && bc.recent_txs.length > 0) {
    txListHtml = `
      <div class="stream-panel" style="border-color:rgba(56,189,248,0.3)">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);padding-bottom:8px">
          <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--accent-cyan);font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
            <span class="status-dot status-dot-cyan pulse"></span>
            <span>RECENT ON-CHAIN TRANSACTIONS [${bc.api || 'EXPLORER FEED'}]</span>
          </div>
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.65rem;color:#94a3b8">${bc.recent_txs.length} Confirmed Records</span>
        </div>
        <div style="max-height:220px;overflow-y:auto">
          <table class="cand-table" style="font-size:0.75rem;width:100%">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style="padding:8px">Tx Hash</th>
                <th style="padding:8px">Direction / Value</th>
                <th style="padding:8px">Counterparty / Block Status</th>
                <th style="padding:8px;text-align:right">Action</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              ${bc.recent_txs.map(t => `
                <tr>
                  <td class="mono" style="color:var(--accent-cyan);padding:8px">${(t.hash || 'N/A').substring(0, 18)}...</td>
                  <td class="mono green" style="padding:8px;font-weight:700">${t.value_eth !== undefined ? t.value_eth + ' ETH' : (t.value_btc !== undefined ? t.value_btc + ' BTC' : 'Confirmed')}</td>
                  <td class="mono" style="color:#94a3b8;padding:8px">${t.to ? t.to.substring(0, 16) + '...' : (t.is_confirmed !== undefined ? (t.is_confirmed ? 'Confirmed (Block #' + t.block_height + ')' : 'Mempool Pending') : 'On-Chain Validated')}</td>
                  <td style="padding:8px;text-align:right">
                    <button class="btn-cyber btn-ghost" onclick="copyToClipboard('${t.hash}', event)" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:0.65rem">Copy</button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              `).join('')}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  // 2. Bitquery V2 Realtime Token Transfers Table
  let bqHtml = '';
  if (bq.transfers && bq.transfers.length > 0) {
    bqHtml = `
      <div class="stream-panel">

function initNoticeIcons() {
  const g = document.getElementById('iconNoticeGavel');
  if (g && !g.innerHTML) g.innerHTML = getIsometricGavelSvg();
  const v = document.getElementById('iconNoticeVault');
  if (v && !v.innerHTML) v.innerHTML = getIsometricFreezeVaultSvg();
  const e = document.getElementById('iconNoticeExchange');
  if (e && !e.innerHTML) e.innerHTML = getIsometricExchangeNodeSvg();
  const c = document.getElementById('iconNoticeEvidence');
  if (c && !c.innerHTML) c.innerHTML = getIsometricEvidenceCertSvg();
}

function applyNoticePreset(presetKey) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.notice-preset-pill').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  if (event && event.currentTarget) event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');

  const off = document.getElementById('nOfficer');
  const unit = document.getElementById('nUnit');
  const state = document.getElementById('nState');
  const fir = document.getElementById('nFIR');

  if (presetKey === 'fir247') {
    if (off) off.value = 'Insp. Anil Sharma, Cyber Crime Cell';
    if (unit) unit.value = 'Cyber Crime Police Station, Pune CID';
    if (state) state.value = 'Maharashtra';
    if (fir) fir.value = 'FIR No. 247/2024 (Sec 66D IT Act, 318(4) BNS)';
  } else if (presetKey === 'urgent_freeze') {
    if (off) off.value = 'DCP Cyber Crime / Special Cell';
    if (unit) unit.value = 'Financial Fraud & On-Chain Asset Seizure Cell';
    if (state) state.value = 'Delhi Police / MHA Cyber Wing';
    if (fir) fir.value = 'EMERGENCY FREEZE REQ / BNSS-106 / 2026-9182';
  } else if (presetKey === 'mlat') {
    if (off) off.value = 'Superintendent of Police (INTERPOL / CBI-NCB)';
    if (unit) unit.value = 'International Police Cooperation Cell (IPCU)';
    if (state) state.value = 'Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), New Delhi';
    if (fir) fir.value = 'MLAT / INTERPOL PURPLE NOTICE REF: 2026-IN-CYBER';
  } else if (presetKey === 'pmla') {
    if (off) off.value = 'Assistant Director (Crypto Forensic Wing)';
    if (unit) unit.value = 'Directorate of Enforcement (ED), Western Region';
    if (state) state.value = 'Ministry of Finance, Govt. of India';
    if (fir) fir.value = 'ECIR/MBZO-I/42/2026 (PMLA Investigation)';
  }
  generateNotice();
}

async function generateNotice(silent = false) {
  initNoticeIcons();
  const officer = (document.getElementById('nOfficer') && document.getElementById('nOfficer').value) || 'Inspector / IO';
  const unit = (document.getElementById('nUnit') && document.getElementById('nUnit').value) || 'Cyber Crime Police Station';
  const state = (document.getElementById('nState') && document.getElementById('nState').value) || 'Maharashtra';
  const fir = (document.getElementById('nFIR') && document.getElementById('nFIR').value) || 'FIR No. 247/2024';
  const preview = document.getElementById('noticePreview');

  if (!preview) return;

  const chkKyc = document.getElementById('chkKyc') ? document.getElementById('chkKyc').checked : true;
  const chkBank = document.getElementById('chkBank') ? document.getElementById('chkBank').checked : true;
  const chkIp = document.getElementById('chkIp') ? document.getElementById('chkIp').checked : true;
  const chkFreeze = document.getElementById('chkFreeze') ? document.getElementById('chkFreeze').checked : true;

  // Derive dynamic VASP and target info
  const v = (currentTrace && (currentTrace.nearest_vasp || currentTrace.vasp)) || {};
  const vaspName = v.name || 'Centralized Exchange Nodal Compliance Desk';
  const email = v.nodal_email || v.contact || 'compliance@exchange.io';
  const jurisdiction = v.country || v.jurisdiction || 'Global / Seychelles';
  const addr = (currentTrace && (currentTrace.deposit_address || currentTrace.suspect_address)) || (document.getElementById('walletAddr') ? document.getElementById('walletAddr').value : '0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc454e4438f44e');
  const chain = (currentTrace && currentTrace.chain) || 'Ethereum (ERC-20)';
  const amount = (currentTrace && (currentTrace.amount || currentTrace.suspect_amount)) || '14.5 ETH (~$36,685 USD)';
  const conf = (currentTrace && (currentTrace.confidence_score || currentTrace.confidence)) || 92;
  const risk = (currentTrace && currentTrace.composite_risk_rating) || 'HIGH';
  const riskScore = (currentTrace && currentTrace.composite_risk_score) || 78;
  const txid = (currentTrace && currentTrace.hops && currentTrace.hops.length > 0 && currentTrace.hops[0].tx_hash) || '0x4f8a9b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a';
  const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
  const timeUtc = new Date().toUTCString();
  const caseRef = currentCaseId || (fir ? `CASE-${fir.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}` : 'MHA-I4C-2026-9182');

  // Update HUD telemetry targets
  const tv = document.getElementById('noticeTargetVasp');
  if (tv) tv.textContent = vaspName;
  const te = document.getElementById('noticeTargetEmail');
  if (te) te.textContent = email;

  // Build Mandate Clauses
  let mandatesText = '';
  let mandateIndex = 1;
  if (chkKyc) {
    mandatesText += `  ${mandateIndex++}. REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION OF SUBSCRIBER IDENTIFICATION (KYC):\n` +
      `     Furnish complete certified copies of all Know-Your-Customer (KYC) documents\n` +
      `     associated with beneficiary accounts linked to Deposit Address [${addr}],\n` +
      `     including Government Photo ID (Aadhaar / PAN / Passport), verified phone number,\n` +
      `     email address, residential address, and Video-KYC / selfie records.\n\n`;
  }
  if (chkBank) {
    mandatesText += `  ${mandateIndex++}. FIAT OFF-RAMP & LINKED BANK ACCOUNT DISCLOSURE:\n` +
      `     Disclose all linked bank accounts, UPI IDs, credit/debit cards, and third-party\n` +
      `     payment gateways utilized to deposit or liquidate illicit crypto balances, including\n` +
      `     complete transaction logs with UTR numbers and INR / USD timestamps.\n\n`;
  }
  if (chkIp) {
    mandatesText += `  ${mandateIndex++}. LOGIN IP AUDIT TRAILS & HARDWARE TELEMETRY:\n` +
      `     Provide complete session login logs containing source IP addresses with port numbers,\n` +
      `     UTC timestamps, device MAC / IMEI identifiers, user-agent strings, and 2FA authentication\n` +
      `     telemetry for the past 180 days.\n\n`;
  }
  if (chkFreeze) {
    mandatesText += `  ${mandateIndex++}. IMMEDIATE DEBIT FREEZE & ASSET RESTRAINT (SEC 106 BNSS / 102 CrPC):\n` +
      `     IMMEDIATELY FREEZE and halt all outbound debit transactions, crypto transfers, P2P\n` +
      `     escrow trades, and internal book transfers for all accounts matching this suspect entity\n` +
      `     to prevent dissipation of criminal proceeds pending further judicial orders.\n\n`;
  }

  const noticeText =
`====================================================================================================
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA // MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS // INDIAN CYBER CRIME COORDINATION CENTRE (I4C)
OFFICIAL STATUTORY NOTICE UNDER SECTION 91 BHARATIYA NAGARIK SURAKSHA SANHITA, 2023 (BNSS)
READ WITH SECTION 91 CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE, 1973 (CrPC) & SECTION 106 BNSS (ASSET RESTRAINT)
====================================================================================================

DOCUMENT REF NO : MHA/I4C/TRACEX/SEC91/${caseRef}
DATE OF ISSUANCE: ${dateStr} (${timeUtc})
JURISDICTION    : ${state} Police // ${unit}
AUTHORIZED IO   : ${officer}
CRIME / FIR NO  : ${fir}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TO:
  THE NODAL COMPLIANCE OFFICER / LEGAL PROCESS TEAM
  VASP ENTITY            : ${vaspName}
  REGISTERED JURISDICTION: ${jurisdiction}
  STATUTORY NODAL EMAIL  : ${email}
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SUBJECT: STATUTORY REQUISITION FOR PRODUCTION OF SUBSCRIBER KYC RECORDS (DRAFT FOR REVIEW BY AUTHORIZED AGENCIES), 
         SESSION AUDIT LOGS, AND IMMEDIATE FREEZE OF DIGITAL ASSETS UNDER SEC 106 BNSS.

Sir / Madam,

1. WHEREAS an active criminal investigation into serious organized cyber fraud / financial laundering
   is underway under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 and the Information
   Technology Act, 2000 under FIR Reference: ${fir}.

2. AND WHEREAS forensic blockchain de-anonymization and heuristic transaction graph clustering
   executed via the TraceX Intelligence Engine has established beyond reasonable doubt that illicit
   proceeds totaling ${amount} were directly channeled into the deposit infrastructure of your VASP:

   • TARGET SUSPECT ADDRESS : ${addr}
   • BLOCKCHAIN / PROTOCOL  : ${chain}
   • ATTRIBUTION CONFIDENCE : ${conf}% PROBABILISTIC MATCH (CONFIDENCE-BASED EVIDENCE)
   • AML RISK CLASSIFICATION: ${risk} (${riskScore}/100)
   • PRIMARY ENTRY TX HASH  : ${txid}

3. YOU ARE HEREBY COMMANDED AND STATUTORILY REQUIRED UNDER SECTION 91 BNSS, 2023 TO COMPLY WITH
   THE FOLLOWING DIRECTIVES WITHIN TWENTY-FOUR (24) HOURS OF RECEIPT:

${mandatesText}4. LEGAL CONSEQUENCE OF NON-COMPLIANCE:
   Take notice that failure to produce the requisitioned information or execute the directed asset
   restraint constitutes an intentional omission punishable under Section 223 / 228 of the Bharatiya
   Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Section 69 / 43A of the Information Technology Act, 2000.

5. TRANSMISSION & VERIFICATION:
   All records must be transmitted in encrypted format to the official law enforcement email of the
   Investigating Officer or uploaded through the automated I4C SAHYOG Nodal Coordination Gateway.
   This document is cryptographically signed and hash-verified under Section 65B Bharatiya Sakshya
   Adhiniyam, 2023 (BSA).

ISSUED UNDER THE SEAL AND AUTHORITY OF:

________________________________________
${officer}
${unit}, ${state} Police
Law Enforcement Agency, Government of India
Digitally Signed Reference: SHA256-${Array.from(caseRef).reduce((a,c)=>a+c.charCodeAt(0)*31,0).toString(16).padStart(12,'0')}
====================================================================================================`;

  preview.textContent = noticeText;

  // Update words & chars counter
  const words = noticeText.trim().split(/\s+/).length;
  const chars = noticeText.length;
  const metaEl = document.getElementById('noticeMetaCount');
  if (metaEl) metaEl.textContent = `${words} words | ${chars} chars`;

  if (!silent) { showToast('✓ Section 91 Statutory Requisition Directive Synthesized!', 'success'); }
}

function copyNotice(e) {
  const preview = document.getElementById('noticePreview');
  const txt = preview ? preview.textContent : '';
  if (!txt || txt.includes("Click 'Synthesize")) {
    showToast('Please synthesize Section 91 notice first', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  const triggerBtn = (e && e.currentTarget) || (typeof event !== 'undefined' && event && event.currentTarget) || null;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => {
    showToast('✓ Section 91 statutory notice copied to clipboard!', 'success');
    if (triggerBtn) {
      triggerBtn.classList.add('btn-copied-anim');
      setTimeout(() => triggerBtn.classList.remove('btn-copied-anim'), 1200);
    }
  }).catch(() => {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = txt;
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    showToast('✓ Section 91 statutory notice copied to clipboard!', 'success');
    if (triggerBtn) {
      triggerBtn.classList.add('btn-copied-anim');
      setTimeout(() => triggerBtn.classList.remove('btn-copied-anim'), 1200);
    }
  });
}

function downloadNotice() {
  const preview = document.getElementById('noticePreview');
  const txt = preview ? preview.textContent : '';
  if (!txt || txt.includes("Click 'Synthesize")) {
    showToast('Please synthesize Section 91 notice first', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = 'data:text/plain;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(txt);
  a.download = `SAHYOG_Sec91_Notice_${currentCaseId || 'DIRECTIVE'}.txt`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  showToast('✓ Section 91 Notice text downloaded', 'info');
}

function printNotice() {
  const preview = document.getElementById('noticePreview');
  const txt = preview ? preview.textContent : '';
  if (!txt || txt.includes("Click 'Synthesize")) {
    showToast('Please synthesize Section 91 notice first', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  const printWin = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=850,height=950');
  if (!printWin) {
    showToast('Pop-up blocked: please allow pop-ups to print notice', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  printWin.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8"/>
  <title>MHA SAHYOG - Section 91 BNSS / CrPC Notice</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; padding: 45px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; color: #111; background: #fff; }
    h1 { font-size: 15px; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
    pre { white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; font-family: inherit; margin: 0; }
    .footer { margin-top: 40px; border-top: 1px solid #ccc; padding-top: 10px; font-size: 10px; color: #666; text-align: center; font-family: sans-serif; }
    @media print { body { padding: 25px; } button { display: none; } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <h1>STATUTORY REQUISITION NOTICE UNDER SECTION 91 BNSS / CrPC</h1>
  <pre>${escapeHtml(txt)}</pre>
  <div class="footer">DISPATCHED VIA SAHYOG AUTOMATED VASP COMPLIANCE GATEWAY (MHA I4C // PS-26182)</div>
</body>
</html>`);
  printWin.document.close();
  printWin.focus();
  setTimeout(() => {
    try { printWin.print(); } catch(e) {}
  }, 450);
}

// ─── PROTOTYPE AI COPILOT (LLM-ASSISTED REASONING) ───────────────────────────

function escapeHtml(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

function formatAiMarkdown(md) {
  if (!md) return '<div class="ai-md-content"><p style="color:#94a3b8">No intelligence response generated.</p></div>';
  
  // 1. Extract and protect code blocks
  const codeBlocks = [];
  let str = md.replace(/```([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\r?\n([\s\S]*?)```/g, (match, lang, code) => {
    const placeholder = '__CODE_BLOCK_' + codeBlocks.length + '__';
    codeBlocks.push({ lang: lang || 'CODE', code: escapeHtml(code.trim()) });
    return placeholder;
  });

  // 2. Extract and protect inline code
  const inlineCodes = [];
  str = str.replace(/`([^`\r\n]+)`/g, (match, code) => {
    const placeholder = '__INLINE_CODE_' + inlineCodes.length + '__';
    inlineCodes.push(escapeHtml(code));
    return placeholder;
  });

  // 3. Escape general HTML
  str = escapeHtml(str);

  // 4. Horizontal rules
  str = str.replace(/^---+$/gm, '<hr class="ai-md-hr" style="border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);margin:12px 0"/>');

  // 5. Headers (h2 - h5)
  str = str.replace(/^####\s+(.*$)/gm, '<h5 style="color:#38bdf8;font-size:0.85rem;margin:12px 0 6px;font-weight:700">$1</h5>');
  str = str.replace(/^###\s+(.*$)/gm, '<h4 style="color:#00e5ff;font-size:0.92rem;margin:14px 0 6px;font-weight:800">$1</h4>');
  str = str.replace(/^##\s+(.*$)/gm, '<h3 style="color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;margin:16px 0 8px;font-weight:800">$1</h3>');
  str = str.replace(/^#\s+(.*$)/gm, '<h2 style="color:#fff;font-size:1.15rem;margin:18px 0 8px;font-weight:900">$1</h2>');

  // 6. Bold & Italic formatting
  str = str.replace(/\*\*\*(.*?)\*\*\*/g, '<strong><em>$1</em></strong>');
  str = str.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  str = str.replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');

  // 7. Process bullet points and numbered lists cleanly
  const lines = str.split('\n');
  const output = [];
  let inUl = false;
  let inOl = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i];
    const bulletMatch = line.match(/^\s*[-*]\s+(.*)$/);
    const numMatch = line.match(/^\s*\d+\.\s+(.*)$/);

    if (bulletMatch) {
      if (inOl) { output.push('</ol>'); inOl = false; }
      if (!inUl) { output.push('<ul style="margin:6px 0 8px 18px;padding-left:0;line-height:1.6">'); inUl = true; }
      output.push('<li style="margin-bottom:4px">' + bulletMatch[1] + '</li>');
    } else if (numMatch) {
      if (inUl) { output.push('</ul>'); inUl = false; }
      if (!inOl) { output.push('<ol style="margin:6px 0 8px 18px;padding-left:0;line-height:1.6">'); inOl = true; }
      output.push('<li style="margin-bottom:4px">' + numMatch[1] + '</li>');
    } else {
      if (inUl) { output.push('</ul>'); inUl = false; }
      if (inOl) { output.push('</ol>'); inOl = false; }
      output.push(line);
    }
  }
  if (inUl) output.push('</ul>');
  if (inOl) output.push('</ol>');

  str = output.join('\n');

  // 8. Restore Inline Code
  inlineCodes.forEach((code, idx) => {
    str = str.replace(new RegExp('__INLINE_CODE_' + idx + '__', 'g'), '<code style="font-family:var(--font-mono, monospace);background:rgba(0,229,255,0.1);color:#00e5ff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.75rem;border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.25)">' + code + '</code>');
  });

  // 9. Restore Code Blocks
  codeBlocks.forEach((block, idx) => {
    const blockHtml = `
      <div style="background:rgba(3,0,20,0.85);border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.25);border-radius:8px;margin:10px 0;overflow:hidden">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);padding:4px 10px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.65rem;color:#94a3b8">
          <span>${block.lang.toUpperCase()}</span>
          <button class="ai-copy-btn" onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.closest('div').nextElementSibling.innerText);this.innerText='Copied!';setTimeout(()=>this.innerText='Copy',1200)">Copy</button>
        </div>
        <pre style="margin:0;padding:10px 14px;overflow-x:auto"><code style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem;color:#38bdf8">${block.code}</code></pre>
      </div>`;
    str = str.replace(new RegExp('__CODE_BLOCK_' + idx + '__', 'g'), blockHtml);
  });

  // 10. Wrap regular text chunks in paragraphs
  const chunks = str.split(/\n\n+/);
  str = chunks.map(chunk => {
    chunk = chunk.trim();
    if (!chunk) return '';
    if (/^<(h[2-5]|ul|ol|hr|blockquote|div|table)/i.test(chunk)) {
      return chunk;
    }
    return '<p style="margin:6px 0 8px 0;line-height:1.65;font-size:0.82rem;color:#cbd5e1">' + chunk.replace(/\n/g, '<br/>') + '</p>';
  }).join('');

  return '<div class="ai-md-content">' + str + '</div>';
}

function copyAiResponseText(btn) {
  const container = btn.closest('.ai-action-bar, div');
  const card = btn.closest('#aiSummaryContent, #copilotChatLog > div, .ai-rendered-body') || container.parentElement;
  const body = card.querySelector('.ai-rendered-body, .ai-md-content') || card;
  if (body) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(body.innerText).then(() => {
      const orig = btn.innerText;
      btn.innerText = '✅ Copied!';
      setTimeout(() => { btn.innerText = orig; }, 1500);
    });
  }
}

// ─── COPY TO CLIPBOARD WITH ANIMATION & FEEDBACK ─────────────────────────────
function copyToClipboard(text, e) {
  if (!text) return;
  const target = (e && (e.currentTarget || e.target)) || (window.event && (window.event.currentTarget || window.event.target)) || null;
  const btn = target ? (target.closest('button') || target) : null;
  
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
    if (btn && btn.tagName) {
      const origHtml = btn.innerHTML;
      btn.classList.add('btn-copied-anim');
      const isCompact = btn.classList.contains('node-inspect-btn') || btn.classList.contains('dt-action-btn') || btn.classList.contains('btn-mini-copy') || btn.classList.contains('btn-copy-card') || (btn.offsetWidth > 0 && btn.offsetWidth < 140);
      const copiedText = isCompact ? 'Copied!' : 'Copied to Clipboard!';
      const iconSize = isCompact ? '12' : '15';
      btn.innerHTML = `<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-weight:700;color:#10b981"><svg width="${iconSize}" height="${iconSize}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline></svg> ${copiedText}</span>`;
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        btn.classList.remove('btn-copied-anim');
        btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
      }, 1600);
    }
    showToast(`✓ Copied to clipboard: ${text.length > 32 ? text.slice(0, 28) + '...' : text}`, 'success');
  }).catch(() => {
    prompt('Copy to clipboard: Ctrl+C, Enter', text);
  });
}

// ─── DYNAMIC 3D PERSPECTIVE WIREFRAME CYBER MESH ENGINE ───────────────────────
(function init3dWireframeMesh() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('wireframe3dCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let width, height;
  let animId;
  let time = 0;
  let targetTiltX = 0, targetTiltY = 0;
  let currentTiltX = 0, currentTiltY = 0;

  function resize() {
    width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    targetTiltX = (e.clientX / width - 0.5) * 0.35;
    targetTiltY = (e.clientY / height - 0.5) * 0.2;
  });

  const COLS = 26;
  const ROWS = 22;
  const SPACING_X = 65;
  const SPACING_Z = 65;
  const CAMERA_HEIGHT = 150;
  const FOV = 440;

  function render() {
    time += 0.014;
    currentTiltX += (targetTiltX - currentTiltX) * 0.05;
    currentTiltY += (targetTiltY - currentTiltY) * 0.05;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const cx = width / 2 + currentTiltX * 160;
    const cy = height * 0.62 + currentTiltY * 110;

    const points = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      points[r] = [];
      const z = (r + 1) * SPACING_Z;
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        const x = (c - COLS / 2) * SPACING_X;
        const wave1 = Math.sin(c * 0.22 + time * 1.2) * Math.cos(r * 0.22 + time * 0.8) * 32;
        const wave2 = Math.sin((c + r) * 0.16 + time * 1.5) * 18;
        const y = CAMERA_HEIGHT + wave1 + wave2;

        const scale = FOV / (z + 200);
        const px = cx + x * scale;
        const py = cy + y * scale;
        const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - (r / ROWS) * 0.85));

        points[r][c] = { x: px, y: py, alpha };
      }
    }

    // Draw horizontal grid lines
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        const p = points[r][c];
        if (c === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
        else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      }
      const rowAlpha = points[r][0].alpha * 0.45;
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, width, 0);
      grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${rowAlpha * 0.15})`);
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(168, 85, 247, ${rowAlpha})`);
      grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${rowAlpha * 0.15})`);
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.6, (1 - r / ROWS) * 1.4);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Draw vertical/depth grid lines
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
        const p = points[r][c];
        if (r === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
        else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      }
      const colNorm = Math.abs(c - COLS / 2) / (COLS / 2);
      const colAlpha = (1 - colNorm * 0.5) * 0.35;
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${colAlpha})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Draw pulsing data beacon nodes
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r += 3) {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c += 3) {
        const p = points[r][c];
        if (!p || p.alpha < 0.2) continue;
        const pulse = (Math.sin(time * 3 + r * 2 + c) + 1) * 0.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(52, 211, 153, ${p.alpha * (0.25 + pulse * 0.5)})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1.8 + pulse * 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    animId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
    else animId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
  });

  animId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
})();

  const walletInp = document.getElementById('walletAddr');
  if (walletInp) {
    if (walletInp.value) handleWalletInputLive(walletInp.value);

      walletInp.addEventListener(evt, () => handleWalletInputLive(walletInp.value));
    });

});

// ─── UNIVERSAL COORDINATE RIPPLE EFFECT FOR ALL CYBER BUTTONS ─────────────────
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.btn-cyber, .btn-primary-trace, .btn-ghost, .btn-green-glow, .btn-primary-glow, .btn-sahyog-primary, .case-card, .hint-badge, .graph-tool-btn, .btn-sih-ad-action, .cyber-tab');
  if (!btn) return;
  
  const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  const circle = document.createElement('span');
  const d = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);
  circle.style.width = circle.style.height = `${d}px`;
  circle.style.left = `${e.clientX - rect.left - d / 2}px`;
  circle.style.top = `${e.clientY - rect.top - d / 2}px`;
  circle.classList.add('cyber-ripple-circle');
  btn.appendChild(circle);
  setTimeout(() => circle.remove(), 650);
});


// ── NEO4J AURA CLOUD INTEGRATION ──
async function fetchNeo4jTelemetry() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/neo4j/status`);
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.status === 'connected') {
      const topPill = document.getElementById('topbarNeo4jStatus');
      if (topPill) topPill.innerHTML = `NEO4J: ${data.instance_name || 'VINI'} (${data.node_count}N)`;
      
      const sVal = document.getElementById('neo4jStatusVal');
      if (sVal) sVal.innerHTML = `🟢 CONNECTED [${data.cloud || 'Aura'}]`;
      
      const nVal = document.getElementById('neo4jNodesVal');
      if (nVal) nVal.textContent = `${data.node_count} Nodes`;

      const rVal = document.getElementById('neo4jRelsVal');
      if (rVal) rVal.textContent = `${data.relationship_count} Relationships`;

      const lVal = document.getElementById('neo4jLatencyVal');
      if (lVal) lVal.textContent = `${data.latency_ms} ms`;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Neo4j telemetry poll failed:', e);
  }
}

function openNeo4jModal() {
  playCyberSound('chirp');
  const m = document.getElementById('neo4jModal');
  if (m) m.style.display = 'flex';
  fetchNeo4jTelemetry();
  executeCurrentCypher();
}

function closeNeo4jModal() {
  const m = document.getElementById('neo4jModal');
  if (m) m.style.display = 'none';
}

function setCypherQuery(q) {
  const inp = document.getElementById('cypherQueryInput');
  if (inp) {
    inp.value = q;
    executeCurrentCypher();
  }
}

async function executeCurrentCypher() {
  const inp = document.getElementById('cypherQueryInput');
  const container = document.getElementById('cypherResultsContainer');
  const timing = document.getElementById('cypherTimingBadge');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnRunCypher');
  if (!inp || !container) return;

  const query = inp.value.trim();
  if (!query) return;

  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳ Running...'; }
  if (timing) timing.textContent = 'Querying Neo4j Aura cloud...';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/neo4j/query`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ query: query })
    });
    const data = await res.json();

    if (!data.success) {
      container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:14px;color:#f87171;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem">❌ Cypher Error: ${escapeHtml(data.error || 'Execution failed')}</div>`;
      if (timing) timing.textContent = `Error (${data.execution_ms || 0}ms)`;
      return;
    }

    if (timing) timing.textContent = `✓ ${data.count} records returned in ${data.execution_ms}ms`;

    const cols = data.columns || [];
    const rows = data.data || [];

    if (rows.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:16px;color:#94a3b8;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem;text-align:center">No records matched your Cypher pattern.</div>`;
      return;
    }

    let html = `<table class="neo4j-results-table"><thead><tr>`;
    cols.forEach(c => { html += `<th>${escapeHtml(c)}</th>`; });
    html += `</tr></thead><tbody>`;

    rows.forEach(r => {
      html += `<tr>`;
      cols.forEach(c => {
        const v = r[c] !== undefined ? String(r[c]) : '';
        html += `<td title="Click to copy" onclick="copyToClipboard('${escapeHtml(v)}', event)">${escapeHtml(v)}</td>`;
      });
      html += `</tr>`;
    });
    html += `</tbody></table>`;
    container.innerHTML = html;

  } catch (e) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:14px;color:#f87171;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem">❌ Network Error: ${escapeHtml(e.message)}</div>`;
    if (timing) timing.textContent = 'Failed';
  } finally {
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '⚡ Execute Cypher'; }
  }
}

async function syncCurrentTraceToNeo4j() {
  if (!currentTrace) {
    showToast('Please execute or select a case first to sync', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  showToast('🔄 Synchronizing active case into Neo4j Aura Cloud...', 'info');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/neo4j/sync`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(currentTrace)
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      showToast(`✓ Synced ${data.nodes_ingested} nodes & ${data.edges_ingested} edges to Neo4j Aura!`, 'success');
      fetchNeo4jTelemetry();
      executeCurrentCypher();
    } else {
      showToast(`Sync warning: ${data.error}`, 'error');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    showToast(`Sync failed: ${e.message}`, 'error');
  }
}

function updateAudioUiState() {
  const hubIcon = document.getElementById('hubAudioIcon');
  const hubBadge = document.getElementById('hubAudioBadge');

      if (hubDesc) hubDesc.textContent = 'Auditory feedback active for telemetry & actions (click to mute)';
    } else {
      hubIcon.textContent = '🔇';
      hubBadge.textContent = 'MUTED';
      hubBadge.className = 'tool-card-tag tag-gray';
      if (hubDesc) hubDesc.textContent = 'Audio muted (click to enable audio feedback)';
    }
  }
  const icon = document.getElementById('audioMenuIcon');
  const badge = document.getElementById('audioMenuBadge');
  const desc = document.getElementById('audioMenuDesc');
  if (icon && badge) {
    if (window.forensicAudioEnabled) {

      badge.className = 'item-tag tag-cyan';

}

// ─── MASTERCLASS FORENSIC TOOLS HUB CONTROLLER ─────────────────────
function openToolsHub() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('toolsHubOverlay');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnToolsHub');
  if (!overlay) return;
  overlay.style.display = 'flex';
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('is-active');
  try { if (typeof playForensicAudio === 'function') playForensicAudio('click'); } catch(e) {}
  setTimeout(() => {
    const input = document.getElementById('toolsSearchInput');
    if (input) input.focus();
  }, 100);
}

function closeToolsHub() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('toolsHubOverlay');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnToolsHub');
  if (!overlay) return;
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  if (btn) btn.classList.remove('is-active');
  try { if (typeof playForensicAudio === 'function') playForensicAudio('click'); } catch(e) {}
}

function toggleToolsHub() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('toolsHubOverlay');
  if (overlay && overlay.style.display === 'flex') {
    closeToolsHub();
  } else {
    openToolsHub();
  }
}

function handleToolsHubBackdrop(e) {
  if (e.target && e.target.id === 'toolsHubOverlay') {
    closeToolsHub();
  }
}

function applyToolsFilters() {
  const q = (document.getElementById('toolsSearchInput')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tool-tab-btn.is-active');
  const cat = activeTab ? (activeTab.getAttribute('data-tab') || 'all') : 'all';
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#toolsHubGrid .tool-card');
  const clearBtn = document.getElementById('toolsSearchClear');
  if (clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = q ? 'inline-block' : 'none';

  let visibleCount = 0;
  cards.forEach(card => {
    const cardCat = card.getAttribute('data-cat') || 'all';
    const title = (card.querySelector('.tool-card-title')?.textContent || '').toLowerCase();
    const desc = (card.querySelector('.tool-card-desc')?.textContent || '').toLowerCase();
    const searchData = (card.getAttribute('data-search') || '').toLowerCase();

    const matchesCat = (cat === 'all' || cardCat === cat);
    const matchesQuery = (!q || title.includes(q) || desc.includes(q) || searchData.includes(q));

    if (matchesCat && matchesQuery) {
      card.classList.remove('is-hidden');
      card.style.display = 'flex';
      visibleCount++;
    } else {
      card.classList.add('is-hidden');
      card.style.display = 'none';
    }
  });

  const countBadge = document.getElementById('toolsHubCount');
  if (countBadge) {
    if (q) {
      countBadge.textContent = `${visibleCount} FOUND`;
    } else if (cat !== 'all') {
      countBadge.textContent = `${visibleCount} MODULES SHOWN`;
    } else {
      countBadge.textContent = '12 MODULES LOADED Prototype';
    }
  }
}

function filterToolsByTab(cat, btn) {
  const tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.tool-tab-btn');
  tabBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('is-active'));
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('is-active');
  applyToolsFilters();
  try { if (typeof playForensicAudio === 'function') playForensicAudio('chirp'); } catch(e) {}
}

function filterToolsGrid(query) {
  applyToolsFilters();
}

function clearToolsSearch() {
  const input = document.getElementById('toolsSearchInput');
  if (input) {
    input.value = '';
    applyToolsFilters();
    input.focus();
  }
}

function runToolAction(action) {
  closeToolsHub();
  try { if (typeof playForensicAudio === 'function') playForensicAudio('lock'); } catch(e) {}
  
  if (action === 'console') {
    if (typeof openTraceXConsole === 'function') {
      openTraceXConsole();
    } else {
      const m = document.getElementById('traceXConsoleModal');
      if (m) m.style.display = 'flex';
      showToast('Opening API Diagnostics Console...', 'info');
    }
  } else if (action === 'sih') {
    if (typeof openSihIntroModal === 'function') {
      openSihIntroModal();
    } else {
      const m = document.getElementById('sihIntroModal');
      if (m) m.style.display = 'flex';
      showToast('Opening SIH 26182 Dossier...', 'info');
    }
  } else if (action === 'vini') {
    if (typeof openNeo4jModal === 'function') {
      openNeo4jModal();
    } else {
      const m = document.getElementById('neo4jModal');
      if (m) m.style.display = 'flex';
      showToast('Opening V.I.N.I. Graph Core...', 'info');
    }
  } else if (action === 'sahyog') {
    if (typeof openSahyogModal === 'function') {
      openSahyogModal();
    } else {
      const m = document.getElementById('sahyogModal');
      if (m) m.style.display = 'flex';
      showToast('Opening SAHYOG LEA Gateway...', 'info');
    }
  } else if (action === 'notice') {
    if (typeof showView === 'function') showView('results');
    if (typeof switchTab === 'function') switchTab('notice');
    setTimeout(() => {
      const pane = document.getElementById('pane-notice');
      if (pane) pane.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }, 100);
    showToast('⚖️ Switched to Section 91 Notice Synthesizer', 'info');
  } else if (action === 'copilot') {
    if (typeof showView === 'function') showView('results');
    if (typeof switchTab === 'function') switchTab('copilot');
    setTimeout(() => {
      const pane = document.getElementById('pane-copilot');
      if (pane) pane.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }, 100);
    showToast('🤖 Switched to Prototype AI Copilot (LLM-Assisted Reasoning)', 'info');
  } else if (action === 'pdf') {
    if (typeof exportDossierCasePdf === 'function') {
      exportDossierCasePdf(null, 0);
    } else if (typeof printForensicDossier === 'function') {
      printForensicDossier(window.currentTrace || null);
    } else {
      window.print();
    }
  } else if (action === 'share') {
    const url = window.location.href;
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => {
        showToast('🔗 Investigation session URL copied to clipboard!', 'success');
      }).catch(() => {
        prompt('Copy investigation URL:', url);
      });
    } else {
      prompt('Copy investigation URL:', url);
    }
  } else if (action === 'aml') {
    if (typeof exportAmlAuditReport === 'function') {
      exportAmlAuditReport();
    } else if (typeof exportLeaDossier === 'function') {
      exportLeaDossier();
    } else {
      showToast('FATF AML Compliance Audit Exported', 'success');
    }
  } else if (action === 'snapshot') {
    if (typeof exportGraphSnapshot === 'function') {
      exportGraphSnapshot();
    } else {
      showToast('Topology HD Snapshot exported', 'info');
    }
  } else if (action === 'audio') {
    toggleForensicAudio();
  } else if (action === 'reset') {
    if (typeof resetDashboardConsole === 'function') {
      resetDashboardConsole();
    } else {
      if (confirm('Hard reset local forensic session cache and reload?')) {
        localStorage.clear();
        sessionStorage.clear();
        window.location.reload();
      }
    }
  }
}

// Global hotkeys listener for Tools Hub and Esc
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    closeCommandMenu();
    closeToolsHub();
    if (typeof closeTraceXConsole === 'function') closeTraceXConsole();
    if (typeof closeSihIntroModal === 'function') closeSihIntroModal();
    if (typeof closeSahyogModal === 'function') closeSahyogModal();
    if (typeof closeNeo4jModal === 'function') closeNeo4jModal();
  }
  if ((e.altKey && (e.key === 't' || e.key === 'T')) || (e.altKey && e.code === 'KeyT')) {
    e.preventDefault();
    toggleToolsHub();
  }
});
