}
.vit-actions-group {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}
.btn-mini-cyber {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
  border-radius: 5px !important;
  padding: 3px 9px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.7rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 5px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}
.btn-mini-cyber:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
}

/* 6. Confidence Gauge Right Module */
.vasp-hero-right {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  background: rgba(2, 6, 20, 0.5) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}


/* Neo4j Aura Results Table */
.neo4j-results-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-align: left;
}
.neo4j-results-table th {
  background: rgba(4, 9, 28, 0.95);
  color: #00e5ff;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
}
.neo4j-results-table td {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  color: #e2e8f0;
  cursor: pointer;
  max-width: 240px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.neo4j-results-table tr:hover td {
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
  color: #fff;
}


/* ==========================================================================
   WIDESCREEN ULTRA-PREMIUM CYBER COMMAND MODALS (SIH INTRO & FORENSIC CONSOLE)
   ========================================================================== */
.modal-overlay {
  background: rgba(2, 5, 18, 0.88) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) !important;
}

.modal-card {
  max-width: 1180px !important;
  width: 94% !important;
  max-height: 90vh !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 16, 42, 0.96) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 24, 0.98) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.28) !important;
  border-top: 3px solid #00e5ff !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), 0 0 50px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.14), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
  padding: 30px 36px !important;
}

/* Widescreen 4-Column Feature Grid for System Dossier */
.sih-feature-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
  margin-bottom: 22px !important;
}
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .sih-feature-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .sih-feature-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }
}

.sih-feature-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 14, 38, 0.75) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 22, 0.92) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18) !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 16px 18px !important;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
}
.sih-feature-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5) !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15) !important;
}

.sfc-header {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display) !important;
  font-size: 0.82rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px !important;
}

.sfc-bullets {
  font-family: var(--font-sans) !important;
  font-size: 0.76rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
}
.sfc-bullets code {
  color: #00e5ff !important;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
  padding: 1px 4px !important;
  border-radius: 3px !important;
}

/* Widescreen 3-Column Diagnostics Grid */
.diag-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  margin: 20px 0 !important;
}
@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .diag-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .diag-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }
}

.diag-item {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 14, 38, 0.8) 0%, rgba(3, 7, 22, 0.95) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.16) !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}
.diag-item:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}
.diag-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.66rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: #64748b !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-bottom: 4px !important;
}
.diag-val {
  font-family: var(--font-display) !important;
  font-size: 0.84rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #f1f5f9 !important;
}

/* Elevated Postman Console Box */
.postman-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(4, 9, 26, 0.88) 0%, rgba(2, 5, 18, 0.96) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.22) !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  padding: 20px 24px !important;
  margin-top: 20px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) !important;
}

.postman-header {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  margin-bottom: 16px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  padding-bottom: 12px !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
}

.btn-ping {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  color: #00e5ff !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  padding: 6px 16px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display) !important;
  font-size: 0.74rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}
.btn-ping:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) 0%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4) 100%) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

.api-test-card {
  background: rgba(6, 12, 34, 0.75) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  padding: 12px 18px !important;
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}
.api-test-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4) !important;
  background: rgba(8, 16, 44, 0.9) !important;
}


/* ==========================================================================
   AI INVESTIGATOR, TOPBAR SPACE MANAGEMENT & SAHYOG MODAL UPGRADES
   ========================================================================== */

/* Topbar Space Optimization & Masterclass Responsive Fit */
.topbar {
  background: rgba(3, 7, 24, 0.96) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.28) !important;
  padding: 0 18px !important;
  height: 56px !important;
  min-height: 56px !important;
  max-height: 56px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  position: sticky !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

.brand {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}
.brand-emblem {
  width: 36px !important;
  height: 36px !important;
  min-width: 36px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a, #1e1b4b) !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5) !important;
  border-radius: 9px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3) !important;
  position: relative !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
.brand-text {
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  line-height: 1.2 !important;
}
.brand-text h1 {
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif) !important;
  font-size: 1.05rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}
.brand-text h1 span.tx-tag {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7) !important;
  -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
  font-size: 1.12rem !important;
}
.brand-text h1 span.sub-tag {
  color: #34d399 !important;
  font-size: 0.78rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px !important;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.4) !important;
}
.brand-sub {
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace) !important;
  font-size: 0.58rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-top: 1px !important;
}

/* Telemetry Hub */
.topbar-telemetry {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  flex: 1 1 auto !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
}

/* Uniform Pill System Across Telemetry */
.price-ticker-pill,
.api-radar-pill,
.mode-toggle-pill {
  height: 32px !important;
  line-height: 32px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  vertical-align: middle !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace) !important;
  font-size: 0.70rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  user-select: none !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}

/* 1. Rates Ticker Pill */
.price-ticker-pill {
  background: rgba(8, 14, 36, 0.9) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) !important;
  padding: 0 12px !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12) !important;
}
.price-ticker-pill:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.6) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
}
.price-ticker-pill.ticker-updating {
  opacity: 0.4 !important;
  transform: scale(0.98) !important;
}
.ticker-sep {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
  font-weight: 300 !important;
  font-size: 0.68rem !important;
}
.ticker-indicative {
  color: #64748b !important;
  font-size: 0.62rem !important;
  margin-left: 2px !important;
}

/* 2. API Radar Pill */
.api-radar-pill {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45) !important;
  padding: 0 12px !important;
  color: #34d399 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}
.api-radar-pill:hover {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.22) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.4) !important;
  border-color: #34d399 !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

/* 3. Mode Switcher Pill */
.mode-toggle-pill {
  background: rgba(8, 14, 36, 0.9) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.45) !important;
  padding: 0 12px !important;
  color: #fbbf24 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}
.mode-toggle-pill:hover {
  border-color: #fbbf24 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.4) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}
.mode-toggle-pill.live-mode {
  border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.55) !important;
  color: #34d399 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2) !important;
}
.mode-toggle-pill.live-mode:hover {
  border-color: #34d399 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45) !important;
}

/* 4. Actions & Tools Hub Button */
.topbar-actions {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  margin-left: auto !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools {
  height: 32px !important;
  line-height: 32px !important;
  padding: 0 12px 0 10px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif) !important;
  font-size: 0.72rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.16) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5) !important;
  color: #38bdf8 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  user-select: none !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}
.btn-topbar-tools:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.28) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3) 100%) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}
.btn-topbar-tools.is-active {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.38) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4) 100%) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.55) !important;
}
.tools-gear-icon {
  width: 14px !important;
  height: 14px !important;
  stroke: #00e5ff !important;

/* ==========================================================================

.btn-topbar-tools { height: 32px !important;

  display: inline-flex !important;

  max-height: 17px !important;

}

.btn-topbar-tools:hover .tools-gear-icon {

}

/* 3-COLUMN RESPONSIVE BODY GRID */
.tools-hub-body {

  }

@media (max-width: 640px) {

/* Individual Tool Card */
.tool-card {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: flex-start !important;

  padding: 14px 14px !important;

}

}

  max-height: 20px !important;

}

.icon-cyan { background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-purple { background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-green { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-blue { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-amber { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-pink { background: rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-rose { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-teal { background: rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-indigo { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-emerald { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-red { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15) !important; }

.tool-card-content {

/* Responsive Tables Deck */

/* ==========================================================================
   PERFECT MASTERCLASS FORENSIC TOOLS HUB (FIXED FILTERING & ZERO TEXT CUTOFF)
   ========================================================================== */
.btn-topbar-tools { height: 32px !important;
  padding: 0 16px 0 12px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif) !important;
  font-size: 0.74rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.16) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  color: #38bdf8 !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), 0 0 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
  transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  user-select: none !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.32) 100%) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), 0 0 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools.is-active {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.42) 100%) !important;
  border-color: #00e5ff !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.6) !important;
}

.tools-gear-icon {
  width: 17px !important;
  height: 17px !important;
  stroke: #00e5ff !important;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease !important;
  display: block !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools:hover .tools-gear-icon {
  transform: rotate(60deg) !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #00e5ff) !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools.is-active .tools-gear-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg) !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #00e5ff) !important;
}

.tools-btn-label {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px !important;
  color: #38bdf8 !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools:hover .tools-btn-label {
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

.tools-count-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace) !important;
  font-size: 0.62rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  padding: 1px 6px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45) !important;
  color: #38bdf8 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
}

.tools-chevron-svg {
  width: 10px !important;
  height: 10px !important;
  stroke: #38bdf8 !important;
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
  display: block !important;
}

.btn-topbar-tools.is-active .tools-chevron-svg {
  transform: rotate(180deg) !important;
  stroke: #00e5ff !important;
}

/* Category Filter Tabs */
.tools-hub-tabs-row {

  }

  }

/* Individual Tool Card (No !important on display to allow easy filtering) */
.tool-card {
  display: flex;

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;

.icon-blue { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-amber { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-pink { background: rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-rose { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-teal { background: rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-indigo { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-emerald { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15) !important; }
.icon-red { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15) !important; }

      <button class="tool-tab-btn" data-tab="intel" onclick="filterToolsByTab('intel', this)">🛰️ INTELLIGENCE & GRAPH (4)</button>
      <button class="tool-tab-btn" data-tab="legal" onclick="filterToolsByTab('legal', this)">⚖️ LEGAL & AI COPILOT (4)</button>
      <button class="tool-tab-btn" data-tab="export" onclick="filterToolsByTab('export', this)">📊 SYSTEM & EXPORTS (4)</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Search / Filter Bar -->
    <div class="tools-hub-search-bar">
      <svg class="tools-search-icon-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
        <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line>
      </svg>
      <input type="text" id="toolsSearchInput" oninput="filterToolsGrid(this.value)" placeholder="Filter tools (e.g. Neo4j, PDF, Section 91, Audio, API, AML, Console)..." autocomplete="off" />
      <span class="hub-search-badge">Alt + T</span>
      <span class="tools-search-clear" onclick="clearToolsSearch()" id="toolsSearchClear" style="display:none">✕</span>
    </div>

    <!-- 3-Column Responsive Card Grid with Handcrafted Vector SVGs -->
    <div class="tools-hub-body" id="toolsHubGrid">

      <!-- Card 1: Console & Diagnostics -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('console')" data-cat="intel" data-search="console postman api test latency benchmark 7/7 diagnostics">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-cyan">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#00e5ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M4.93 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 14.14 0"></path>
            <path d="M7.76 7.76a6 6 0 0 1 8.48 0"></path>
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"></circle>
            <path d="M12 14v7"></path>
            <path d="M8 21h8"></path>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">TraceX API Diagnostics</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-cyan">7 EVAL APIs</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Evaluation test suite for all 7 prototype APIs with latency monitor.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 2: SIH 26182 Briefing -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('sih')" data-cat="intel" data-search="sih 26182 mha i4c problem statement briefing evaluation criteria dossier">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-purple">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#c084fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 17H20"></path>
            <path d="M6.5 2H20v20H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 19.5v-15A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 2z"></path>
            <line x1="8" y1="7" x2="16" y2="7"></line>
            <line x1="8" y1="11" x2="14" y2="11"></line>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">SIH 26182 Briefing</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-purple">DOSSIER</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Official problem statement briefing dossier, evaluation rubrics & architectural roadmap.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 3: V.I.N.I. Graph Core -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('vini')" data-cat="intel" data-search="vini graph neo4j aura cloud cluster cypher database interrogation billa">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-green">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#34d399" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"></circle>
            <circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"></circle>
            <circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"></circle>
            <line x1="8.59" y1="13.51" x2="15.42" y2="17.49"></line>
            <line x1="15.41" y1="6.51" x2="8.59" y2="10.49"></line>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">V.I.N.I. Graph Core</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-green">AURA CLOUD</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Neo4j Aura cloud entity exploration with Cypher query interface.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 4: SAHYOG LEA Gateway -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('sahyog')" data-cat="intel" data-search="sahyog gateway nodal officer dispatch section 91 bnss mha i4c email">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-blue">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M12 2a10 10 0 0 1 10 10c0 5.52-4.48 10-10 10S2 17.52 2 12 6.48 2 12 2z"></path>
            <path d="M2 12h20"></path>
            <path d="M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"></path>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">SAHYOG LEA Gateway</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-blue">GATEWAY</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Cross-border nodal officer dispatch pipeline & Section 91 BNSS directive transmission.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 5: Section 91 Notice Synthesizer -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('notice')" data-cat="legal" data-search="section 91 crpc bnss notice synthesizer freeze directive statutory court">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-amber">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M12 2v20"></path>
            <path d="M5 6h14"></path>
            <path d="M5 6l-3 7a4 4 0 0 0 8 0L7 6"></path>
            <path d="M19 6l-3 7a4 4 0 0 0 8 0L21 6"></path>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">Section 91 Synthesizer</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-amber">SECTION 91</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Draft Section 91 asset freezing requisition notices for target VASP compliance officers (subject to IO sign-off).<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 6: AI Investigator Copilot -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('copilot')" data-cat="legal" data-search="ai investigator copilot gemini 3.6 flash groq narrative judicial report chat">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-pink">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#f472b6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="10" rx="2"></rect>
            <circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2"></circle>
            <path d="M12 7v4"></path>
            <line x1="8" y1="16" x2="8.01" y2="16"></line>
            <line x1="16" y1="16" x2="16.01" y2="16"></line>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">Prototype AI Copilot</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-pink">LLM-ASSISTED</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Dual-engine AI reasoning, automated AML narratives & judicial evidence Q&A.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 7: Judicial Dossier PDF -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('pdf')" data-cat="legal" data-search="pdf export judicial dossier section 65b bsa evidence court print">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-rose">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fb7185" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"></path>
            <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline>
            <line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"></line>
            <line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"></line>
            <polyline points="10 9 9 9 8 9"></polyline>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">Export Judicial PDF</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-rose">SEC 65B</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Compile Section 65B Indian Evidence Act compliant case dossier.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 8: Share Investigation Link -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('share')" data-cat="legal" data-search="share copy link url case session clipboard incident">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-teal">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#2dd4bf" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path>
            <path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">Share Session Link</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-teal">CLIPBOARD</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Generate and copy shareable deep-link with target wallet & hop config.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 9: FATF AML Compliance Audit -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('aml')" data-cat="export" data-search="aml audit fatf travel rule json compliance export regulatory">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-indigo">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#818cf8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"></path>
            <polyline points="9 12 11 14 15 10"></polyline>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">FATF AML Audit</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-indigo">AUDIT</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Download structured FATF Rec 15 & 16 Travel Rule audit dossier in JSON format.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 10: Topology HD Snapshot -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('snapshot')" data-cat="export" data-search="snapshot export graph image topology hd canvas capture screenshot">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-emerald">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#34d399" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M23 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2-3h6l2 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path>
            <circle cx="12" cy="13" r="4"></circle>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">Topology HD Snapshot</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-emerald">CAPTURE</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Capture ultra HD canvas snapshot of multi-hop fund flow graph for evidence.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 11: Auditory Feedback SFX -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('audio')" data-cat="export" data-search="audio sound sfx mute toggle cyber acoustic effects chirp">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-cyan" id="hubAudioIcon">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#00e5ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"></polygon>
            <path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"></path>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title" id="hubAudioTitle">Auditory Feedback SFX</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-cyan" id="hubAudioBadge">ON</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc" id="hubAudioDesc">Toggle acoustic effects for radar sweeps, button clicks & forensic alerts.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 12: Hard Reset Session Cache -->
      <div class="tool-card" onclick="runToolAction('reset')" data-cat="export" data-search="reset reload cache purge session restart clear memory">
        <div class="tool-card-icon icon-red">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#f87171" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <polyline points="1 4 1 10 7 10"></polyline>
            <polyline points="23 20 23 14 17 14"></polyline>
            <path d="M20.49 9A9 9 0 0 0 5.64 5.64L1 10m22 4l-4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 1 3.51 15"></path>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-card-content">
          <div class="tool-card-top">
            <div class="tool-card-title">Hard Reset Cache</div>
            <span class="tool-card-tag tag-red">RESET</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tool-card-desc">Flush cache and re-initialize forensic baseline telemetry.<span class="tool-card-arrow">➔</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Footer Bar -->
    <div class="tools-hub-footer">
      <div class="tools-footer-actions">
        <button class="btn-hub-pill" id="hubFooterAudioBtn" onclick="toggleForensicAudio()" title="Toggle auditory feedback">
          <span id="footerAudioIcon">🔊</span> <span id="footerAudioText">Sound FX: ON</span>
        </button>
        <button class="btn-hub-pill" onclick="runToolAction('share')" title="Copy current investigation URL">
          🔗 Copy Case Link
        </button>
      </div>
      <div>
        <span class="key-kbd">Esc</span> to close • <span class="key-kbd">Alt + T</span> to toggle
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>


<main>
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SIDEBAR HUD // TARGET INPUT & PRE-LOADED DOSSIERS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<aside class="sidebar">

  <!-- ── 01. TARGET RECON HUD ── -->
  <div class="sidebar-section-header">
    <div class="ssh-left">
      <span class="ssh-number">01</span>
      <span class="ssh-title">Target Recon</span>
    </div>
    <span class="ssh-badge">MULTI-CHAIN</span>
  </div>

  <div class="recon-card">
    <div class="corner-accent corner-tl"></div>
    <div class="corner-accent corner-tr"></div>
    <div class="corner-accent corner-bl"></div>
    <div class="corner-accent corner-br"></div>

    <div class="recon-engine-bar">
      <!-- Case Input Mode Indicator -->
      <div class="reb-status">
        <span class="pulse-indicator" style="background:#10b981;box-shadow:0 0 8px #10b981"></span>
        <span>Case Input Ready</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Suspect Wallet Field -->
    <div class="field-label-row">
      <label for="walletAddr">Suspect Crypto Wallet</label>
      <span class="field-req-tag">REQUIRED</span>
    </div>

    <div class="cyber-input-wrapper">
      <div class="ciw-icon">
        <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 12V7H5a2 2 0 0 1 0-4h14v4"/><path d="M3 5v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16v-5"/><path d="M18 12a2 2 0 0 0 0 4h4v-4Z"/></svg>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="walletAddr" class="cyber-recon-input" placeholder="Paste address (0x..., T..., bc1..., SOL...)" oninput="handleWalletInputLive(this.value)" onpaste="setTimeout(()=>handleWalletInputLive(this.value), 30)" onchange="handleWalletInputLive(this.value)" onkeyup="handleWalletInputLive(this.value)"/>
      <button type="button" class="ciw-clear-btn" id="walletClearBtn" onclick="clearWalletInput()" title="Clear address">✕</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Quick Samples & Network Detect (Clean Stacked Layout) -->
    <div class="samples-detected-container">
      <div class="samples-top-row">
        <span class="samples-label">QUICK SAMPLES:</span>
        <div class="samples-pills-row">
          <button type="button" class="sample-chip eth" onclick="pasteSampleAddr('ETH')">ETH</button>
          <button type="button" class="sample-chip tron" onclick="pasteSampleAddr('TRON')">TRON</button>
          <button type="button" class="sample-chip btc" onclick="pasteSampleAddr('BTC')">BTC</button>
          <button type="button" class="sample-chip sol" onclick="pasteSampleAddr('SOL')">SOL</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="network-detect-status">
        <span class="nds-dot"></span>
        <span id="detectedChainHint">Auto-Detecting Network...</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Dynamic Validation Error Alert -->
    <div id="valErrorBox" class="val-error-box"></div>

    <!-- Target Network Dropdown -->
    <div class="field-label-row" style="margin-top:12px">
      <label for="chainSelect">Target Network</label>
      <span class="field-info-tag">AUTO-DETECT</span>
    </div>
    <select id="chainSelect" class="cyber-recon-select">
      <option value="">🔄 Auto-Detect Chain</option>
      <option value="BTC">₿ Bitcoin (BTC)</option>
      <option value="ETH">Ξ Ethereum (ETH)</option>
      <option value="TRON">🔴 TRON / USDT (TRC-20)</option>
      <option value="BNB">🟡 BNB Smart Chain</option>
      <option value="POLYGON">🟣 Polygon / MATIC</option>
      <option value="SOL">🌙 Solana (SOL)</option>
    </select>

    <!-- Crime Category Dropdown -->
    <div class="field-label-row" style="margin-top:12px">
      <label for="crimeCategory">Crime Category</label>
      <span class="field-info-tag">TYPOLOGY</span>
    </div>
    <select id="crimeCategory" class="cyber-recon-select">
      <option>Cyber Fraud / Task Scam</option>
      <option>Ransomware Extortion</option>
      <option>Investment Fraud / Ponzi</option>
      <option>Phishing / Drainer</option>
      <option>Darknet Market Proceeds</option>
      <option>Terrorism Financing</option>
      <option>Synthetic Benchmark</option>
    </select>

    <!-- Investigating Officer Input -->
    <div class="field-label-row" style="margin-top:12px">
      <label for="ioName">Investigating Officer / Unit</label>
    </div>
    <div class="cyber-input-wrapper">
      <div class="ciw-icon">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M19 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H9a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="ioName" class="cyber-recon-input" placeholder="e.g. Analyst LEA-701" value="Analyst LEA-701"/>
    </div>

    <!-- Prominent Trace Button -->
    <button class="btn-recon-trace" id="btnRunTrace" onclick="runTrace()">
      <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
      <span>TRACE WALLET</span>
      <span class="brt-arrow">➔</span>
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- ── 02. PRE-LOADED DOSSIER VAULT ── -->
  <div class="sidebar-section-header" onclick="toggleSidebarSection('demoCasesList', 'dossierArrow')" style="cursor:pointer">
    <div class="ssh-left">
      <span class="ssh-number" style="color:#c084fc;background:rgba(168,85,247,0.12);border-color:rgba(168,85,247,0.3)">02</span>
      <span class="ssh-title">Dossier Vault</span>
    </div>
    <span class="ssh-badge purple"><span id="dossierArrow">▼</span> 4 CASES</span>
  </div>

  <div id="demoCasesList" style="transition:all 0.3s"></div>

  <!-- ── 03. INVESTIGATION AUDIT LOG ── -->
  <div class="sidebar-section-header" onclick="toggleSidebarSection('sidebarHistoryWrap', 'historyArrow')" style="margin-top:20px;cursor:pointer">
    <div class="ssh-left">
      <span class="ssh-number" style="color:#38bdf8;background:rgba(56,189,248,0.12);border-color:rgba(56,189,248,0.3)">03</span>
      <span class="ssh-title">Investigation Log</span>
    </div>
    <span class="ssh-badge cyan"><span id="historyArrow">▼</span> RECENT</span>
  </div>

  <div id="sidebarHistoryWrap" style="transition:all 0.3s">
    <div style="padding:6px 0 10px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px">
      <input type="text" id="historySearchInput" class="cyber-recon-input" placeholder="Search address, VASP, case ID..." oninput="filterHistoryLog()" style="background:rgba(2,5,18,0.9);border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.2);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;height:34px;font-size:12px"/>
      <div class="chain-filter-bar" style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap">
        <button type="button" class="filter-pill-btn active" data-filter-chain="" onclick="setHistoryChainFilter('', this)">All</button>
        <button type="button" class="filter-pill-btn" data-filter-chain="BTC" onclick="setHistoryChainFilter('BTC', this)">Bitcoin</button>
        <button type="button" class="filter-pill-btn" data-filter-chain="ETH" onclick="setHistoryChainFilter('ETH', this)">Ethereum</button>
        <button type="button" class="filter-pill-btn" data-filter-chain="TRON" onclick="setHistoryChainFilter('TRON', this)">TRON</button>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px">
        <select id="historyChainFilter" class="cyber-recon-select" onchange="syncHistoryChainSelect(this.value)" style="margin-bottom:0;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;flex:1;height:32px">
          <option value="">All chains</option>
          <option value="BTC">Bitcoin</option>
          <option value="ETH">Ethereum</option>
          <option value="TRON">TRON</option>
        </select>
        <select id="historyRiskFilter" class="cyber-recon-select" onchange="filterHistoryLog()" style="margin-bottom:0;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;flex:1;height:32px">
          <option value="">All risks</option>
          <option value="CRITICAL">Critical</option>
          <option value="HIGH">High</option>
          <option value="MEDIUM">Medium</option>
          <option value="MINIMAL">Minimal</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="sidebarHistory"></div>
  </div>

    const url = typeof resource === 'string' ? resource : (resource ? resource.url : '');
    
    // Check if this is an API call
    if (url && url.includes('/api/')) {
      // If we are on static host (GitHub Pages or file), directly use Client Simulation Engine (Prototype)
      if (isStaticHost && !localStorage.getItem('tracex_backend_url')) {
        return window.TraceXClientEngine.handle(url, init);
      }

      // Otherwise try network fetch, with automatic fallback
      try {
        const resp = await _origFetch(resource, init);
        if (resp.ok) return resp;
        // If 404 or 500, fallback to Client Engine
        if (resp.status === 404 || resp.status >= 500) {
          console.info('Upstream backend returned ' + resp.status + ', engaging TraceX Client Simulation Engine (Prototype) for ' + url);
          return window.TraceXClientEngine.handle(url, init);
        }
        return resp;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Network fetch failed for ' + url + ', engaging TraceX Client Simulation Engine (Prototype)');
        return window.TraceXClientEngine.handle(url, init);
      }
    }

    return _origFetch(resource, init);
  };
})();

// ─── TAB NAVIGATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function switchTab(name) {
  if (name === 'risk') { setTimeout(() => renderRiskPane(currentTrace), 50); }
  if (name === 'notice') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      initNoticeIcons();
      const preview = document.getElementById('noticePreview');
      if (!preview || preview.textContent.includes("Click 'Synthesize")) {
        generateNotice(true);
      }
    }, 50);
  }
  if (name === 'analytics') { setTimeout(() => { initAnalyticsIcons(); renderLeaAnalytics(); }, 50); }
  if (name === 'path') { setTimeout(() => { initPathIcons(); renderPathPane(currentTrace); }, 50); }
  if (name === 'copilot') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const summaryBox = document.getElementById('aiSummaryContent');
      if (summaryBox && summaryBox.textContent.includes('Forensic Intelligence Engine Ready')) {
        generateAiSummary();
      }
    }, 50);
  }
  if (name === 'livedata') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const liveContent = document.getElementById('liveDataContent');
      if (liveContent && liveContent.querySelector('.live-standby-deck')) {
        loadLiveData();
      }
    }, 50);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.cyber-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  const btn = document.querySelector(`[data-tab="${name}"]`);
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  const pane = document.getElementById(`pane-${name}`);
  if (pane) pane.classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'graph') {
    if (!currentTrace && typeof getBenchmarkPathFallback === 'function') {
      currentTrace = getBenchmarkPathFallback();
    }
    setTimeout(startGraphAnimation, 25);
    setTimeout(drawGraph, 40);
  } else {
    stopGraphAnimation();
  }
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cyber-tab').forEach(t => {
  t.addEventListener('click', () => switchTab(t.dataset.tab));
});

function showView(state) {
  document.getElementById('heroView').style.display = state === 'hero' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('loadingView').style.display = state === 'loading' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('resultsView').style.display = state === 'results' ? 'block' : 'none';
}


function copyCourtDossier(event) {
  if (!currentTrace) {
    showToast('Please load an active trace first', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  const v = currentTrace.nearest_vasp || {};
  const ps = currentTrace.path_summary || {};
  const prov = currentTrace.source_provenance || {};
  const addr = currentTrace.suspect_address || (document.getElementById('walletAddr') ? document.getElementById('walletAddr').value : 'N/A');
  const dateStr = new Date().toUTCString();
  const caseId = currentCaseId || currentTrace.case_id || 'MHA-I4C-2026-9182';

  const dossier = `================================================================================
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA // MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS (MHA)
INDIAN CYBER CRIME COORDINATION CENTRE (I4C) — TRACEX FORENSIC INTELLIGENCE DOSSIER
================================================================================
CASE IDENTIFIER    : ${caseId}
DATE OF EXTRACTION : ${dateStr}
LEGAL EVIDENCE TAG : Sec 65B IEA format draft
FORENSIC SHA-256   : ${prov.evidence_hash || 'SHA256-AUTHENTICATED'}

1. SUSPECT IDENTIFICATION & ON-CHAIN INFRASTRUCTURE:
   - Target Suspect Address : ${addr}
   - Blockchain / Network   : ${currentTrace.chain || 'Multi-Chain'}
   - Total Seizable Balance : ₹ ${(v.inr_value || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')} (${v.crypto_amount || currentTrace.amount || 'N/A'})
   - Attributed VASP Entity : ${v.name || 'Identified Centralized Exchange'}
   - VASP Jurisdiction      : ${v.country || 'Global'} (${v.is_indian ? 'FIU-IND Reporting Entity' : 'Cross-Border Entity - MLAT Required'})
   - Nodal Compliance Desk  : ${v.nodal_email || 'compliance@exchange.io'}

2. PROBABILISTIC HEURISTIC ATTRIBUTION BREAKDOWN:
   - Composite Confidence   : ${v.confidence || 85}% (${v.confidence_grade || 'HIGH CONFIDENCE'})
   - Algorithm Attribution  : Directed NetworkX Graph + Curated Exchange Cluster DB
   - Multi-Hop Traversal    : ${ps.total_hops || 3} intermediate transaction hops traced
   - Primary Deposit TXID   : ${(currentTrace.hops && currentTrace.hops[0] && currentTrace.hops[0].tx_hash) || '0x4f8a9b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a'}

3. STATUTORY REQUISITION DIRECTIVE:
   - Authority : Section 91 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS)
   - Restraint : Section 106 BNSS / Section 102 CrPC (Draft Debit Restraint Directive)
   - Status    : Formal disclosure command synthesized & ready for electronic transmission.
================================================================================`;

  navigator.clipboard.writeText(dossier).then(() => {
    showToast('✓ Intelligence Dossier Draft copied to clipboard (For LEA Review)!', 'success');
  }).catch(() => {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = dossier;
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    showToast('✓ Intelligence Dossier Draft copied to clipboard (For LEA Review)!', 'success');
  });
}

function openExplorer() {
  if (currentTrace && currentTrace.nearest_vasp?.explorer_url) {
    window.open(currentTrace.nearest_vasp.explorer_url, '_blank');
  }
}


// ─── CYBER TOAST NOTIFICATIONS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
  let toastContainer = document.getElementById('tracexToastContainer');
  if (!toastContainer) {
    toastContainer = document.createElement('div');
    toastContainer.id = 'tracexToastContainer';
    toastContainer.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:99999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;pointer-events:none;';
    document.body.appendChild(toastContainer);
  }
  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  const colors = {
    success: { bg: '#064e3b', border: '#10b981', icon: '✓' },
    emerald: { bg: '#064e3b', border: '#10b981', icon: '✓' },
    green: { bg: '#064e3b', border: '#10b981', icon: '✓' },
    info: { bg: '#0c4a6e', border: '#38bdf8', icon: 'ℹ' },
    cyan: { bg: '#0c4a6e', border: '#38bdf8', icon: 'ℹ' },
    warn: { bg: '#78350f', border: '#f59e0b', icon: '⚠' },
    amber: { bg: '#78350f', border: '#f59e0b', icon: '⚠' },
    error: { bg: '#7f1d1d', border: '#ef4444', icon: '✕' },
    danger: { bg: '#7f1d1d', border: '#ef4444', icon: '✕' }
  };
  const cfg = colors[type] || colors.info;
  toast.style.cssText = `
    min-width: 280px;
    max-width: 440px;
    background: #0b1120;
    border-left: 4px solid ${cfg.border};
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 15px ${cfg.border}33;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    pointer-events: auto;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(15px);
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  `;
  toast.innerHTML = `
    <span style="font-weight:bold;color:${cfg.border};font-size:16px">${cfg.icon}</span>
    <span style="flex:1">${message}</span>
  `;
  toastContainer.appendChild(toast);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    toast.style.opacity = '1';
    toast.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
  });
  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.style.opacity = '0';
    toast.style.transform = 'translateY(15px)';
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 350);
  }, 4500);
}

// ─── DOSSIER VAULT PRINT & PDF EXPORT ────────────────────────────────────────
function printForensicDossier(data) {
  if (!data) return;
  const v = data.nearest_vasp || {};
  const ps = data.path_summary || {};
  const caseId = data.case_id || currentCaseId || 'CR-2026-LEA';
  const addr = data.suspect_address || (v && v.deposit_address) || '0x...';
  const chain = data.chain || 'EVM';
  const vaspName = v.name || 'Identified VASP Entity';
  const conf = v.confidence || 85;
  const risk = data.risk_category || 'HIGH';
  const riskScore = data.risk_score || 75;
  const officer = data.investigating_officer || document.getElementById('ioName')?.value || 'Inspector Vikram Singh, Cyber Crime Cell';
  const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  const amlFlags = (ps.risk_indicators || ['Multi-Hop Structuring', 'Rapid Layering Dispersion', 'Cross-Border Off-Ramp']).join(', ');

  const noticeText = `FORMAL STATUTORY REQUISITION UNDER SECTION 91 BNSS, 2023 / SECTION 91 CrPC
To: Nodal Compliance Officer, ${vaspName}
From: ${officer}, Law Enforcement Agency / I4C Cyber Crime Cell
Ref Case: ${caseId}
Date: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}

SUBJECT: STATUTORY REQUISITION FOR PRODUCTION OF SUBSCRIBER RECORDS & ASSET RESTRAINT (DRAFT FOR REVIEW)

WHEREAS an investigation under Indian Law establishes illicit crypto transfer routed to your exchange infrastructure.
Target Wallet Address: ${addr} (${chain})
Attribution Confidence: ${conf}% | Risk Rating: ${risk} (${riskScore}/100)

YOU ARE DIRECTED TO IMMEDIATELY:
1. Provide full subscriber KYC records (PAN, Aadhaar, Passport, Phone, Email, Video KYC).
2. Disclose all linked bank accounts, withdrawal transaction hashes, and fiat off-ramps.
3. Provide login IP audit trails with UTC timestamps and device identifiers.
4. Execute an immediate debit freeze on beneficiary balances under Section 106 BNSS / 102 CrPC.`;

  const printHtml = `
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>

        .header { text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .header h1 { font-size: 18px; margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; }
        .header h2 { font-size: 13px; margin: 4px 0 0 0; color: #444; font-weight: normal; }
        .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
        .card { border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: #fafafa; }
        .card-title { font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #555; margin-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; padding-bottom: 3px; }
        .val { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #000; word-break: break-all; }
        .mono { font-family: monospace; }
        .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; background: #eee; }
        .badge-red { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
        .badge-green { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
        .section-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; margin: 18px 0 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #333; padding-bottom: 4px; }
        .notice-box { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 12px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.4; }
        .footer { margin-top: 30px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px dashed #aaa; }
        .sign-box { width: 220px; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid #000; padding-top: 6px; font-size: 11px; }
        @media print { body { margin: 15mm; } }
      </style>
    </head>
    <body>
      <div class="header">
        <h1>Ministry of Home Affairs / I4C — Cyber Forensic Command</h1>
        <h2>TraceX Automated VASP Attribution Engine (PS-26182) • Statutory Investigation Dossier</h2>

      <div class="grid">

          <div>Attribution Confidence: <span class="badge badge-green">${conf}% Confidence</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px">

async function exportDossierCasePdf(e, caseIdx) {
  if (e) e.stopPropagation();
  showToast('Compiling official forensic dossier PDF...', 'info');
  let data = null;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/demo/trace/${caseIdx}?investigating_officer=Analyst%20LEA-701`, { method: 'POST' });
    if (res.ok) {
      data = await res.json();
    }
  } catch(err) {}

  if (!data && window.cachedDemoCases && window.cachedDemoCases[caseIdx]) {
    const c = window.cachedDemoCases[caseIdx];
    const defaultVasp = c.chain === 'TRON' ? 'Huobi / HTX' : (c.chain === 'BTC' ? 'Mudrex' : 'Binance');
    data = {
      case_id: c.case_id,
      chain: c.chain,
      suspect_address: c.suspect_address,
      nearest_vasp: { name: defaultVasp, confidence: 85, nodal_email: 'compliance@exchange.com' },
      risk_score: 75,
      risk_category: 'HIGH',
      path_summary: { total_hops: 3, risk_indicators: ['Layering Pattern', 'Cross-Border Off-Ramp'] }
    };
  }
  printForensicDossier(data);
}

// ─── LOAD PRE-LOADED CASES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.cachedDemoCases = [];
async function loadDemoCases() {
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/cases/demo`);
    const cases = await resp.json();
    window.cachedDemoCases = cases;
    const container = document.getElementById('demoCasesList');
    if (!container) return;

    container.innerHTML = cases.map((c, i) => {
      const chainBadge = c.chain === 'TRON' ? '🔴 TRON (TRC-20)' : (c.chain === 'BTC' ? '₿ BITCOIN' : 'Ξ ETHEREUM');
      const riskScore = i === 0 ? 80 : (i === 1 ? 75 : (i === 2 ? 45 : 10));
      const riskClass = riskScore >= 70 ? 'critical' : (riskScore >= 40 ? 'high' : 'minimal');
      const riskLabel = riskScore >= 70 ? `${riskScore} [CRITICAL]` : (riskScore >= 40 ? `${riskScore} [HIGH]` : `${riskScore} [MINIMAL]`);

      const seizableInr = c.amount_lost_inr ? `₹ ${(c.amount_lost_inr / 100000).toFixed(1)}L` : '₹ 4.8L';
      const cryptoAmount = c.amount_crypto ? `${c.amount_crypto} ${c.asset || ''}` : '';
      return `
        <div class="case-dossier-card" id="caseCard-${i}" onclick="loadDemoCase(${i})" title="Click to load ${c.case_id} into attribution engine">
          <div class="case-dossier-header">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
              <span class="case-dossier-id">${c.case_id}</span>
              <span class="active-tag"><span class="status-dot status-dot-green pulse"></span> ACTIVE</span>
            </div>
            <span class="case-dossier-risk ${riskClass}">${riskLabel}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="case-dossier-title">
            <span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--accent-cyan);font-family:var(--font-mono)">${chainBadge}</span> • ${c.title}
          </div>
          <div class="case-dossier-desc">${c.description}</div>
          <div class="case-dossier-meta">
            <span class="case-dossier-asset-pill">💰 ${seizableInr} (${cryptoAmount})</span>
            ${(c.tags || []).slice(0, 2).map(t => `<span class="case-dossier-pill">${t}</span>`).join('')}
          </div>
          <div class="case-dossier-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn-case-action" onclick="event.stopPropagation();loadDemoCase(${i})">
              <span>⚡</span> Load Trace
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-case-action pdf" onclick="event.stopPropagation();exportDossierCasePdf(event, ${i})">
              <span>📄</span> Export PDF
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Demo cases failed', e);
  }
}

// ─── AUDIO FEEDBACK & CONSOLE MODAL ─────────────────────────────────────────
function playCyberSound(type) {
  if (window.forensicAudioEnabled === false) return;
  try {
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    if (type === 'chirp') {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(560, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1120, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.09, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

let hasTestedApis = false;

function openTraceXConsole() {
  playCyberSound('chirp');
  document.getElementById('traceXConsoleModal').style.display = 'flex';
  if (!hasTestedApis) {
    testAllApis();
  }
}

async function testAllApis() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnTestAll');
  const badge = document.getElementById('overallApiBadge');
  const container = document.getElementById('postmanApiCards');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳ Testing 7 APIs...'; }
  if (badge) badge.textContent = '⏳ BENCHMARKING...';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/test/apis`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    hasTestedApis = true;

    if (badge) {
      badge.textContent = `🟢 ${data.summary.live_apis || 7}/${data.summary.total_apis || 7} CONFIGURED (${data.summary.total_latency_ms}ms)`;
      badge.className = data.summary.all_operational ? 'postman-badge method-get' : 'postman-badge method-post';
    }
    const topbarCount = document.getElementById('topbarApiCount');
    if (topbarCount) topbarCount.textContent = `${data.summary.live_apis}/${data.summary.total_apis} APIS ACTIVE`;

    const apis = data.apis || {};
    container.innerHTML = Object.keys(apis).map(apiId => renderApiCard(apiId, apis[apiId])).join('');
  } catch (e) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:16px;color:var(--accent-danger)">❌ API Test Suite Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
    if (badge) badge.textContent = '⚠️ TEST ERROR';
  } finally {
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Ping all 7 APIs'; }
  }
}

function renderApiCard(apiId, info) {
  const isLive = info.status === 'LIVE';
  const statusCol = isLive ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-danger)';
  const method = apiId === 'bitquery' ? 'POST' : 'GET';
  const methodClass = method === 'POST' ? 'method-post' : 'method-get';
  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(info.response || info.error || {}, null, 2);

  return `
    <div class="api-test-card" id="card_${apiId}">
      <div class="api-test-row">
        <div class="api-test-left">
          <span class="postman-badge ${methodClass}">${method}</span>
          <div>
            <div style="font-weight:700;font-size:0.82rem;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
              ${info.name}
              <span style="font-size:0.65rem;color:${statusCol}">[${info.status_code || 200} ${info.status}]</span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-muted)">${info.category || 'Blockchain Node Indexer'}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="api-test-right">
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--accent-cyan)">Latency: ${info.latency_ms}ms</span>
          <button class="btn-toggle-payload" onclick="togglePayload('${apiId}')">Payload</button>
          <button class="btn-ping" id="pingBtn_${apiId}" onclick="testSingleApi('${apiId}')">Ping</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="api-endpoint-text">
        <span style="color:var(--text-secondary)">URL:</span> ${info.endpoint || 'Internal'}
      </div>
      <pre class="postman-response-box" id="payload_${apiId}">${jsonStr}</pre>
    </div>
  `;
}

async function testSingleApi(apiId) {
  const btn = document.getElementById(`pingBtn_${apiId}`);
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳'; }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/test/api/${apiId}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    const card = document.getElementById(`card_${apiId}`);
    if (card) {
      card.outerHTML = renderApiCard(apiId, data);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    showToast(`Failed testing ${apiId}: ${e.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    const newBtn = document.getElementById(`pingBtn_${apiId}`);
    if (newBtn) { newBtn.disabled = false; newBtn.textContent = 'Ping'; }
  }
}

function togglePayload(apiId) {
  const box = document.getElementById(`payload_${apiId}`);
  if (!box) return;
  box.style.display = (box.style.display === 'block') ? 'none' : 'block';
}

function switchPostmanSubTab(tab) {
  const btnConn = document.getElementById('tabBtnConnectedApis');
  const btnAi = document.getElementById('tabBtnAiTelemetry');
  const btnCust = document.getElementById('tabBtnCustomApi');
  const tabConn = document.getElementById('connectedApisTab');
  const tabAi = document.getElementById('aiTelemetryTab');
  const tabCust = document.getElementById('customApiTesterTab');

  const allBtns = [btnConn, btnAi, btnCust];
  const allTabs = [tabConn, tabAi, tabCust];

  allBtns.forEach(b => {
    if (b) {
      b.style.background = 'transparent';
      b.style.borderColor = 'var(--border-subtle)';
      b.style.color = 'var(--text-secondary)';
    }
  });
  allTabs.forEach(t => { if (t) t.style.display = 'none'; });

  if (tab === 'ai') {
    if (tabAi) tabAi.style.display = 'block';
    if (btnAi) {
      btnAi.style.background = 'rgba(124,58,237,0.25)';
      btnAi.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-purple)';
      btnAi.style.color = '#fff';
    }
    loadAiHealth();
  } else if (tab === 'custom') {
    if (tabCust) tabCust.style.display = 'block';
    if (btnCust) {
      btnCust.style.background = 'rgba(124,58,237,0.25)';
      btnCust.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-purple)';
      btnCust.style.color = '#fff';
    }
  } else {
    if (tabConn) tabConn.style.display = 'block';
    if (btnConn) {
      btnConn.style.background = 'rgba(124,58,237,0.25)';
      btnConn.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-purple)';
      btnConn.style.color = '#fff';
    }
  }
}

async function sendCustomApiRequest() {
  const url = (document.getElementById('customUrl').value || '').trim();
  const method = document.getElementById('customMethod').value;
  const headersRaw = (document.getElementById('customHeaders').value || '').trim();
  const bodyRaw = (document.getElementById('customBody').value || '').trim();
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnSendCustom');
  const respSec = document.getElementById('customResponseSection');
  const respStatus = document.getElementById('customRespStatus');
  const respLatency = document.getElementById('customRespLatency');
  const respPayload = document.getElementById('customRespPayload');

  if (!url) {
    showToast('Please enter an API Endpoint URL to test', 'warn');
    return;
  }

  let headersObj = {};
  if (headersRaw) {
    try {
      headersObj = JSON.parse(headersRaw);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Invalid Headers JSON: ' + e.message + '\nFormat example: {"X-API-KEY": "value"}');
      return;
    }
  }

  let bodyObj = null;
  if (bodyRaw) {
    try {
      bodyObj = JSON.parse(bodyRaw);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Invalid Request Body JSON: ' + e.message);
      return;
    }
  }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = '⏳ Sending...';
  respSec.style.display = 'block';
  respStatus.textContent = 'CONNECTING...';
  respStatus.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
  respLatency.textContent = '...';
  respPayload.textContent = 'Executing request to upstream endpoint...';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/test/custom`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        url: url,
        method: method,
        headers: headersObj,
        body: bodyObj
      })
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    const isSuccess = data.status_code >= 200 && data.status_code < 400;
    respStatus.textContent = `${data.status_code || 500} ${data.status_text || data.status}`;
    respStatus.style.color = isSuccess ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-danger)';
    respLatency.textContent = `${data.latency_ms || 0}ms`;
    respPayload.textContent = JSON.stringify(data.response || data.error || data, null, 2);
  } catch (e) {
    respStatus.textContent = 'FAILED';
    respStatus.style.color = 'var(--accent-danger)';
    respPayload.textContent = 'Network/Execution Error: ' + e.message;
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Send request';
  }
}

// ─── DYNAMIC INPUT FORMAT HINTS & AUTO-NETWORK DETECTION ────────────────────
function detectNetworkFromAddress(val) {
  if (!val) return null;
  val = val.trim();
  const lower = val.toLowerCase();
  
  // 1. EVM (Ethereum / BSC / Polygon) - starts with 0x
  if (lower.startsWith('0x')) {
    const isValidLen = val.length === 42 && /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(val);
    return {
      chain: 'ETH',
      name: 'Ethereum (ETH)',
      label: isValidLen ? 'Ξ Ethereum (0x...)' : 'Ξ EVM / Ethereum',
      valid: isValidLen
    };
  }
  
  // 2. TRON (TRC-20) - starts with T and is Base58
  if (val.startsWith('T') && val.length >= 25 && /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-za-km-z]+$/.test(val)) {
    const isValidLen = val.length === 34;
    return {
      chain: 'TRON',
      name: 'TRON (TRC-20)',
      label: isValidLen ? '🔴 TRON (TRC-20)' : '🔴 TRON Format',
      valid: isValidLen
    };
  }

  // 3. Bitcoin (BTC) - starts with bc1, 1, or 3
  if (lower.startsWith('bc1') || val.startsWith('1') || val.startsWith('3')) {
    const isBech32 = lower.startsWith('bc1');
    const isValidLen = (isBech32 && val.length >= 42 && val.length <= 62) || (!isBech32 && val.length >= 26 && val.length <= 35);
    return {
      chain: 'BTC',
      name: 'Bitcoin (BTC)',
      label: isValidLen ? '₿ Bitcoin (BTC)' : '₿ BTC Format',
      valid: isValidLen
    };
  }

  // 4. Solana (SOL) - Base58 32-44 characters
  if (val.length >= 32 && val.length <= 44 && /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-za-km-z]+$/.test(val)) {
    return {
      chain: 'SOL',
      name: 'Solana (SOL)',
      label: '🌙 Solana (SOL)',
      valid: true
    };
  }

  return null;
}

function clearWalletInput() {
  const inp = document.getElementById('walletAddr');
  if (inp) {
    inp.value = '';
    handleWalletInputLive('');
    inp.focus();
  }
}

function handleWalletInputLive(val) {
  const clearBtn = document.getElementById('walletClearBtn');
  if (clearBtn) {
    clearBtn.style.display = (val && val.trim().length > 0) ? 'flex' : 'none';
  }
  const hint = document.getElementById('detectedChainHint');
  const sel = document.getElementById('chainSelect');
  const errBox = document.getElementById('valErrorBox');
  if (errBox) errBox.style.display = 'none';

  val = (val || '').trim();
  if (!val) {
    if (hint) {
      hint.textContent = 'Auto-detect';
      hint.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
    }
    if (sel && sel.value !== '') {
      sel.value = '';
    }
    return;
  }

  const detected = detectNetworkFromAddress(val);
  if (detected) {
    if (hint) {
      hint.innerHTML = `<span style="color:var(--accent-green);font-weight:700">✓ ${detected.label}</span>`;
    }
    if (sel) {
      if (sel.value !== detected.chain) {
        sel.value = detected.chain;
        // Visual auto-detect feedback glow on the select dropdown
        sel.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-green)';
        sel.style.boxShadow = '0 0 16px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.55)';
        sel.style.transition = 'all 0.25s ease';
        setTimeout(() => {
          sel.style.borderColor = '';
          sel.style.boxShadow = '';
        }, 800);
      }
    }
  } else {
    if (hint) {
      if (val.length > 6) {
        hint.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--accent-amber)">Detecting network format...</span>';
      } else {
        hint.textContent = 'Auto-detect';
        hint.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
      }
    }
  }
}

  else if (chain === 'SOL') inp.value = '4k3Dyjzvzp8eMZWUXbBCjEvwSkkk59S5iCNLY3QrkX6R';

}

let currentChainFilter = '';
let currentRiskFilter = '';

function setHistoryChainFilter(chain, btn) {
  currentChainFilter = chain;
  document.querySelectorAll('.chain-filter-bar .filter-pill-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  const sel = document.getElementById('historyChainFilter');
  if (sel) sel.value = chain;
  filterHistoryLog();
}

function syncHistoryChainSelect(chain) {
  currentChainFilter = chain;
  document.querySelectorAll('.chain-filter-bar .filter-pill-btn').forEach(b => {
    b.classList.toggle('active', (b.getAttribute('data-filter-chain') || '').toUpperCase() === chain.toUpperCase());
  });
  filterHistoryLog();
}

function filterHistoryLog() {
  const query = (document.getElementById('historySearchInput')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
  const chainFilter = (currentChainFilter || document.getElementById('historyChainFilter')?.value || '').toUpperCase();
  const riskFilter = (document.getElementById('historyRiskFilter')?.value || '').toUpperCase();

  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#sidebarHistory .case-card');
  let matchCount = 0;
  cards.forEach(card => {
    const cChain = (card.getAttribute('data-chain') || '').toUpperCase();
    const cRisk = (card.getAttribute('data-risk') || '').toUpperCase();
    const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();

    const matchesQ = !query || text.includes(query);
    const matchesChain = !chainFilter || cChain === chainFilter;
    const matchesRisk = !riskFilter || cRisk === riskFilter;

    if (matchesQ && matchesChain && matchesRisk) {
      card.style.display = 'block';
      matchCount++;
    } else {
      card.style.display = 'none';
    }
  });

  const emptyEl = document.getElementById('historyNoMatchMsg');
  if (emptyEl) emptyEl.style.display = (matchCount === 0 && cards.length > 0) ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function renderFilteredHistory() {
  const container = document.getElementById('sidebarHistory');
  if (!container) return;

  const riskCols = { CRITICAL: '#ef4444', HIGH: '#f59e0b', MEDIUM: '#f59e0b', LOW: '#10b981', MINIMAL: '#10b981' };
  container.innerHTML = allInvestigationHistory.map(h => {
    const col = riskCols[h.risk_category] || '#64748b';
    const chain = (h.chain || '').toUpperCase();
    const risk = (h.risk_category || '').toUpperCase();
    return `
      <div class="case-card" data-chain="${chain}" data-risk="${risk}" onclick="loadHistoryItem(${h.id})">
        <div class="case-id">
          <span>${h.case_id}</span>
          <span style="color:${col};font-weight:600">${h.risk_score} [${h.risk_category}]</span>
        </div>
        <div class="case-title" style="font-size:13px">${h.nearest_vasp} • ${h.chain}</div>
        <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);word-break:break-all">${h.suspect_address}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('') + '<div id="historyNoMatchMsg" style="display:none;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:12px;padding:8px 0">No matching investigation logs found</div>';

  filterHistoryLog();
}

async function loadCryptoPrices() {
  const ticker = document.getElementById('priceTicker');
  if (ticker) ticker.classList.add('ticker-updating');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/prices?_=${Date.now()}`);
    if (res.ok) {
      const p = await res.json();
      if (p.BTC && document.getElementById('tickerBtc')) {
        const btcVal = p.BTC.usd >= 1000 ? `$${(p.BTC.usd / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : `$${Math.round(p.BTC.usd).toLocaleString()}`;
        document.getElementById('tickerBtc').textContent = btcVal;
      }
      if (p.ETH && document.getElementById('tickerEth')) {
        document.getElementById('tickerEth').textContent = `$${Math.round(p.ETH.usd).toLocaleString()}`;
      }
      if (p.SOL && document.getElementById('tickerSol')) {
        document.getElementById('tickerSol').textContent = `$${Math.round(p.SOL.usd)}`;
      }
      if (p.TRON && document.getElementById('tickerTron')) {
        document.getElementById('tickerTron').textContent = `$${p.TRON.usd.toFixed(3)}`;
      }
    }
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn('Crypto price ticker fallback active', e);
  } finally {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (ticker) ticker.classList.remove('ticker-updating');
    }, 250);
  }
}
