// ─── LOAD HISTORY ITEM ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function loadHistoryItem(id) {
  try {
    showView('loading');
    const steps = [
      'Retrieving stored investigation record...',
      'Loading cryptographic transaction graph...',
      'Synthesizing attribution matrix...',
      'Opening case dossier...'
    ];
    let si = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (si < steps.length && document.getElementById('loadingStep')) {
        document.getElementById('loadingStep').textContent = steps[si++];
      } else clearInterval(interval);
    }, 200);

    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/cases/${id}/result`);
    clearInterval(interval);
    if (!resp.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load case history (HTTP ${resp.status})`);
    }
    const data = await resp.json();
    data.trace_id = id;
    renderResults(data);
    showToast(`Investigation dossier loaded: ${data.case_id || ('Case #' + id)}`, 'success');
  } catch (e) {
    showView('hero');
    showToast('Failed loading case: ' + e.message, 'error');
  }
}

async function loadDemoCase(idx) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.case-dossier-card').forEach((card, i) => {
    card.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
  });
  const io = document.getElementById('ioName').value || 'Analyst LEA-701';
  const errBox = document.getElementById('valErrorBox');
  if (errBox) errBox.style.display = 'none';

  showView('loading');
  const steps = [
    'Initializing TraceX forensic protocol...',
    'Traversing on-chain transaction hops...',
    'Running graph attribution engine...',
    'Performing FATF typology & AML screening...',
    'Attribution verified!'
  ];
  let si = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    if (si < steps.length) {
      document.getElementById('loadingStep').textContent = steps[si++];
    } else clearInterval(interval);
  }, 400);

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/demo/trace/${idx}?investigating_officer=${encodeURIComponent(io)}`, { method: 'POST' });
    clearInterval(interval);
    const data = await resp.json();

    clearInterval(interval);
    showToast('Case load failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
    showView('hero');
  }
}

// ─── RUN LIVE TRACE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function runTrace() {
  const addr = document.getElementById('walletAddr').value.trim();
  const errBox = document.getElementById('valErrorBox');
  if (errBox) errBox.style.display = 'none';

  if (!addr) {
    if (errBox) {
      errBox.innerHTML = '⚠️ <b>Wallet address required:</b> Please enter a valid crypto address.';
      errBox.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      showToast('Please enter a suspect cryptocurrency wallet address', 'warn');
    }
    return;
  }

  const chain = document.getElementById('chainSelect').value || null;
  const crime = document.getElementById('crimeCategory').value;
  const io = document.getElementById('ioName').value || 'Analyst LEA-701';

  showView('loading');
  const steps = [
    'Cryptographic address validation...',
    'Querying blockchain node explorer...',
    'Constructing directed fund movement graph...',
    'Correlating nearest VASP cluster heuristics...',
    'Evaluating AML indicators...',
    'Synthesis complete!'
  ];
  let si = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    if (si < steps.length) {
      document.getElementById('loadingStep').textContent = steps[si++];
    } else clearInterval(interval);
  }, 400);

  try {
    const body = { address: addr, crime_category: crime, investigating_officer: io, mode: currentMode };
    if (chain) body.chain = chain;
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/trace`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    clearInterval(interval);

    if (!resp.ok) {
      const errJson = await resp.json();
      const errMsg = errJson.detail?.message || (typeof errJson.detail === 'string' ? errJson.detail : JSON.stringify(errJson.detail));
      if (errBox) {
        errBox.innerHTML = `❌ <b>VALIDATION ERROR (HTTP ${resp.status}):</b><br/>${errMsg}`;
        errBox.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        showToast('Validation Error: ' + errMsg, 'error');
      }
      showView('hero');
      return;
    }

    const data = await resp.json();
    renderResults(data);
  } catch (e) {
    clearInterval(interval);
    if (errBox) {
      errBox.innerHTML = `❌ <b>NETWORK ERROR:</b> ${e.message}`;
      errBox.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      showToast('Trace execution failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
    }
    showView('hero');
  }
}

function updateAnalyticsData(traceData) {
  if (!traceData) return;
  const an = getAnalyticsData();
  an.total_traces += 1;
  const v = traceData.nearest_vasp || {};
  if (v.name && v.name !== 'Unknown') {
    an.attributed_wallets += 1;
    an.vasp_freq[v.name] = (an.vasp_freq[v.name] || 0) + 1;
  }
  const crime = traceData.crime_category || document.getElementById('crimeCategory')?.value || 'Cyber Fraud / Task Scam';
  an.crime_freq[crime] = (an.crime_freq[crime] || 0) + 1;
  
  const nodes = traceData.nodes || [];
  nodes.forEach(n => {
    if (n.node_type === 'bridge' || n.node_type === 'mixer') {
      an.bridges_detected += 1;
    }
  });

  localStorage.setItem('tracex_lea_analytics', JSON.stringify(an));
  renderLeaAnalytics();
}

  const an = getAnalyticsData();

      avg_nodal_sla: an.avg_sla || "3.4 hrs"
    },
    top_attributed_vasps: an.vasp_freq,
    crime_typologies: an.crime_freq,
    vasp_sla_matrix: an.vasp_sla_matrix,
    recent_intercepts: an.recent_cases
  };

  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(dossier, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `TraceX_National_LEA_Dossier_${Date.now()}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast('📥 Exported National Cyber Forensics Dossier (JSON)', 'success');
}

function inspectAuditCase(address, chain, caseId) {
  // 1. Switch to Tab 1 (Attribution)

  // 2. Populate input
  const input = document.getElementById('targetAddress');
  if (input) {
    input.value = address;
    input.focus();
  }
  const chainSelect = document.getElementById('targetChain');
  if (chainSelect && chain) {
    chainSelect.value = chain;
  }

  // 3. Initiate trace
  showToast(`⚡ Loading Case ${caseId} (${chain}) into On-Chain Engine...`, 'info');
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (typeof startInvestigation === 'function') {
      startInvestigation();
    }
  }, 400);
}

function renderAnalyticsWaveChart(waveData) {
  const container = document.getElementById('analyticsWaveChart');
  if (!container) return;

  const data = waveData && waveData.length ? waveData : [
    { time: "00:00", influx: 14, attr: 12, freezes: 8 },
    { time: "04:00", influx: 18, attr: 16, freezes: 11 },
    { time: "08:00", influx: 32, attr: 29, freezes: 22 },
    { time: "12:00", influx: 48, attr: 44, freezes: 36 },
    { time: "16:00", influx: 62, attr: 58, freezes: 45 },
    { time: "20:00", influx: 70, attr: 65, freezes: 50 },
    { time: "INDEX", influx: 74, attr: 68, freezes: 52 }
  ];

  const w = 700;
  const h = 170;
  const padL = 40;
  const padR = 20;
  const padT = 20;
  const padB = 30;

  const maxVal = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.influx), 80);

  const getX = (i) => padL + (i / (data.length - 1)) * (w - padL - padR);
  const getY = (val) => padT + (1 - val / maxVal) * (h - padT - padB);

  // Generate Area & Line paths
  const influxPoints = data.map((d, i) => [getX(i), getY(d.influx)]);
  const attrPoints = data.map((d, i) => [getX(i), getY(d.attr)]);
  const freezePoints = data.map((d, i) => [getX(i), getY(d.freezes)]);

  const makeSmoothPath = (pts) => {
    if (!pts.length) return "";
    let path = `M ${pts[0][0]},${pts[0][1]}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
      const p0 = pts[i];
      const p1 = pts[i + 1];
      const mx = (p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2;
      path += ` C ${mx},${p0[1]} ${mx},${p1[1]} ${p1[0]},${p1[1]}`;
    }
    return path;
  };

  const influxLine = makeSmoothPath(influxPoints);
  const influxArea = `${influxLine} L ${influxPoints[influxPoints.length-1][0]},${h - padB} L ${influxPoints[0][0]},${h - padB} Z`;

  const attrLine = makeSmoothPath(attrPoints);
  const attrArea = `${attrLine} L ${attrPoints[attrPoints.length-1][0]},${h - padB} L ${attrPoints[0][0]},${h - padB} Z`;

  const freezeLine = makeSmoothPath(freezePoints);

  // Grid Lines
  const gridLines = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0].map(frac => {
    const yVal = padT + (1 - frac) * (h - padT - padB);
    const labelVal = Math.round(frac * maxVal);
    return `
      <line x1="${padL}" y1="${yVal}" x2="${w - padR}" y2="${yVal}" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.06)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 4"/>
      <text x="${padL - 8}" y="${yVal + 3}" fill="#64748b" font-size="9" text-anchor="end" font-family="monospace">${labelVal}</text>
    `;
  }).join('');

  // X Labels
  const xLabels = data.map((d, i) => {
    const x = getX(i);
    return `<text x="${x}" y="${h - 10}" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9.5" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace">${d.time}</text>`;
  }).join('');

  // Blip Dots
  const blipDots = data.map((d, i) => {
    const x = getX(i);
    const yIn = getY(d.influx);
    const yAt = getY(d.attr);
    const yFr = getY(d.freezes);
    return `
      <g>
        <circle cx="${x}" cy="${yIn}" r="3.5" fill="#00e5ff" stroke="#030718" stroke-width="1.5" style="filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #00e5ff)"/>
        <circle cx="${x}" cy="${yAt}" r="3.5" fill="#10b981" stroke="#030718" stroke-width="1.5" style="filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #10b981)"/>
        <circle cx="${x}" cy="${yFr}" r="3" fill="#fbbf24" stroke="#030718" stroke-width="1.5" style="filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #fbbf24)"/>
      </g>
    `;
  }).join('');

  container.innerHTML = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" width="100%" height="${h}" style="overflow:visible">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="waveCyanGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00e5ff" stop-opacity="0.32"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#00e5ff" stop-opacity="0.0"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="waveGreenGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#10b981" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#10b981" stop-opacity="0.0"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <filter id="waveGlow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
        </filter>
      </defs>

      <!-- Grid lines -->
      ${gridLines}

      <!-- Bottom baseline -->
      <line x1="${padL}" y1="${h - padB}" x2="${w - padR}" y2="${h - padB}" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" stroke-width="1.2"/>

      <!-- Areas -->
      <path d="${influxArea}" fill="url(#waveCyanGrad)"/>
      <path d="${attrArea}" fill="url(#waveGreenGrad)"/>

      <!-- Lines -->
      <path d="${influxLine}" fill="none" stroke="#00e5ff" stroke-width="2.2" filter="url(#waveGlow)"/>
      <path d="${attrLine}" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#waveGlow)"/>
      <path d="${freezeLine}" fill="none" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="4 3" filter="url(#waveGlow)"/>

      <!-- Nodes -->
      ${blipDots}

      <!-- Labels -->
      ${xLabels}
    </svg>
  `;
}

function renderLeaAnalytics() {
  initAnalyticsIcons();
  const an = getAnalyticsData();
  const curJur = an.active_jurisdiction || 'all';
  const jData = (an.jurisdictions && an.jurisdictions[curJur]) || {
    traces: an.total_traces,
    attr: an.attributed_wallets,
    sec91: an.sec91_count,
    bridges: an.bridges_detected,
    valuation: an.asset_valuation || '₹ 14.82 Cr',
    sla: an.avg_sla || '3.4 hrs',
    precision: '91.8%'
  };

  const elTotal = document.getElementById('statTotalTraces');
  const elAttr = document.getElementById('statAttributed');
  const elSec91 = document.getElementById('statSec91');
  const elBridges = document.getElementById('statBridges');
  const elValuation = document.getElementById('statValuation');
  const elSla = document.getElementById('statSla');

  if (elTotal) elTotal.textContent = jData.traces;
  if (elAttr) elAttr.textContent = jData.attr;
  if (elSec91) elSec91.textContent = jData.sec91;
  if (elBridges) elBridges.textContent = jData.bridges;
  if (elValuation) elValuation.textContent = jData.valuation;
  if (elSla) elSla.textContent = jData.sla;

  // Render 24-hour Wave Chart
  renderAnalyticsWaveChart(an.hourly_wave);

  // Render State Command Hubs
  renderHubGrid(an);

  // Render VASP SLA Table
  renderVaspSlaTable(an);

  // Render Real-time Influx Case Audit Table
  renderCaseAuditTable(an);

  // 1. TOP VASPS HORIZONTAL CYBER LEADERBOARD
  const vaspBars = document.getElementById('analyticsVaspBars');
  if (vaspBars) {
    const vasps = Object.entries(an.vasp_freq || {}).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 5);
    const maxV = Math.max(...vasps.map(v => v[1]), 1);
    const totalVaspCases = vasps.reduce((acc, [, c]) => acc + c, 0) || 1;

    vaspBars.innerHTML = vasps.length ? `
      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px">
        ${vasps.map(([name, count], idx) => {
          const pct = Math.round((count / totalVaspCases) * 100);
          const barPct = Math.round((count / maxV) * 100);
          const rankColor = idx === 0 ? '#ffd700' : (idx === 1 ? '#00e5ff' : '#94a3b8');
          return `
          <div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);transition:all 0.2s" onmouseover="this.style.borderColor='rgba(0,229,255,0.3)'" onmouseout="this.style.borderColor='rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:7px">
              <span style="font-weight:700;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
                <span style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(0,229,255,0.12);color:${rankColor};text-align:center;line-height:22px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.25)">#${idx+1}</span>
                <span>${name}</span>
              </span>
              <span style="color:#00e5ff;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-weight:700">
                ${count} cases <span style="color:#64748b;font-weight:normal">(${pct}%)</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style="height:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;position:relative">
              <div style="height:100%;width:${barPct}%;background:linear-gradient(90deg, #00e5ff, #818cf8);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,229,255,0.4);transition:width 0.6s ease"></div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        }).join('')}
      </div>
    ` : '<div style="color:var(--text-muted);font-size:13px">Run traces to populate attribution metrics.</div>';
  }

  // 2. CRIME CATEGORIES INLINE SVG DONUT CHART
  const crimeBars = document.getElementById('analyticsCrimeBars');
  if (crimeBars) {
    const crimes = Object.entries(an.crime_freq || {}).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 5);
    const totalCrimes = crimes.reduce((acc, [, c]) => acc + c, 0) || 1;
    const colors = ['#00e5ff', '#a855f7', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444'];
    
    // SVG Donut geometry: R = 54, Circumference = 2 * PI * 54 = 339.29
    const circ = 339.29;
    let offset = 0;
    const donutSlices = crimes.map(([name, count], i) => {
      const frac = count / totalCrimes;
      const strokeDash = `${(frac * circ).toFixed(2)} ${(circ * (1 - frac)).toFixed(2)}`;
      const currentOffset = offset;
      offset += frac * circ;
      return `<circle cx="80" cy="80" r="54" fill="transparent" stroke="${colors[i % colors.length]}" stroke-width="20" stroke-dasharray="${strokeDash}" stroke-dashoffset="${(-currentOffset).toFixed(2)}" transform="rotate(-90 80 80)" style="transition:all 0.5s ease"/>`;
    }).join('');

    crimeBars.innerHTML = crimes.length ? `
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:6px 0">
        <div style="position:relative;width:160px;height:160px;flex-shrink:0">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 160 160" width="160" height="160">
            <circle cx="80" cy="80" r="54" fill="transparent" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.05)" stroke-width="20"/>
            ${donutSlices}
            <circle cx="80" cy="80" r="42" fill="#030718" stroke="rgba(0,229,255,0.2)" stroke-width="1"/>
            <text x="80" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" font-weight="800" fill="#fff" font-family="var(--font-display)">${totalCrimes}</text>
            <text x="80" y="93" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#94a3b8" letter-spacing="1.5" font-family="monospace">CASES</text>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div style="flex:1;min-width:180px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">
          ${crimes.map(([name, count], i) => {
            const pct = Math.round((count / totalCrimes) * 100);
            return `
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;padding:3px 0">
              <span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#fff">
                <span style="width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;background:${colors[i % colors.length]};box-shadow:0 0 6px ${colors[i % colors.length]};flex-shrink:0"></span>
                <span style="white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:150px" title="${name}">${name}</span>
              </span>
              <span style="color:#94a3b8;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px">
                <b style="color:#fff">${count}</b> (${pct}%)
              </span>
            </div>`;
          }).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>
    ` : '<div style="color:var(--text-muted);font-size:13px">Run traces to populate crime typology metrics.</div>';
  }
}

  const i1 = document.getElementById('iconRiskIndex');
  if (i1 && !i1.innerHTML) i1.innerHTML = getIsometricShieldSvg();
  const i2 = document.getElementById('iconRiskMule');
  if (i2 && !i2.innerHTML) i2.innerHTML = getIsometricNodesSvg();
  const i3 = document.getElementById('iconRiskMixer');
  if (i3 && !i3.innerHTML) i3.innerHTML = getIsometricChainLinkSvg();
  const i4 = document.getElementById('iconRiskFreeze');
  if (i4 && !i4.innerHTML) i4.innerHTML = getIsometricGavelSvg();
}

function exportAmlAuditReport() {
  const trace = currentTrace || {
    case_id: 'FIR-247/24-BENCHMARK',
    composite_risk_score: 82,
    composite_risk_rating: 'CRITICAL',
    nearest_vasp: { name: 'Binance Global (India Desk)' }
  };
  
  const amlReport = {
    audit_title: 'FATF Virtual Asset Risk & AML Telemetry Report',
    statutory_authority: 'Section 91 & 106 BNSS 2023 / PMLA 2002',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    case_id: trace.case_id || 'FIR-247/24-MH',
    composite_risk_score: trace.composite_risk_score || 82,
    risk_category: trace.composite_risk_rating || 'CRITICAL',
    target_vasp: trace.nearest_vasp?.name || 'Centralized Exchange',
    detected_typologies: trace.detected_typologies || [
      { name: 'Rapid Cashout to VASP', severity: 'CRITICAL', code: 'FATF-TYP-03' },
      { name: 'Unhosted Mule Layering', severity: 'HIGH', code: 'FATF-TYP-08' },
      { name: 'Peel Chain Structuring', severity: 'HIGH', code: 'FATF-TYP-01' }
    ],
    compliance_checks: {
      fatf_rec_15: 'COMPLIANT (VASP Isolated)',
      fatf_rec_16: 'COMPLIANT (Nodal Mandate Prepared)',
      pmla_nexus: 'FLAGGED (Section 3 Crime Proceeds Layering)',
      bnss_sec_106: 'QUALIFIED (Immediate Asset Restraint Mandated)'
    }
  };

  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(amlReport, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `TraceX_FATF_AML_Audit_${Date.now()}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast('📥 Exported FATF AML Compliance Audit Dossier', 'success');
}

function renderRiskPane(data) {
  initRiskIcons();
  const elRiskMeter = document.getElementById('riskMeter');
  const elTypologyList = document.getElementById('typologyList');

  // Benchmark fallback data when no trace has been run yet
  const isFallback = !data;
  const traceData = isFallback ? {
    case_id: 'FIR-247/24-MH',
    composite_risk_score: 82,
    composite_risk_rating: 'CRITICAL',
    nodes: [
      { node_id: 0, node_type: 'suspect', address: 'TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t' },
      { node_id: 1, node_type: 'intermediary', address: 'TYDzsYUEpvnYmQk4zGP9sWWcTEd2MiAtW6' },
      { node_id: 2, node_type: 'intermediary', address: 'TKzfdSpPkvypRuhDSBTgHe2WmUTx88ShT8' },
      { node_id: 3, node_type: 'exchange_deposit', address: 'TNDzfPkvypRuhDSBTgHe2WmUTx88Binance' }
    ],
    detected_typologies: [
      {
        name: 'Rapid Cashout Funneling',
        typology_code: 'FATF-TYP-03',
        severity: 'CRITICAL',
        risk_score_contribution: 35,
        freeze_recommended: true,
        description: 'Funds forwarded to exchange gateway within 4.2 minutes of genesis injection, demonstrating calculated temporal evasion.',
        evidence: 'Chronological telemetry confirms sub-5-minute velocity directly into Binance deposit cluster.'
      },
      {
        name: 'Unhosted Mule Layering Dispersion',
        typology_code: 'FATF-TYP-08',
        severity: 'HIGH',
        risk_score_contribution: 25,
        freeze_recommended: true,
        description: '2 intermediate unhosted/self-custodial wallets utilized to layer and camouflage origin from victim complaint.',
        evidence: 'Hop 1 (TYDz...) and Hop 2 (TKzf...) identified as disposable unhosted layering accounts.'
      },
      {
        name: 'Peel Chain Structuring Pattern',
        typology_code: 'FATF-TYP-01',
        severity: 'HIGH',
        risk_score_contribution: 22,
        freeze_recommended: true,
        description: 'Successive stripping of small network gas fees while maintaining 98.5% of primary illicit volume.',
        evidence: 'Consistent amount reduction across sequential transfers matching automated bot peeling behavior.'
      }
    ],
    factors: {
      layering: 85,
      velocity: 92,
      mixer: 10,
      compliance: 78
    }
  } : data;

  const riskScore = traceData.composite_risk_score !== undefined ? traceData.composite_risk_score : (traceData.risk_score || 75);
  const riskCat = traceData.composite_risk_rating || traceData.risk_category || (riskScore >= 70 ? 'CRITICAL' : riskScore >= 40 ? 'HIGH' : riskScore >= 20 ? 'MEDIUM' : 'LOW');
  const riskColor = riskScore >= 70 ? '#ef4444' : riskScore >= 40 ? '#f59e0b' : riskScore >= 20 ? '#eab308' : '#10b981';

  // 1. Update 4-HUD Telemetry Cards
  const elRiskIndex = document.getElementById('fatfRiskIndexVal');
  if (elRiskIndex) {
    elRiskIndex.textContent = `${riskScore} / 100 (${riskCat})`;
    elRiskIndex.style.color = riskColor;
  }

  const nodes = traceData.nodes || [];
  const muleCount = nodes.filter((n, i) => i > 0 && i < nodes.length - 1).length;
  const elMuleFreq = document.getElementById('fatfMuleFreqVal');
  if (elMuleFreq) {
    elMuleFreq.textContent = `${muleCount} Layering Hop${muleCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    elMuleFreq.style.color = muleCount > 0 ? '#fbbf24' : '#94a3b8';
  }

  const hasMixer = nodes.some(n => n.node_type === 'mixer' || n.node_type === 'bridge');
  const elMixerExp = document.getElementById('fatfMixerExposureVal');
  if (elMixerExp) {
    elMixerExp.textContent = hasMixer ? '⚠️ Mixer / Bridge Flagged' : '✅ 0% Mixer (Clean Trail)';
    elMixerExp.style.color = hasMixer ? '#ef4444' : '#34d399';
  }

  const elFreezeQual = document.getElementById('fatfFreezeQualVal');
  if (elFreezeQual) {
    elFreezeQual.textContent = riskScore >= 50 ? 'Statutory Restraint (Draft)' : 'Advisory Review';
    elFreezeQual.style.color = riskScore >= 50 ? '#ef4444' : '#34d399';
  }

  // Factor breakdown estimates
  const factors = traceData.factors || {
    layering: Math.min(100, muleCount * 30 + 25),
    velocity: riskScore >= 60 ? 88 : 45,
    mixer: hasMixer ? 95 : 12,
    compliance: riskScore >= 50 ? 84 : 35
  };

  // 2. Render Reactor Meter Gauge
  if (elRiskMeter) {
    const rCirc = 2 * Math.PI * 46;
    const rDashOffset = rCirc * (1 - (riskScore / 100));

    // End spark node position
    const angleRad = -Math.PI / 2 + (riskScore / 100) * 2 * Math.PI;
    const endX = (55 + 46 * Math.cos(angleRad)).toFixed(1);
    const endY = (55 + 46 * Math.sin(angleRad)).toFixed(1);

    elRiskMeter.innerHTML = `
      <div style="position:relative;width:170px;height:170px;margin:0 auto 12px auto">
        <svg width="170" height="170" viewBox="0 0 110 110" style="overflow:visible">
          <defs>
            <filter id="reactorGaugeGlow" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
              <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3.5" result="blur"/>
              <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
            </filter>
            <radialGradient id="reactorCoreAura" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
              <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${riskColor}" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
              <stop offset="80%" stop-color="${riskColor}" stop-opacity="0.03"/>
              <stop offset="100%" stop-color="transparent"/>
            </radialGradient>
          </defs>

          <!-- Ambient Core Aura -->
          <circle cx="55" cy="55" r="44" fill="url(#reactorCoreAura)"/>

          <!-- Outer Segmented Tachometer Notches -->
          <circle cx="55" cy="55" r="52" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.12)" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="2, 6"/>

          <!-- Crosshairs -->
          <line x1="55" y1="1" x2="55" y2="6" stroke="${riskColor}" stroke-width="2"/>
          <line x1="55" y1="104" x2="55" y2="109" stroke="${riskColor}" stroke-width="2"/>
          <line x1="1" y1="55" x2="6" y2="55" stroke="${riskColor}" stroke-width="2"/>
          <line x1="104" y1="55" x2="109" y2="55" stroke="${riskColor}" stroke-width="2"/>

          <!-- Judicial Freeze Threshold Marker at 50% (Bottom: 55, 101) -->
          <circle cx="55" cy="101" r="2.5" fill="#f59e0b" filter="url(#reactorGaugeGlow)"/>
          <text x="55" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="var(--font-mono)" font-size="5" font-weight="900" fill="#fbbf24">50% FREEZE</text>

          <!-- Background Track -->
          <circle cx="55" cy="55" r="46" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.06)" stroke-width="7"/>

          <!-- Animated Progress Arc -->
          <circle cx="55" cy="55" r="46" fill="none" stroke="${riskColor}" stroke-width="7.5"
                  stroke-dasharray="${rCirc.toFixed(1)}" stroke-dashoffset="${rDashOffset.toFixed(1)}"
                  stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(-90 55 55)"
                  filter="url(#reactorGaugeGlow)"
                  style="transition: stroke-dashoffset 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);"/>

          <!-- Glowing Endpoint Spark Node -->
          <circle cx="${endX}" cy="${endY}" r="3.5" fill="#ffffff" filter="url(#reactorGaugeGlow)"/>
          <circle cx="${endX}" cy="${endY}" r="1.8" fill="${riskColor}"/>
        </svg>

        <!-- Center Threat Gauge Readout -->
        <div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none">
          <div style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:900;color:${riskColor};line-height:0.95;letter-spacing:-0.03em;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px ${riskColor}88)">
            ${riskScore}
          </div>
          <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.64rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:0.12em;color:#fff;background:${riskColor}33;border:1px solid ${riskColor}88;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin-top:6px;box-shadow:0 0 10px ${riskColor}44">
            ${riskCat} THREAT
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:900;color:#fff;margin-bottom:3px">
        FATF Virtual Asset Risk Engine
      </div>
      <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.7rem;color:#94a3b8;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:12px">
        Evaluated against FATF Recommendation 15/16 & PMLA Sec 3 Red-Flag Indicators
      </div>

      <!-- 4-Pillar Risk Factor Decomposition Breakdown -->
      <div class="risk-factor-metrics">
        <div class="risk-factor-row">
          <div class="rfr-top">
            <span class="rfr-label">Layering Dispersion</span>
            <span class="rfr-val" style="color:#fbbf24">${factors.layering}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rfr-track"><div class="rfr-fill" style="width:${factors.layering}%;background:#fbbf24"></div></div>
        </div>

        <div class="risk-factor-row">
          <div class="rfr-top">
            <span class="rfr-label">Transfer Velocity (<30m)</span>
            <span class="rfr-val" style="color:#ef4444">${factors.velocity}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rfr-track"><div class="rfr-fill" style="width:${factors.velocity}%;background:#ef4444"></div></div>
        </div>

        <div class="risk-factor-row">
          <div class="rfr-top">
            <span class="rfr-label">Mixer / Privacy Evasion</span>
            <span class="rfr-val" style="color:${hasMixer ? '#ef4444' : '#34d399'}">${factors.mixer}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rfr-track"><div class="rfr-fill" style="width:${factors.mixer}%;background:${hasMixer ? '#ef4444' : '#34d399'}"></div></div>
        </div>

        <div class="risk-factor-row">
          <div class="rfr-top">
            <span class="rfr-label">Statutory Restraint Threshold</span>
            <span class="rfr-val" style="color:#34d399">${factors.compliance}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rfr-track"><div class="rfr-fill" style="width:${factors.compliance}%;background:#34d399"></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  // 3. Render Detected Typologies
  const typologies = traceData.detected_typologies || [];
  if (elTypologyList) {
    if (typologies.length > 0) {
      let cardsHtml = '';

      if (isFallback) {
        cardsHtml += `
          <div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12) 0%, rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.05) 100%);border:1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
              <span style="font-size:1.1rem">⚡</span>

      cardsHtml += typologies.map(t => {
        const severity = t.severity || 'MEDIUM';
        const sevClass = severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'crit' : severity === 'HIGH' ? 'high' : 'med';
        const sevColor = severity === 'CRITICAL' ? '#ef4444' : severity === 'HIGH' ? '#f59e0b' : '#38bdf8';
        const iconSvg = (t.typology_code === 'FATF-TYP-01' || (t.name && t.name.includes('Peel'))) ? getIsometricNodesSvg() :

                        (t.typology_code === 'FATF-TYP-03' || (t.name && t.name.includes('Cashout'))) ? getIsometricCoinStackSvg() :

        return `

                  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
                    <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.65rem;font-weight:900;color:${sevColor};background:${sevColor}22;border:1px solid ${sevColor}55;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:5px;letter-spacing:0.04em">
                      ${severity} SEVERITY
                    </span>
                    <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.65rem;color:#94a3b8;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px">
                      ${t.typology_code || 'FATF-REC-15'}

                <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem;color:#cbd5e1;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:8px">

                ${t.evidence ? `
                  <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.7rem;color:#94a3b8;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);border-left:2px solid ${sevColor};padding:6px 10px;border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;margin-bottom:10px">
                    <span style="color:${sevColor};font-weight:700">Forensic Evidence:</span> ${t.evidence}
                  </div>
                ` : ''}

                <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)">
                  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
                    <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:800;color:${t.freeze_recommended ? '#ef4444' : '#34d399'}">
                      ${t.freeze_recommended ? '🚨 SECTION 106 FREEZE TRIGGERED' : '✓ ADVISORY RECORD'}
                    </span>
                    <span style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.15)">•</span>
                    <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.65rem;color:#fbbf24">
                      PMLA 2002 Sec 3 Nexus
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div style="display:flex;gap:8px">
                    <button class="thc-act-btn green" onclick="switchTab('notice')" style="font-size:0.68rem;padding:4px 10px">
                      ⚖️ Add to Freezing Mandate
                    </button>
                    <button class="thc-act-btn primary" onclick="switchTab('graph')" style="font-size:0.68rem;padding:4px 10px">
                      ⚡ Inspect in Graph
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');

      elTypologyList.innerHTML = cardsHtml;
    } else {
      elTypologyList.innerHTML = `
        <div style="text-align:center;padding:32px 20px;background:rgba(16,185,129,0.06);border:1px dashed rgba(16,185,129,0.35);border-radius:12px">
          <div style="width:48px;height:48px;margin:0 auto 10px auto">${getIsometricShieldSvg()}</div>
          <div style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:800;color:#34d399;margin-bottom:6px">No Critical AML Red-Flags Triggered</div>
          <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:0.75rem;color:#94a3b8;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 14px auto;line-height:1.5">
            Standard baseline on-chain activity detected. No mixers, peel chains, or sanctioned entities flagged along the hop trail.
          </div>
          <button class="analytics-btn primary" onclick="loadDemoCase(0)" style="font-size:0.75rem;padding:6px 14px">
            ⚡ Load High-Risk Benchmark Case 1
          </button>
        </div>
      `;
    }
  }

  // 4. Update Compliance Badges in Statutory Deck
  const pmlaBadge = document.getElementById('pmlaStatusBadge');
  if (pmlaBadge) {
    pmlaBadge.textContent = riskScore >= 50 ? '🚨 SECTION 3 NEXUS ESTABLISHED' : '✓ NO DIRECT PMLA NEXUS';
    pmlaBadge.style.color = riskScore >= 50 ? '#f87171' : '#34d399';
    pmlaBadge.style.borderColor = riskScore >= 50 ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.4)' : 'rgba(16,185,129,0.4)';
    pmlaBadge.style.background = riskScore >= 50 ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)' : 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)';
  }

  const bnssBadge = document.getElementById('bnssStatusBadge');
  if (bnssBadge) {
    bnssBadge.textContent = riskScore >= 50 ? '⚖️ SEC 106 ASSET RESTRAINT READY' : 'ℹ SURVEILLANCE ADVISORY';
    bnssBadge.style.color = riskScore >= 50 ? '#34d399' : '#38bdf8';
  }
}


// ─── STEP 4: FORENSIC TRANSACTION PATH TIMELINE ENGINE (SUPERCHARGED) ────────
function initPathIcons() {
  const h = document.getElementById('iconPathHops');
  if (h && !h.innerHTML) h.innerHTML = getIsometricChainLinkSvg();
  const m = document.getElementById('iconPathMules');
  if (m && !m.innerHTML) m.innerHTML = getIsometricNodesSvg();
  const t = document.getElementById('iconPathTaint');
  if (t && !t.innerHTML) t.innerHTML = getIsometricShieldSvg();
  const v = document.getElementById('iconPathVasp');
  if (v && !v.innerHTML) v.innerHTML = getIsometricExchangeNodeSvg();
}

let currentPathFilter = 'all';

function filterPathHops(type) {
  currentPathFilter = type;
  const pills = ['All', 'Mules', 'Vasp'];
  pills.forEach(p => {
    const el = document.getElementById('pillHop' + p);
    if (el) {
      if (p.toLowerCase() === type) el.classList.add('active');
      else el.classList.remove('active');
    }
  });

  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.hop-evidence-card');
  const conduits = document.querySelectorAll('.hop-conduit-strip');
  
  cards.forEach(c => {
    const hopType = c.getAttribute('data-hop-type');
    if (type === 'all') {
      c.style.display = 'flex';
    } else if (type === 'mules') {
      c.style.display = (hopType === 'mule' || hopType === 'intermediary') ? 'flex' : 'none';
    } else if (type === 'vasp') {
      c.style.display = (hopType === 'deposit' || hopType === 'exchange_deposit') ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }
  });

  conduits.forEach(cd => {
    cd.style.display = (type === 'all') ? 'flex' : 'none';
  });

  showToast(`Filtered trail: ${type.toUpperCase()}`, 'info');
}

function inspectHopInTerminal(address, chain) {
  switchTab('livedata');
  showToast(`🔍 Interrogating Node ${address.slice(0, 8)}... in Explorer Terminal`, 'info');
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (typeof loadLiveData === 'function') loadLiveData();
  }, 300);
}

function addHopToNotice(address) {
  switchTab('notice');
  showToast(`⚖️ Added ${address.slice(0, 8)}... to Statutory Freezing Mandate`, 'success');
}

function exportPathRoute() {
  const trace = currentTrace || getBenchmarkPathFallback();
  const routeData = {
    case_id: trace.case_id || 'FIR-247/24-BENCHMARK',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    legal_statutory_basis: 'BNSS 2023 Sec 106 & Sec 91 / Sec 65B IEA format draft Hop Trail',
    total_hops: (trace.nodes ? trace.nodes.length - 1 : 4),
    target_vasp: trace.nearest_vasp?.name || 'Binance Global (India Desk)',
    nodes: trace.nodes || [],
    edges: trace.edges || []
  };

  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(routeData, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `TraceX_Hop_Evidence_Route_${Date.now()}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast('📥 Exported Chronological Hop Evidence Trail (JSON)', 'success');
}

function formatHopAmount(amt, defaultAsset) {
  if (!amt) return '0 ' + (defaultAsset || 'USDT');
  const s = String(amt).trim();
  if (/[a-zA-Z]/.test(s)) return s;
  return `${s} ${defaultAsset || 'USDT'}`;
}

function renderPathPane(data) {
  initPathIcons();

  const isFallback = !data || !data.nodes || data.nodes.length === 0;
  const traceData = isFallback ? getBenchmarkPathFallback() : data;
  const nodes = traceData.nodes || [];
  const edges = traceData.edges || [];
  const v = traceData.nearest_vasp || { name: 'Binance Global (India Desk)' };

  // Update Path Summary Badges
  const elTotalHops = document.getElementById('psTotalHops');
  if (elTotalHops) elTotalHops.textContent = `${Math.max(0, nodes.length - 1)} Sequential Hops`;

  const muleCount = nodes.filter((n, i) => i > 0 && i < nodes.length - 1).length;

  const elTaintRate = document.getElementById('psTaintRate');

    `;
  }

  html += `<div class="electric-timeline-wrap">`;

  nodes.forEach((n, i) => {
    const edge = edges[i] || (edges[i - 1] ? edges[i - 1] : {});
    const col = hopColors[n.node_type] || '#38bdf8';

    let iconSvg = '';
    let badgeClass = 'hop-badge-unhosted';

    if (i === 0) {

              NODE_ID: #${n.node_id !== undefined ? n.node_id : i}

          <!-- Telemetry Grid -->
          <div class="thc-telemetry-grid">

            </button>
            <button class="thc-act-btn green" onclick="addHopToNotice('${n.address}')">
              <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m16 16 3-8 3 8c-.87.65-1.92 1-3 1s-2.13-.35-3-1Z"/><path d="m2 16 3-8 3 8c-.87.65-1.92 1-3 1s-2.13-.35-3-1Z"/><path d="M7 21h10"/><path d="M12 3v18"/><path d="M3 7h2c2 0 5-1 7-2 2 1 5 2 7 2h2"/></svg>
              <span>Add to Freezing Schedule</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  });

  html += `</div>`;
  container.innerHTML = html;

  const hopTimelineEl = document.getElementById('hopTimeline');
  if (hopTimelineEl) {
    hopTimelineEl.innerHTML = html;
  }
}


function updateUniversalTargetPills(data) {
  const addr = (data && (data.deposit_address || data.suspect_address)) || (document.getElementById('walletAddr')?.value) || '0x742d...f44e';
  const shortAddr = addr.length > 14 ? `${addr.slice(0, 6)}...${addr.slice(-4)}` : addr;
  const vasp = (data && (data.nearest_vasp?.name || data.vasp?.name)) || 'Centralized Exchange';
  const conf = (data && (data.confidence_score || data.confidence)) || 92;
  const chain = (data && data.chain) || 'EVM';

  const pillHtml = `<span class="status-dot status-dot-cyan pulse"></span> <span>Target: <b>${shortAddr}</b> (${chain}) • <b>${vasp}</b> (${conf}%)</span>`;

  document.querySelectorAll('.universal-target-pill').forEach(el => {
    el.innerHTML = pillHtml;
  });
}

function renderResults(data) {
  hideSkeletonLoader();
  updateAnalyticsData(data);
  updateUniversalTargetPills(data);
  hideSkeletonLoader();
  currentTrace = data;
  currentTraceId = data.trace_id;
  currentCaseId = data.case_id;
  try { generateNotice(true); } catch (e) {}

  const v = data.nearest_vasp || {};
  const ps = data.path_summary || {};
  const prov = data.source_provenance || {};
  const topCands = data.top_candidates || [];
  const breakdown = v.confidence_breakdown || [];
  const confScore = v.confidence !== undefined ? v.confidence : 85;

  // Confidence color ramp: green >80%, amber 50-79%, red <50%
  const confColor = confScore >= 80 ? '#10b981' : (confScore >= 50 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444');
  const confBadgeClass = confScore >= 80 ? 'status-dot-green' : (confScore >= 50 ? 'status-dot-amber' : 'status-dot-red');

  // Typology Card calculation
  const typo = data.typology_card || {};
  const typoHtml = typo.name ? `
    <div class="typology-fatf-card">
      <div class="typology-fatf-header">
        <div class="typology-fatf-title">
          <span class="status-dot status-dot-amber"></span>
          <span>${typo.name}</span>
        </div>
        <span class="typology-fatf-ref">FATF RFI: ${typo.fatf_code || 'RFI-4.2'}</span>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.5">${typo.description || 'Laundering pattern identified along transaction hop path.'}</div>
    </div>
  ` : '';

  // Cross-Border Flag and MLAT notice template
  const isIndian = v.is_indian !== undefined ? v.is_indian : true;
  const mlatHtml = !isIndian ? `
    <div class="mlat-alert-card">
      <div class="mlat-alert-header">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
          <span class="status-dot status-dot-amber status-dot-pulse"></span>
          <span>Cross-Border VASP (${v.name || 'Offshore Exchange'} - ${v.country || 'International'})</span>
        </div>
        <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12px;background:rgba(245,158,11,0.2);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px">MLAT Required</span>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.5">
        Target VASP operates outside Indian jurisdiction. Section 91 BNSS directive must be accompanied by Letter Rogatory / Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty (MLAT) requisition via Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) / CBI Interpol NCB.
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:4px">
        <button class="btn-cyber btn-ghost" onclick="copyMlatDraft()" style="font-size:12px;padding:4px 10px">Copy MLAT notice template</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  ` : '';

  // Top 3 Candidates HTML with Modern Cyber Podium Cards
  const topCandsHtml = topCands.length > 0 ? `
    <div class="cand-section">
      <div class="cand-header">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px">
          <span class="status-dot status-dot-cyan pulse"></span>
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent-cyan);letter-spacing:0.5px">
            TOP VASP ATTRIBUTION CANDIDATES
          </span>
          <span class="badge-cyber" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(6,182,212,0.12);color:var(--accent-cyan);border:1px solid rgba(6,182,212,0.3)">
            MULTI-CLUSTER RANKING
          </span>
        </div>
        <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted)">
          Evaluated across 40+ VASP Registries
        </span>
      </div>

      <div class="cand-grid">
        ${topCands.map(c => {

          const rankBadge = isRank1 ? '👑 PRIMARY MATCH' : `#${c.rank} ALTERNATIVE`;
          const rankClass = isRank1 ? 'cand-card-rank1' : 'cand-card-alt';
          return `

      return;
    }
    const routeText = currentTrace.nodes.map((n, idx) => `Hop ${idx}: ${n.address} (${n.node_type})`).join('\n');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(routeText).then(() => {
      showToast(`Copied ${currentTrace.nodes.length} hop addresses in sequence!`, 'success');
    });
  };

  // 3. Risk Matrix & Typologies (Delegated to elevated renderRiskPane)
  renderRiskPane(data);

  // Pre-populate Legal Notice fields
  const io = document.getElementById('ioName').value;
  if (io) document.getElementById('nOfficer').value = io;

  // Update LEA Analytics in localStorage
  updateAnalyticsData(data);

  showView('results');
  switchTab('attribution');
  loadHistory();
}


// ─── INTERACTIVE CANVAS GRAPH WITH Fund Flow Visualizer & REAL-TIME FLOW ───────────────
let graphZoom = 1.0;
let graphPanX = 0;
let graphPanY = 0;
let graphNodePositions = [];
let graphFlowActive = true;
let graphAnimationRunning = false;
let graphAnimFrameId = null;
let graphPulseTime = 0;
let graphFlowProgress = 0;
let hoveredNodeIndex = -1;
let selectedNodeIndex = -1;
let currentInspectedNode = null;
let isGraphDragging = false;
let dragStartX = 0;
let dragStartY = 0;
let graphWheelZoomActive = false;
let graphConstellation = [];

function initGraphConstellation(w, h) {
  graphConstellation = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
    graphConstellation.push({
      x: Math.random() * w,
      y: Math.random() * h,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
      radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.8,
      alpha: Math.random() * 0.35 + 0.15
    });
  }
}

function zoomGraph(factor) {
  graphZoom *= factor;
  if (graphZoom < 0.4) graphZoom = 0.4;
  if (graphZoom > 2.8) graphZoom = 2.8;
  if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
}

function resetGraphZoom() {
  graphZoom = 1.0;
  graphPanX = 0;
  graphPanY = 0;
  if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
}

function toggleWheelZoom() {
  graphWheelZoomActive = !graphWheelZoomActive;
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnWheelZoom');
  if (btn) {
    if (graphWheelZoomActive) {
      btn.innerHTML = '🖱️ Wheel Zoom: ON';
      btn.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.45)';
      btn.style.background = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)';
      btn.style.boxShadow = '0 0 10px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25)';
      showToast('🖱️ Wheel Zoom ON (scroll mouse wheel to zoom)', 'info');
    } else {
      btn.innerHTML = '🖱️ Wheel Zoom: OFF';
      btn.style.color = '#94a3b8';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
      btn.style.background = 'transparent';
      btn.style.boxShadow = 'none';
      showToast('🖱️ Wheel Zoom OFF (normal page scrolling restored)', 'info');
    }
  }
}

function toggleFlowAnimation() {
  graphFlowActive = !graphFlowActive;
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnFlowToggle');
  if (btn) {
    if (graphFlowActive) {
      btn.innerHTML = '⚡ Flow: ON';
      btn.style.color = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35)';
      btn.style.background = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1)';
      startGraphAnimation();
    } else {
      btn.innerHTML = '⚡ Flow: OFF';
      btn.style.color = '#94a3b8';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
      btn.style.background = 'transparent';
      stopGraphAnimation();
      drawGraph();
    }
  }
}

function exportGraphSnapshot() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('graphCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  const caseRef = currentCaseId || ('CASE-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-6));
  link.download = `TraceX_Topology_${caseRef}.png`;
  link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  showToast('📷 HD Topology Map exported for LEA Dossier', 'success');
}

function startGraphAnimation() {
  if (!graphFlowActive) {
    drawGraph();
    return;
  }
  if (graphAnimationRunning) return;
  const pane = document.getElementById('pane-graph');
  if (!pane || !pane.classList.contains('active')) return;
  graphAnimationRunning = true;
  function loop() {
    if (!graphAnimationRunning) return;
    graphPulseTime += 1;
    if (graphFlowActive) {
      graphFlowProgress += 0.0075;
      if (graphFlowProgress >= 1.0) graphFlowProgress -= 1.0;
    }
    drawGraph();
    graphAnimFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  graphAnimFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function stopGraphAnimation() {
  graphAnimationRunning = false;
  if (graphAnimFrameId) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(graphAnimFrameId);
    graphAnimFrameId = null;
  }
}

// ─── MAIN GRAPH DRAW FUNCTION ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawGraph() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('graphCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const W = rect.width || canvas.offsetWidth || 1000;
  const H = 420;

  if (canvas.width !== Math.floor(W * dpr) || canvas.height !== Math.floor(H * dpr)) {
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
  }

  ctx.save();
  ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

  const cy = H / 2;

  // 1. Subdued Background Gradient
  const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, cy, 40, W / 2, cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#090e24');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#050817');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#020309');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // 2. Coordinate Grid Matrix with Crosshairs
  const gridSize = 45;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.04)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += gridSize) {
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += gridSize) {
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // Draw Grid Crosshairs (+)
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)';
  for (let x = gridSize; x < W; x += gridSize * 2) {
    for (let y = gridSize; y < H; y += gridSize * 2) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - 3, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, y);
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - 3);
      ctx.lineTo(x, y + 3);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // 3. Drifting Constellation Dust Particles
  if (graphConstellation.length === 0) initGraphConstellation(W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
  for (let i = 0; i < graphConstellation.length; i++) {
    const p = graphConstellation[i];
    p.x = (p.x + p.vx + W) % W;
    p.y = (p.y + p.vy + H) % H;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${p.alpha})`;
    ctx.fill();

    // Subtle connection lines between proximate dust points
    for (let j = i + 1; j < graphConstellation.length; j++) {
      const p2 = graphConstellation[j];
      const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - p2.x, p.y - p2.y);
      if (dist < 65) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
        ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(99, 102, 241, ${(1 - dist / 65) * 0.08})`;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Border Brackets [ ]
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  const cornerLen = 14;
  // Top-Left
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, 12 + cornerLen); ctx.lineTo(12, 12); ctx.lineTo(12 + cornerLen, 12);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Top-Right
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W - 12 - cornerLen, 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, 12 + cornerLen);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Bottom-Left
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, H - 12 - cornerLen); ctx.lineTo(12, H - 12); ctx.lineTo(12 + cornerLen, H - 12);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Bottom-Right
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W - 12 - cornerLen, H - 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, H - 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, H - 12 - cornerLen);
  ctx.stroke();

  // HUD Telemetry Overlays
  ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.55)';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('◈ TOPOLOGY MATRIX // SYSTEM: TRACEX-NEURAL // PS-26182', 18, 22);

  // Seamless Fallback to Benchmark Case if currentTrace is not yet initialized
  const traceData = currentTrace || (typeof getBenchmarkPathFallback === 'function' ? getBenchmarkPathFallback() : null);
  const nodes = (traceData && traceData.nodes && traceData.nodes.length > 0) ? traceData.nodes : [];
  const rawEdges = (traceData && (traceData.edges || traceData.links)) ? (traceData.edges || traceData.links) : [];
  const edges = rawEdges.map((e, idx) => {
    const srcNode = nodes[idx];
    const dstNode = nodes[idx + 1];
    return {
      ...e,
      from: e.from || e.source || (srcNode ? (srcNode.address || srcNode.id) : ''),
      to: e.to || e.target || (dstNode ? (dstNode.address || dstNode.id) : ''),
      amount: e.amount || (e.value ? (e.value + ' ' + (traceData?.asset || 'USDT')) : ''),
      tx_hash: e.tx_hash || e.hash || '',
      speed: e.speed || '2-5 min transfer'
    };
  });

  // Clean, Non-Colliding Bottom Telemetry
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(`HOPS: ${nodes.length} | FLOW: ${graphFlowActive ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`, W - 18, H - 14);

  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  const caseRef = (traceData && traceData.case_id) || currentCaseId || 'BENCHMARK-26182';
  ctx.fillText(`◈ CASE: ${caseRef}`, 18, H - 14);

  // 5. IF NO ACTIVE TRACE AND NO BENCHMARK: RENDER AWESOME RECON RADAR SCREEN
  if (nodes.length === 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, cy);

    // Concentric Range Rings
    [60, 120, 180, 230].forEach((r, idx) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = idx === 3 ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25)' : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.setLineDash(idx % 2 === 1 ? [4, 6] : []);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      
      // Range Ring Text
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3)';
      ctx.font = '9px JetBrains Mono';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText(`${r * 4}m`, r + 3, -4);
    });

    // Crosshair axis
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-230, 0); ctx.lineTo(230, 0);
    ctx.moveTo(0, -230); ctx.lineTo(0, 230);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Rotating Radar Sweep Beam
    const sweepAngle = graphPulseTime * 0.03;
    const sweepGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 230);
    sweepGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35)');
    sweepGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.0)');

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 230, sweepAngle - 0.45, sweepAngle);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = sweepGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    // Leading laser line of radar
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(sweepAngle) * 230, Math.sin(sweepAngle) * 230);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Standby Text Banner in Center
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 15, 36, 0.85)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(-210, -32, 420, 64, 10);
    else ctx.rect(-210, -32, 420, 64);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px Space Grotesk';
    ctx.fillText('◈ TOPOLOGY RECONNAISSANCE ENGINE ACTIVE', 0, -10);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = '11px JetBrains Mono';
    ctx.fillText('Execute a trace or select a benchmark case to map transaction hops', 0, 12);

    ctx.restore();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  // 6. IF TRACE ACTIVE: RENDER MULTI-HOP GRAPH WITH USER PAN & ZOOM
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W / 2 + graphPanX, cy + graphPanY);
  ctx.scale(graphZoom, graphZoom);
  ctx.translate(-W / 2, -cy);

  // Calculate Node Positions
  const nodeCount = nodes.length;
  if (nodeCount === 1) {
    // Single Hop (Direct VASP Hop-0)
    graphNodePositions = [{
      x: W / 2,
      y: cy,
      node: nodes[0],
      index: 0
    }];
  } else {
    const padX = Math.max(100, W * 0.11);
    const availW = W - padX * 2;
    const stepX = availW / (nodeCount - 1);
    graphNodePositions = nodes.map((n, i) => {
      const wave = Math.sin(i * 1.5 + 0.35) * (H * 0.15);
      return {
        x: padX + i * stepX,
        y: cy + wave,
        node: n,
        index: i
      };
    });
  }

  // Helper function for roundRect fallback
  function drawPill(rx, ry, rw, rh, rad) {
    if (ctx.roundRect) {
      ctx.roundRect(rx, ry, rw, rh, rad);
    } else {
      ctx.rect(rx, ry, rw, rh);
    }
  }

  // Helper to get entity info
  function getEntityMeta(n, idx) {
    const type = n.node_type || (idx === 0 ? 'suspect' : (idx === nodeCount - 1 ? 'exchange_deposit' : 'intermediary'));
    if (type === 'suspect' || idx === 0) {
      return { col: '#ef4444', icon: '⚠', tag: 'SUSPECT ORIGIN' };
    }
    if (type === 'exchange_deposit' || idx === nodeCount - 1) {
      return { col: '#10b981', icon: '🏛', tag: 'VASP GATEWAY' };
    }
    if (type === 'mixer') {
      return { col: '#a855f7', icon: '☍', tag: 'MIXER PROTOCOL' };
    }
    if (type === 'bridge') {
      return { col: '#38bdf8', icon: '⌥', tag: 'CROSS-CHAIN BRIDGE' };
    }
    return { col: '#f59e0b', icon: '⇄', tag: `MULE LAYER ${idx}` };
  }

  // 7. DRAW EDGES & ELECTRIC FLOW
  edges.forEach((e, i) => {
    let src = graphNodePositions.find(p => p.node && (p.node.id === e.from || p.node.address === e.from || p.node.id === e.source || p.node.address === e.source)) || graphNodePositions[i];
    let dst = graphNodePositions.find(p => p.node && (p.node.id === e.to || p.node.address === e.to || p.node.id === e.target || p.node.address === e.target)) || graphNodePositions[i + 1];
    if (!src || !dst) return;

    const srcMeta = getEntityMeta(src.node, src.index);
    const dstMeta = getEntityMeta(dst.node, dst.index);

    const dx = dst.x - src.x;
    const dy = dst.y - src.y;
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

    // Outer Glow Conduit
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(src.x, src.y);
    ctx.lineTo(dst.x, dst.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.22)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Inner Neon Core Line (Gradient from source color to destination color)
    const lineGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(src.x, src.y, dst.x, dst.y);
    lineGrad.addColorStop(0, srcMeta.col + '99');
    lineGrad.addColorStop(1, dstMeta.col + '99');

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(src.x, src.y);
    ctx.lineTo(dst.x, dst.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = lineGrad;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Directional Holographic Chevrons
    [0.32, 0.68].forEach(t => {
      const cxPos = src.x + dx * t;
      const cyPos = src.y + dy * t;
      const chevSize = 6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cxPos - Math.cos(angle - 0.5) * chevSize, cyPos - Math.sin(angle - 0.5) * chevSize);
      ctx.lineTo(cxPos, cyPos);
      ctx.lineTo(cxPos - Math.cos(angle + 0.5) * chevSize, cyPos - Math.sin(angle + 0.5) * chevSize);
      ctx.strokeStyle = dstMeta.col;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    });

    // Real-Time Electric Fund Flow Photons
    if (graphFlowActive) {
      const photonCount = 3;
      for (let k = 0; k < photonCount; k++) {
        const pt = (graphFlowProgress + k / photonCount) % 1.0;
        const px = src.x + dx * pt;
        const py = src.y + dy * pt;

        // Draw Comet Tail (3 trail points)
        for (let tr = 1; tr <= 3; tr++) {
          const trailT = (pt - tr * 0.02 + 1.0) % 1.0;
          const tx = src.x + dx * trailT;
          const ty = src.y + dy * trailT;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(tx, ty, 3 - tr * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = dstMeta.col + (tr === 1 ? '70' : (tr === 2 ? '40' : '15'));
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // Photon Head
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowColor = dstMeta.col;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, 3.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, 5.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = dstMeta.col + '88';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

    // Floating Glass Pill Badge for Transaction Amount
    const mx = (src.x + dst.x) / 2;
    const my = (src.y + dst.y) / 2 - 16;
    const amtText = e.amount || '';
    if (amtText) {
      ctx.font = 'bold 10px JetBrains Mono';
      const textWidth = ctx.measureText(amtText).width;
      const pillW = textWidth + 24;
      const pillH = 20;
      const px = mx - pillW / 2;
      const py = my - pillH / 2;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      drawPill(px, py, pillW, pillH, 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8, 12, 28, 0.9)';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      // Icon + Amount text
      ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
      ctx.fillText('⚡', px + 5, my);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
      ctx.fillText(amtText, px + 17, my);
    }
  });

  // 8. DRAW HOLOGRAPHIC MULTI-RING NODES
  graphNodePositions.forEach((p, i) => {
    const n = p.node;
    const meta = getEntityMeta(n, i);
    const radius = 22;
    const isHovered = (hoveredNodeIndex === i);
    const isSelected = (selectedNodeIndex === i);
    const isActiveFocus = (isHovered || isSelected);

    // Layer 1: Ambient Pulsing Aura
    const pulseRad = radius + 8 + Math.sin(graphPulseTime * 0.05 + i) * 4;
    const auraGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, radius, p.x, p.y, pulseRad + 6);
    auraGrad.addColorStop(0, meta.col + (isActiveFocus ? '45' : '25'));
    auraGrad.addColorStop(1, meta.col + '00');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, pulseRad + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = auraGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    // Layer 2: Rotating Dashed HUD Scanner Ring
    const ringAngle = graphPulseTime * 0.02 * (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.rotate(ringAngle);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, radius + 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = meta.col + (isActiveFocus ? 'cc' : '77');
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // 4 Micro Tick Crosshairs on HUD ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = meta.col;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5].forEach(ang => {
      const tx1 = Math.cos(ang) * (radius + 4);
      const ty1 = Math.sin(ang) * (radius + 4);
      const tx2 = Math.cos(ang) * (radius + 10);
      const ty2 = Math.sin(ang) * (radius + 10);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx1, ty1);
      ctx.lineTo(tx2, ty2);
      ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.restore();

    // Layer 3: Solid Core Metallic Sphere
    const sphereGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x - 5, p.y - 5, 2, p.x, p.y, radius);
    sphereGrad.addColorStop(0, meta.col);
    sphereGrad.addColorStop(0.7, meta.col + 'dd');
    sphereGrad.addColorStop(1, '#060814');

    ctx.save();
    if (isActiveFocus) {
      ctx.shadowColor = isSelected ? '#c084fc' : meta.col;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = sphereGrad;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = isActiveFocus ? '#ffffff' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)';
    ctx.lineWidth = isActiveFocus ? 2.5 : 1.8;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Layer 4: Center Hop Number & Icon
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Space Grotesk';
    ctx.fillText(`${meta.icon} ${i}`, p.x, p.y);

    // Layer 5: Active Target Lock Brackets [ ] when hovered or selected
    if (isActiveFocus) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = isSelected ? '#c084fc' : '#38bdf8';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      const bSize = radius + 12;
      const bLen = 8;
      // Top-Left bracket
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x - bSize, p.y - bSize + bLen);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - bSize, p.y - bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - bSize + bLen, p.y - bSize);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Top-Right bracket
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + bSize - bLen, p.y - bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + bSize, p.y - bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + bSize, p.y - bSize + bLen);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Bottom-Left bracket
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x - bSize, p.y + bSize - bLen);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - bSize, p.y + bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - bSize + bLen, p.y + bSize);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Bottom-Right bracket
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + bSize - bLen, p.y + bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + bSize, p.y + bSize);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + bSize, p.y + bSize - bLen);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Layer 6: Floating Pill Container for Entity Label & Address
    const labelY = p.y + radius + 12;
    const rawAddr = n.address || n.id || '';
    const shortAddr = rawAddr.length > 10 ? (rawAddr.slice(0, 6) + '...' + rawAddr.slice(-4)) : (rawAddr || 'N/A');
    const tagText = meta.tag;

    ctx.font = 'bold 10px Space Grotesk';
    const tagW = ctx.measureText(tagText).width;
    ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono';
    const addrW = ctx.measureText(shortAddr).width;
    const labelPillW = Math.max(tagW, addrW) + 20;
    const labelPillH = 32;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    drawPill(p.x - labelPillW / 2, labelY, labelPillW, labelPillH, 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(7, 11, 26, 0.9)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = isHovered ? meta.col : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Label Line 1: Tag
    ctx.font = 'bold 10px Space Grotesk';
    ctx.fillStyle = meta.col;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText(tagText, p.x, labelY + 4);

    // Label Line 2: Address
    ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono';
    ctx.fillStyle = isHovered ? '#38bdf8' : '#94a3b8';
    ctx.fillText(shortAddr, p.x, labelY + 17);
  });

  ctx.restore();
  ctx.restore();
}

// ─── INTERACTIVE LISTENERS (DRAG PAN, WHEEL ZOOM, HOVER, CLICK) ─────────────
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('graphCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;

  // 1. Mouse Down: Start Pan Drag
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isGraphDragging = true;
    dragStartX = e.clientX - graphPanX;
    dragStartY = e.clientY - graphPanY;
    canvas.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
  });

  // 2. Window Mouse Up: End Pan Drag
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
    if (isGraphDragging) {
      isGraphDragging = false;
      if (canvas) canvas.style.cursor = hoveredNodeIndex !== -1 ? 'pointer' : 'crosshair';
    }
  });

  // 3. Mouse Move: Hover Detection & Tooltip
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;

    if (isGraphDragging) {
      graphPanX = e.clientX - dragStartX;
      graphPanY = e.clientY - dragStartY;
      if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
      return;
    }

    const W = rect.width;
    const H = 420;
    const cy = H / 2;

    // Inverse matrix transform
    const tx = (mouseX - (W / 2 + graphPanX)) / graphZoom + W / 2;
    const ty = (mouseY - (cy + graphPanY)) / graphZoom + cy;

    let foundIdx = -1;
    for (let p of graphNodePositions) {
      const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - tx, p.y - ty);
      if (dist <= 28) {
        foundIdx = p.index;
        break;
      }
    }

    hoveredNodeIndex = foundIdx;
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('graphHoverTooltip');

    if (foundIdx !== -1) {
      canvas.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      const p = graphNodePositions[foundIdx];
      const targetNode = p.node;
      if (tooltip) {
        tooltip.style.display = 'block';
        tooltip.style.left = `${Math.min(mouseX + 15, W - 260)}px`;
        tooltip.style.top = `${Math.min(mouseY + 15, H - 120)}px`;

        const isSuspect = (foundIdx === 0);
        const isVasp = (foundIdx === graphNodePositions.length - 1);
        const col = isSuspect ? '#ef4444' : (isVasp ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b');
        const roleName = isSuspect ? '⚠ SUSPECT WALLET' : (isVasp ? '🏛 VASP GATEWAY' : `⇄ MULE HOP #${foundIdx}`);

        tooltip.innerHTML = `
          <div class="tt-header">
            <span style="color:${col};font-weight:700">${roleName}</span>
            <span style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;background:${col}22;border:1px solid ${col}55;color:${col}">${targetNode.risk_badge || 'ACTIVE'}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tt-addr">${targetNode.address || 'N/A'}</div>
          <div class="tt-meta">
            <span>Amount: <strong style="color:var(--accent-green)">${targetNode.amount || 'N/A'}</strong></span>
            <span>Type: <strong style="color:#fff">${targetNode.wallet_classification || targetNode.node_type || 'Unhosted'}</strong></span>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:10px;color:#38bdf8;margin-top:6px;text-align:right">👉 Click node for full forensics</div>
        `;
      }
    } else {
      canvas.style.cursor = 'crosshair';
      if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';
    }

    if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
  });

  // 4. Mouse Leave
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
    hoveredNodeIndex = -1;
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('graphHoverTooltip');
    if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';
    if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
  });

  // 5. Wheel Zoom (Only zooms if Wheel Zoom option is ON or user holds Ctrl key; otherwise normal page scroll happens)
  canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
    if (graphWheelZoomActive || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const factor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;
      zoomGraph(factor);
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  // 6. Click on Node: Open Inspection Drawer
  canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const W = rect.width;
    const H = 420;
    const cy = H / 2;

    const tx = (clickX - (W / 2 + graphPanX)) / graphZoom + W / 2;
    const ty = (clickY - (cy + graphPanY)) / graphZoom + cy;

    for (let p of graphNodePositions) {
      const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - tx, p.y - ty);
      if (dist <= 30) {
        inspectGraphNode(p.node, p.index);
        return;
      }
    }
  });
});

function inspectGraphNode(node, idx) {
  selectedNodeIndex = idx;
  currentInspectedNode = node;
  const drawer = document.getElementById('nodeInspectorDrawer');
  const title = document.getElementById('inspectNodeTitle');
  const body = document.getElementById('inspectNodeBody');
  if (!drawer || !node) return;

  const isSuspect = (idx === 0);
  const isVasp = (idx === graphNodePositions.length - 1);
  const roleLabel = isSuspect ? 'Suspect Origin' : (isVasp ? 'VASP Exit Gateway' : `Hop ${idx} Intermediary Mule`);

  // Update Header Status Pill
  const pill = document.getElementById('graphTargetPill');
  const targetPillText = document.getElementById('targetPillText');
  if (pill && targetPillText) {
    pill.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    targetPillText.textContent = `🎯 Hop ${idx} [${roleLabel}]`;
  }

  if (title) {
    title.innerHTML = `
      <span>⚡ Target Acquired: Hop ${idx} // ${roleLabel}</span>
      <span class="badge-cyber" style="background:rgba(168,85,247,0.25);border:1px solid #c084fc;color:#e9d5ff;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;margin-left:8px;border-radius:4px">DOCKED BELOW GRAPH</span>
    `;
  }
  if (body) {
    const riskBadge = node.risk_badge || 'MODERATE';
    const riskColor = riskBadge === 'CRITICAL' || riskBadge === 'HIGH' ? '#ef4444' : (riskBadge === 'MINIMAL' ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b');

    body.innerHTML = `
      <div>
        <div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px">Full Address</div>
        <div style="color:var(--accent-cyan);word-break:break-all;font-size:11px">${node.address || 'N/A'}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px">Entity Classification</div>
        <div style="color:#fff;font-weight:600">${node.wallet_classification || node.node_type || 'Unhosted Wallet'}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px">Value Handled</div>
        <div style="color:var(--accent-green);font-weight:600">${node.amount || 'N/A'}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px">FATF Risk Severity</div>
        <div style="color:${riskColor};font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
          <span class="status-dot" style="background:${riskColor}"></span>
          <span>${riskBadge}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
  drawer.style.display = 'block';
  drawer.classList.remove('pulse-glow');
  void drawer.offsetWidth;
  drawer.classList.add('pulse-glow');

  // Smooth scroll so the drawer is immediately in view
  setTimeout(() => {
    drawer.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
  }, 40);

  showToast(`🎯 Hop ${idx} details loaded below graph ↓`, 'info');
  if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
}

function copyCurrentInspectNode() {
  if (currentInspectedNode && currentInspectedNode.address) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentInspectedNode.address).then(() => {
      showToast('✓ Address copied to clipboard', 'success');
      const btn = document.getElementById('inspectCopyBtn');
      if (btn) {
        btn.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#10b981;font-weight:700">✓ Copied!</span>';
        btn.style.borderColor = '#10b981';
        btn.style.background = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.innerHTML = '📋 Copy Address';
          btn.style.borderColor = '';
          btn.style.background = '';
        }, 1500);
      }
    }).catch(() => {
      prompt('Copy address: Ctrl+C, Enter', currentInspectedNode.address);
    });
  }
}

function closeNodeInspector() {
  selectedNodeIndex = -1;
  const drawer = document.getElementById('nodeInspectorDrawer');
  if (drawer) drawer.style.display = 'none';
  const pill = document.getElementById('graphTargetPill');
  if (pill) pill.style.display = 'none';
  if (!graphAnimationRunning) drawGraph();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  const pane = document.getElementById('pane-graph');
  if (pane && pane.classList.contains('active')) {
    drawGraph();
  }
});

async function loadLiveData() {
  if (!currentTrace) {
    currentTrace = {
      suspect_address: 'TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t',
      chain: 'TRON',
      case_id: 'DEMO-SIH26182-001',
      nearest_vasp: { name: 'CoinDCX Nodal Compliance', confidence: 88, inr_value: 480000, is_indian: true }
    };
  }
  const addr = currentTrace.suspect_address;
  const chain = currentTrace.chain;
  const container = document.getElementById('liveDataContent');
  const btn = document.getElementById('loadLiveBtn');

  btn.textContent = '⏳ Querying On-Chain APIs...';
  btn.disabled = true;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--text-muted)">
      <div class="cyber-radar" style="margin:auto;margin-bottom:16px"></div>
      <div>Dispatching queries to PublicAML, Chainabuse, and Explorer nodes...</div>
    </div>
  `;

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/api/live/${encodeURIComponent(addr)}?chain=${chain}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    renderLiveData(data);
  } catch (e) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="color:var(--accent-danger);padding:20px">❌ Query Failed: ${e.message}</div>`;
  } finally {
    btn.textContent = '🔄 Refresh Query Data';
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
}

function copyNotice(e) {
  const preview = document.getElementById('noticePreview');
  const txt = preview ? preview.textContent : '';
  if (!txt || txt.includes("Click 'Synthesize")) {
    showToast('Please synthesize Section 91 notice first', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  const triggerBtn = (e && e.currentTarget) || (typeof event !== 'undefined' && event && event.currentTarget) || null;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => {
    showToast('✓ Section 91 statutory notice copied to clipboard!', 'success');
    if (triggerBtn) {
      triggerBtn.classList.add('btn-copied-anim');
      setTimeout(() => triggerBtn.classList.remove('btn-copied-anim'), 1200);
    }
  }).catch(() => {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = txt;
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    showToast('✓ Section 91 statutory notice copied to clipboard!', 'success');
    if (triggerBtn) {
      triggerBtn.classList.add('btn-copied-anim');
      setTimeout(() => triggerBtn.classList.remove('btn-copied-anim'), 1200);
    }
  });
}
